Datapads_FE.05_D_Boxes_in_corridor_01_c_Content:
Chris: Alright, joke's over. It's been four weeks that these boxes have been blocking the hallway. Take them to the storeroom already.

Cam: No one's told us to clean them up. My people have things to do.

Chris: You need to be told to do anything? At least move them aside. They're right in the fucking middle, you can barely get through. Harold tripped over them today and nearly broke the equipment.

Cam: Don't use such language. If it's bothering you so much, go to the logistics department. If we're officially told to move the boxes, we'll get right on it.

Cam: As soon as we're done with higher priority tasks, of course.

Chris: You know full well that there's a bigger mess in the paperwork than here. It'll take at least a week, if we're lucky.

Cam: Had you reported this four weeks ago, it's possible it would've already been done three weeks ago :)

Chris: Don't fucking piss me off.
Datapads_FE.27_D_Office_01_c_Content:
From: Aiden Patel
To: IRO Mission Bureau

The changes that we need to introduce to the Engine have extended our mission time. I'm sure that very soon everything will be ready - we have also gathered some very interesting data in the meantime. We're motivated to continue our work but our food supplies are slowly starting to run out. Please send an additional transport that will help us continue our mission.

——

From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: Aiden Patel

We fully understand the challenges you face during this revolutionary mission. We appreciate your courage and the sacrifice you are making in the name of science. We recommend optimizing management of your current supplies, by reducing daily food rations, for example.

——

From: Aiden Patel
To: IRO Mission Bureau

We've already reduced our food rations. Further reduction is not possible. If I don't receive additional food quickly, I'll be forced to hibernate the discs of most of the crew. Their safety is my priority and I can't allow them to starve.

——

From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: Aiden Patel

Hibernation is an excellent idea. It will effectively help reduce the wasting of supplies and the Engine does not currently need to maintain a full crew.

The management is impressed with your creativity and quick problem solving in stressful situations. This is why you were hired.

We trust you will be able to make the right decisions on your own.

——

From: Aiden Patel
To: IRO Mission Bureau

I'd like to emphasize that this solution is only TEMPORARY. It is meant to ensure the safety of all personnel until the food transport arrives. Once again I'll ask you to send it as quickly as possible.
Datapads_FE.37_D_Autocorrection_01_c_Content:
From: Aiden Patel
To: Isaac Saneer

I didn't sleep a wink last night… I couldn't stop thinking about your red, full lips. I could kiss them non-stop. And those thighs! So round and firm! Skin soft like silk. I want to dive in between those beautiful legs… Let's meet again today. Come to my office, following ODM protocol, of course ;p

———

From: Isaac Saneer
To: Aiden Patel

Hey Boss,
I don't know who you wanted to send this to but I doubt it was me... I'll pretend I didn't see it, but be careful next time. I don't want to know your life's intimate details like this.
P.S. I'm jealous.

———

From: Aiden Patel
To: Isaac Saneer

That email was to test if I can trust you. You passed. Delete it at once.
Datapads_FE.13_D_Biologist_office_02_c_Content:
From: Aiden Patel
To: Isabella Santos

What the fuck were you thinking? I should throw you into a box and leave you there. If we didn't have a staff shortage I'd send you on the first transport back to Earth.

I'm demoting you. From now on, you come to me first with everything. EVERYTHING. You can continue your research, but officially you're on test tube cleaning duty, or whatever it is you all do in that lab. Got it?

We'll figure it out. And we'll handle all private matters in person from now on. Delete all previous messages, I already did.

It's also time for our scheduled ODM.

From: Isabella Santos
To: Aiden Patel

ODM? Seriously? After you cut my salary?

From: Aiden Patel
To: Isabella Santos

I'm not forcing you to do anything.
Datapads_FE.15_D_Disc_01_c_Content:
From: Albert Miller
To: Sarah Miller

I'm worried you haven't written back in so long. You said they'll soon put your discs into storage - I hope that's where you are and you're safe. I decided I'd write you so that you have something to read when you're back in your body.

Agathe is doing great in school and there's a chance she'll be eligible for a scholarship next semester! Maybe she'll follow in your footsteps and become a scientist - she's mentioned something about physics.

Your parents were finally able to find an apartment closer to ours. They want to keep an eye out on their granddaughter while you're away. After all those years they still don't trust that scatterbrain husband of yours!

Our spot on the corner changed chefs but I can confirm that the ravioli you love so much is still as good as ever. I'll take you there when you get back.

We all miss you so much. Write back when you can.
I love you,
Albert.
Datapads_FE.02_D_Cloning_01_c_Content:
From: Cloning Center
To: Thomas King

Thomas, we tried being nice, but I've had it, so I'll be blunt. We can't give you muscles, it's against regulations, end of discussion. I'll report everything to Aiden if you continue pestering us.

——

From: Thomas King
To: Cloning Center

I read the regulations. If my sleeve happens to be crushed by something heavy, then according to paragraph 6, clause 72, I can get a new one with additional muscle tissue. Plus I'd get a discount on account of insurance. What do you say? I'll give you a little something from the discount.

 ——

From: Cloning Center
To: Thomas King

No.

——

From: Cloning Center
To: Thomas King

As you probably noticed, we didn't give you muscles, but we did write an official complaint. You have a desk job, Thomas, we can't cite getting crushed by an engine as a workplace accident. Focus on logistics and don't touch any more heavy machinery.

 ——

From: Cloning Center
To: Thomas King

Stop it. We don't have an endless supply of biofilament. I took a look at your finances and you can't afford to keep changing sleeves. If you're trying to appeal to our conscience, it won't work. Instead of destroying sleeve after sleeve, try working out and getting a six-pack.

——

From: Cloning Center
To: Thomas King

In a way, you deserve to be congratulated. You’re the first crew member to be marked by the system as being unfit for the mission. We had to put your disc away in the storeroom. If you’re reading this, that means the mission’s over. Unfortunately, I don’t know how long it lasted, so an invoice for storing your disc is in some other message. In the future, I recommend physical exercise, it’s free and doesn’t lead to getting suspended from your duties. See you back on Earth.

You were our favorite patient, nineteen sleeves in 8 weeks. Bravo.
Datapads_FE.28_D_Office_02_c_Content:
From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: Aiden Patel

As requested, I'm sending you the general plan for the World Engine program.

Engine H-01 (temporarily suspended) - A terraforming heating machine that allows for survival near the dark regions of the planet.

Engine W-01 (working, in testing phase) - A machine that purifies the planet's natural water resources. This would make it not only suitable for industrial use but also, in the near future, for consumption.

Engine A-01 (in initial testing phase) - A machine that changes the planet's atmosphere to reduce the effects of cosmic radiation on the planet.

Engine S-01 (building to commence soon) - A machine that controls a satellite defense system around the planet against meteor showers and the influence of Ruptura activity.

Engine M-01 (in planning phase) - A planned underground machine that would manipulate the flow of the planet's core to increase the protection of its surface by amplifying the effects of its natural magnetic field.


Please remember that all information contained in this email is highly classified. Revealing it to any unauthorized individuals will result in immediate termination and a fine in the amount of the highest possible credit.

Remember that it is you who are building the Engines that will power the world of tomorrow!
Datapads_FE.29_D_IRO_office_02_c_Content:
From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: Aiden Patel

It has come to our attention that Dr. Santos has revealed the recipe for the XK-CD-6 substance. Do you know anything about this?

———

From: Aiden Patel
To: IRO Mission Bureau

Good morning!

Dr. Santos will face the consequences of her actions, as outlined in her contract. Dr. Santos has been demoted from her position and fined for the amount equal to her salary for the full duration of the mission.

Respectfully,
Aiden Patel

———

From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: Aiden Patel

We believe that a person who willingly violates signed agreements and opposes patent law, the rules of the free market, and also causes honest employees of Future Health Solutions to face potential consequences should not perform any role on a mission as prestigious as the World Engine program.

We recommend that she is placed in forced hibernation and her disc is sent to us on the next transport back to Earth.

Of course, the decision is yours. But please remember that it could affect your performance review.
Datapads_FE.03_D_Welcome_01_c_Content:
From: IRO Mission Bureau
To: All
Subject: Welcome!
Welcome to the World Engine program!

Congratulations! You are among the pioneers who will help build a second home here! Remember that our goal is to make everyone who comes to the new world not only safe from radiation but, in the future, able to take a deep breath of fresh air! We invite you for a briefing and some refreshments to the canteen on level 0. The briefing will be conducted by logistics officer Aiden Patel, and then after the refreshments, each team will be led by its supervisors:

Logistics: Officer Aiden Patel
Chemists: Prof. Mason Johnson
Technicians: Dr. Peter Kelsey
Biologists: Dr. Isabella Santos
Security/Support/Searchers: Col. Bruce Walker

The IRO thanks you for your commitment to the cause and your work for the good of all mankind! You're heroes!
Datapads_FE.11_D_Lab_05_c_Content:
From: Isabella Santos
To: Aiden Patel
Report on air filter effectiveness

As expected, the RanMun synthesizer in the ventilation system is working perfectly not only as an electrolysis device for oxygen compounds in the atmosphere but also as a filtering device. No toxic substances have been detected in over ten days and oxygen levels are remaining stable at a very satisfactory and safe 32%. This confirms Prof. Johnson's conclusions as well.

Because the air filters are being used up very slowly, they should last another 216 years, so that's a problem for any potential future expedition.

I would like to take this opportunity to express my disappointment in the policies of Future Health Solutions regarding its patents. Providing the rest of the personnel with information regarding the composition of the XK-CD-6 substance used in the air filters and how it works would give us more leeway and a quicker assessment of whether this particular compound is fit to be spread across the surface of the planet. If we were to share the makeup of the substance with all scientific personnel, it would provide us with a faster and better assessment of not only any possible dangers but the general potential of the second phase of the mission, which is the creation of breathable air across the entire planet.

It is my conclusion that oxygen masks are no longer required inside the facility. All technical details are attached.

Dr. Isabella Santos
Datapads_FE.12_D_Biologist_office_01_c_Content:
From: Isabella Santos
To: Biological Research Department + 2 more

Dear all, I'm done butting heads with FHS about patent secrecy. Attached is the full composition of the substance XK-CD-6.

You've all signed the NDA, you all know the consequences of revealing mission secrets, so I trust none of you will be careless enough to do anything with this information. I believe that knowing the details of the product we're working with every day will make our work more efficient.

All the best and I can't wait for my work with every single one of you to be much smoother from now on.
Dr. Isabella Santos
Datapads_FE.14_D_Biologist_office_03_c_Content:
From: Isabella Santos
To: Mason Johnson

Hey,

How's the research coming along on the effect of XK-CD-6 on Sulheart? The deadline was four days ago.

Best,
Dr. Isabella Santos

———

From: Mason Johnson
To: Isabella Santos

Chris and Harold reported seeing a negative reaction from one of the proteins in the fruit. The tests are taking longer than expected. It's hard to tell when we will have the report ready.

Regards,
Prof. Mason Johnson

———

From: Isabella Santos
To: Mason Johnson

Mason, you know full well it's probably one of the fluorides in XK-CD-6. Just finish the research yourself.

Best,
Dr. Isabella Santos

———

From: Mason Johnson
To: Isabella Santos

I can't do everything myself. And before you ask, no, I can't tell them such details. I'll break the NDA, a classified substance is classified. Patience, we're not in any rush.

Prof. Mason Johnson
Datapads_FE.36_D_Storage_c_Content:
From: Logistics
To: All

Due to numerous questions regarding the distribution of supplies, we would like to inform you that we were forced to limit the distribution of food rations to an absolute minimum. Because it is not possible for us to receive additional supplies in the near future, we have calculated the minimum caloric requirement for everyone present and food will be issued in those exact amounts. Anything above that is an unnecessary luxury that we can't afford if we still wish to be the "Engine that powers the world of tomorrow". Patience, let's endure this for the good of all mankind, we believe, we're sure, that our efforts will be acknowledged and rewarded.

We would also like to announce that all storerooms from now on will be protected by soldiers. Any attempt at theft or bribery will result in forced hibernation and a debt imposed in accordance with the updated regulations.

We're fighting for a better tomorrow and our new home.
Datapads_FE.39_D_Costa_mail_01_c_Content:
From: Luca Costa
To: Bella Porshe

Hey!

This is engineer Luca Costa, we met in the cafeteria, I found you in the system. I'll get straight to the point: I'm jealous you were able to see Arcadia. Do you know if it'd be possible to join you on your next expedition? Maybe you could use someone who knows the equipment? I'm really getting tired of being cooped up in here.

Best,
Engineer Luca Costa

———

Hey.

You shouldn't even be writing me, much less asking about something like that. Our team is full, we're not planning to recruit anyone new, not now, not ever. You weren't trained to survive out there and trust me, you don't want to go out there. I hope I've made myself clear. One more message and I'll block you.

Junior Searcher, Corporal Bella Porshe
Datapads_FE.38_D_ClaywoodEngineerMail_01_c_Content:
From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

I'm writing to you in secret from an IRO research facility in the Ruptura System. My name is Luca Costa and I am an engineer working on the planet terraforming project. The team I'm a part of has made incredible discoveries. Modifying the atmosphere has caused unexpected changes. The IRO does not understand the significance of our research but I trust you will appreciate it. The Claywood Corporation has much to gain by learning this information.
I am ready to divulge certain data on the condition that a large shipment of nonperishable food is delivered to our base. We can make the exchange at any moment, the sooner the better.

——

From: Claywood Corp.
To: Luca Costa

Thank you for such an extraordinarily interesting proposition, but I'm afraid that it would be too risky at the moment.

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

Claywood, you don't understand. I can give you access to all of the information, all of the documents. You can take over the entire project for yourself. I can work for you and I'll definitely be able to convince others as well. I don't want weapons, medicine or anything illegal, just food. One shipment will do, supplies for at least two weeks. I'm sure we can come to some kind of agreement.

——

From: Claywood Corp.
To: Luca Costa

Do you have a way to send a sample of the documents so that I can judge their worth?

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

Sample is attached. There's a lot more where that came from.

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

Have you had a chance to look at what I sent? I really need a quick decision here.

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

I gave you what you wanted. Now it's your turn. It's not just about me, there are other people here. You have no idea what we're going through. We won't make it without your help.
I know you're a decent person. I'm offering you a fair deal. Please write me back.

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Claywood Corp.

You son of a bitch! You're just like the IRO. It's all about profit, you don't care about the people. You're a nobody, another greedy power-hungry asshole. You think I need your help? You'll regret that you ignored me!
Datapads_FE.01_D_MachineBody_01_c_Content:
From: Luca Costa
To: Hana Yamamoto

I can't take this anymore! The IRO doesn't care about us, food's running out, even Claywood won't help! I'm not going to sit here on my hands and wait for death. I'm leaving, today, maybe the people there will actually do something. If you want to join me, come to my lab.

——

From: Hana Yamamoto
To: Luca Costa

I understand how you feel, but this is not a good idea. The planet's full of Vermin and you don't have the right equipment or a weapon. Please, don't risk it! You're safe here! Our plan will soon start working, you must be patient.
If you need to talk, I'll gladly listen. Just don't do anything foolish.

——

From: Luca Costa
To: Hana Yamamoto

If you want to stay and wait for a miracle, be my guest. I don't have a lot of time left. Aiden wants to put my disc in a drawer, I don't know for how long. Don't worry about my equipment, I plan on getting ready. Don't try to stop me.
I'm sending you the base coordinates if you change your mind.
Datapads_FE.33_D_TechLab_01_c_Content:
From: Peter Kelsey
To: Moon Energy Corporation - Research and New Technologies Department

Ladies and Gentlemen,
My name is Peter Kelsey and I am the lead technician for the terraforming mission on Arcadia-7 in the Ruptura System. During research on modifying the atmosphere, a sudden increase in alkane concentration in the air occurred. This inspired me to begin working on a machine that would extract alkanes directly from the air and use them to produce energy. I was able to create a prototype for such a device. Below are the benefits of mass producing it.

Benefits:
Electricity generated out of the planet's air is a renewable, ecological and innovative source of energy. It could turn out to be as much - or even more - of a breakthrough for the space energy industry as Helium-3. My device will provide the colonists on Arcadia with much more energy than the currently used technology, without the need for digging or drilling. It will also make it easier to colonize other planets with similar atmospheres.

Partnership proposal:
The machine prototype designed by me to generate electricity out of the atmosphere has achieved very promising results during testing. I plan to continue fixing and improving it. I turn to you with an offer of cooperation - in exchange for financing my project, I propose granting the Energy Moon Corporation all rights and patents for this groundbreaking device. We can discuss compensation and a potential percentage of the profits at a later time.
I am willing to abandon my current terraforming project if need be and move to one of your bases on any given planet.

——

From: Moon Energy Corporation - Research and New Technologies Department
To: Peter Kelsey

Dear Mr. Kelsey,
Thank you for contacting our company. Your project has generated a lot of interest here. Attached is our offer - please let us know if the amount is satisfactory.
For now, you should continue working on the prototype on Arcadia, since it has the best conditions for it.
Please make sure that any further correspondence on this matter is encrypted.
Datapads_FE.40_D_Corridor_02_c_Content:
From: Robert Poole
To: Aiden Patel

We've reinforced the barricades but I doubt they'll hold for long. If the intruders get through and reach the generator, it's over. Are you sure you can't send anyone our way? Every pair of hands would help.
I'm worried about the disc storeroom. I saw one of the intruders get our engineer, it went straight for his disc, pulled it out of his body... I think they know. They're destroying not only the bodies but the discs on purpose. They know that's the only way they can really kill us. Aiden, they're intelligent. I've never seen anything like this. We underestimated them, we can't make the same mistake again.

If you have any materials to strengthen the barricade, send them to us. We'll win.
Datapads_FE.26_D_Corridor_03_c_Content:
From: Stephanie Montes
To: Aiden Patel

The barricade's fallen! The exobiological entities are in the generator. With access to so much energy they'll start multiplying exponentially. This is no longer a threat just to us but to everyone on Arcadia!

———

From: Aiden Patel
To: Stephanie Montes

You need to shut off the generator at all costs! Try to get to the technical corridor.

———

From: Stephanie Montes
To: Aiden Patel

I'm going now, I'm taking the gear with me, I'll do what I can. Keep your fingers crossed.
Datapads_FE.35_D_Coffee_01_c_Content:
From: Thomas King
To: Logistics

Hello,

When I was applying for this project, one of the benefits you guaranteed was access to natural coffee. Meanwhile, I have been forced to drink algae coffee for the past 57 days. I have analyzed my contract and I'm afraid this is in violation of the conditions of our initial agreement. Could you please tell me when we will get actual coffee?

Best regards,
Thomas King
Datapads_FE.34_D_TechLab_02_c_Content:
From: Wentworth Connelly
To: Jules Dawn

Hey!

I was looking through the paperwork on facilities currently on Arcadia and I noticed (you won't believe it) that you're on the list. What's up? We haven't seen each other in quite a few years. I'm so happy you've decided to make some extra money and came all the way out here. I really hope you'll make enough to return the 60,000 UC you owe your friend.

You know what's interesting about our Engine? It releases atmospheric compounds with such precision that I could change the composition of the atmosphere in one small area and then flood it with ionizing cosmic radiation. Of course, we're not allowed to do that, there's high probability that a person could be in that area and we'd destroy their sleeve, maybe even their disc too. But if I did want to have some fun, I have this one hypothetical area, I've attached its coordinates along with my bank account number.

We should meet up.

Hugs,
Wentworth Connelly
Datapads_FE.06_D_BHP_c_Content:
General Notes
• The Food Station should be installed and operated according to the instruction manual.
• The Food Station should be hung in a well-ventilated area.

Basic Safety Rules
• The Food Station should only be operated by personnel familiar with the instruction manual.
• Only items intended for consumption should be placed inside the Food Station.
• Any items processed by the Food Station should be consumed within 426 days. Consuming a product after this period does not guarantee the quality assured by Future Health Solutions.
• The Food Station may only be used by individuals 21 years of age or older (in Earth years). If you are unsure of your age, please refer to the table on page 289 of the instruction manual. It will allow you to easily calculate your age based on the celestial body you are currently on.
• By using the Food Station, you waive your right to any compensation from Future Health Solutions in the event of damage and/or destruction of your sleeve (both internally and externally).
• After each use, the Food Station should be set to full-clean mode. This process can take anywhere from 6 to 92 minutes, depending on the amount of stains present as well as external factors.
• Due to the risk of fuse damage, the Food Station can only be disconnected from power if the entire grid has been safely shut off. To do this, the user should contact the technical lead or the next highest ranking person. Hierarchy details can be found on page 56 of the supplementary instruction manual.

Enjoy your delicious, nutritious meal!
Future Health Solutions: For modern problems
Datapads_FE.41_D_Servers_01_c_Content: I'm clearly going crazy from the hunger. I spent nearly an hour trying to get the door open but my card doesn't seem to work. All I can do is wait. The humming of the servers is the worst. It's like a drill going into my head. I'm afraid I'll eventually rip my ears off or damage my disc. I'm losing hope anyone will get me out of here. I'm afraid everyone's dead. My body's already digested everything it could. Dear journal, I'm going to sleep.
Datapads_FE.30_D_Corridor_01_c_Content:
Introduction:
Despite the shutting down of security systems, the Engine still remained a safe shelter until the unauthorized opening of the main entrance. As the result of sabotage by one of the engineers, the aliens managed to get inside.

Description of damages:
90% of laboratories and work rooms on level 0 were destroyed. The door blocking mechanism was damaged, which meant we were not able to close the facility back again and prevent more aliens from getting in. We were able to secure the clone station. A barricade is currently preventing the Vermin from getting through to the lowest levels.

We are unable to contact any of the personnel on level +1. We assume that level has been entirely taken over by the enemy.

The intruders have infected most of the strategic points necessary to maintain the base. I don't know what shape the equipment is in, but considering how fragile it is, most of it will probably not be useable.

Summary/Conclusion:
Level +1 should be considered completely lost. We will probably not be able to hold Level 0. We should direct all efforts to preventing the intruders from moving to the lower levels.
Datapads_FE.10_D_Lab_04_c_Content:
Just as I predicted, the plants that had to evolve in the extreme environmental conditions of Arcadia had no problem quickly adapting to the changing atmosphere. The rate at which they adapt is rather astonishing. Sulheart is changing especially fast, which could have something to do with it developing around sulfur deposits, the fumes of which are toxic to most carbon-based compounds.

Sample no. SP-RU-43. It consists of an elongated tuber and hard, stiff leaves.

Chemical analysis reveals that it contains B-group vitamins, vitamins C, A, E, and K, as well as dietary fiber. At the same time, I did not detect any substances potentially toxic or harmful to humans. SP-RU-43 could therefore be a nutritious food source for humans in the Ruptura System.

Recommendations:
1. Conduct an organoleptic test.
2. More detailed observation of how the changing atmospheric composition affects other species.
Datapads_FE.23_D_Cooling_hint_01_c_Content:
Kyle: I know it was you. I'm reporting you to Aiden, enough is enough.
Diego: I don't know what you're writing about.
Kyle: You unsealed it. Again.
Diego: This time it wasn't me.
Kyle: I've had enough. When we announce the tests, don't go into the cooling station. You shouldn't be going in there at all anyway. Now it'll take us a whole day to reset the test.
Diego: Don't be so dramatic.
Kyle: I'm not being dramatic. I'm going to Aiden and he'll block the passage and you'll have to take the hallway like everyone else.
Diego: Come on. I like to cool off, the generator gets very hot. It's like a boiler room in there. :(((
Kyle: I get that, but don't go in there during the tests. It needs to be sealed. Okay?
Diego: Okay. :D
Kyle: You promise?
Diego: On my mother's sleeve.
Kyle: I know what happened to your mother.
Diego: Fine, on my own sleeve.
Kyle: That's better. :)
Datapads_FE.31_D_Forbidden_01_c_Content:
Remember that the possession of files in violation of current law is forbidden. This applies to everyone without exception. Breaking regulation in this difficult time will result in a fine and forced hibernation.

For finding inappropriate files on their private tablets, the following people have already been hibernated:

Buzz Holden - for the book "Credit for a Grandson" by Jacob Jax
Issac Saneer - for the album "Shell Break" by the band Soul Cage and the game "Horrific Adventures of Mr. Natural"
Kyle Rockwood - for the documentary film "Leaving Alaska"
Tiffany Rockwood - for the documentary film "Leaving Alaska"
Bella Porshe - for the full discography of the band Brothers of Venice

This list will continue to be updated. Amnesty is possible if the files are reported personally to anyone in the logistic department.
Datapads_FE.24_D_Cooling_01_c_Content:
Report on the cooling station operating for 1 week.

All systems working according to predictions.
Temperature inside station: 22 C
Coolant temperature: -269 C
Average power consumption: 450 MJ/h
Thermal shields: Undamaged

As predicted, the effect of the coolant intensifies during Ruptura activity. No leaks detected, everything is perfectly fine. Speaking freely, I'll add that thanks to these temperatures we should have a long and safe mission here.
Datapads_FE.25_D_Cooling_02_c_Content:
Report on the cooling station operating for 22 weeks.

Despite warnings test could not be performed
Temperature inside station: UNKNOWN
Coolant temperature: -269 C
Average power consumption: UNKNOWN
Thermal shields: STATUS UNKNOWN

Remember that the station needs to be sealed during the test. I don't know how it got unsealed, but I have my suspicions. Kyle, speak with your friend.
Datapads_FE.21_D_Help_01_c_Content:
TO ALL

Anyone who is able to hold a weapon should report immediately to the generator area. The Vermin cannot reach it, our survival depends on it.

Colonel Bruce Walker
Datapads_FE.09_D_Lab_03_c_Content:
The composition of the Planet's atmosphere does not filter out cosmic radiation as well as does the atmosphere of Earth or even Mars. In fact, the intensity of cosmic radiation appears to be significantly increased due to the specificity of Ruptura's activity.

Surprisingly, the species living here seem to be perfectly suited to such high doses of radiation. As is the case with our own terrestrial organisms, I'm afraid it's not just a matter of being resistant to radiation as such, but rather some unique evolution in these specific conditions. It's highly possible that removing access to the ionizing radiation could irrevocably damage all (or nearly all) life on the planet. I do not wish for our team to be responsible for speciocide on such a scale.

As long as the Engine has not been fully activated, its effect is limited to an area closest to it, a small piece of the ecosystem. This will prevent the risk of speciocide and allow us to better control the effect that decreasing radiation will have on the various species. Furthermore, samples sent to Earth should allow for deeper analysis of the situation.
Datapads_FE.08_D_Lab_02_c_Content:
The following Safe Work rules apply inside the laboratory:
1. Every individual entering the laboratory must log into the logbook and log out upon leaving the laboratory. Lab personnel is required to log every entry and exit.
2. Employees are required to wear protective gear.
3. Employees are required to maintain a clean workstation.
4. Eating is strictly prohibited.
5. Removing reagents and equipment from the laboratory is prohibited.
6. Any destruction, damage, or loss of reagents or equipment must be reported immediately.
7. In the event of contact with a hazardous substance, report to medical personnel immediately.
Datapads_FE.32_D_Expedition_01_c_Content:
The next research expedition of the search team will take place on day 421 of the mission.

The expedition will last four Earth days. The team will consist of five people.

Any requests for samples or research to be carried out should be made directly to Colonel Bruce Walker no later than five days before the expedition. The decision to grant permission for the research will be announced a day before the expedition.

It is still possible to request samples and research to be carried out on the planet's surface. However, we cannot guarantee that the proposed tasks will be performed in the near future and reserve the right to refuse any requests without providing a reason.
Datapads_FE.16_D_Near_control_01_c_Content:
To everyone! Along with the power outage the way to the main control room has been cut off! Don't go in there until the situation has stabilized, we don't want to let any more of those creatures inside. An S.O.S. has been sent to authorities on Earth.

For those working in nearby facilities and outside, I can assure you that, even without the auxiliary generator, the area near the machine remains free of radiation, so people in the field and nearby facilities won't be irradiated. This does not apply to people more than 5 km from the Engine. We recommend you evacuate immediately.

Datapads_L1Base.18_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
Are we in for a MOONopoly?

In light of the recent news that the Moon Energy Corporation has acquired the Liu Mining Company it's only fitting to ask whether this doesn't bring us closer to a monopoly in the space mining market. The lack of a reaction from the IRO is worrying as it seems to ignore the potential threat.

According to our analysis, MEC alone will control up to 86% of the extraterrestrial mining market. In second place is the Claywood Corporation which hardly compares in size to the lunar giant.

Despite our attempts to speak to the IRO, it is not taking any action to review the potential monopoly. Is this negligent or intended behavior? We don't know for sure at this time but, let's be honest, the IRO is not known for being negligent.

I wonder if the company was headed by someone like William Claywood and not a government puppet like Yui Sakamoto whether the IRO would also not investigate it on claims of violating monopoly laws? As always, I'm just asking.
Datapads_L1Base.11_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
Can't find work on Earth? Have you always been fascinated by space? Do you enjoy a challenge?

Join the Liu Mining Company's extraordinary project! We are one of the first space mining companies to set up operations on Arcadia-7. Come with us to conquer the Ruptura System! Gain experience and make unforgettable memories! Earn a good salary while building the future of humanity with us!

We offer:
- financing for disc subscriptions
- one free sleeve per cycle
- compensation for the family in the event of disc damage
- delivery of fresh fruits and vegetables from Earth, once per cycle*
We're looking for ambitious and talented engineers, chemists and people educated in related fields. Prior space mining experience is a plus but not required. We offer training!

*The company is not responsible for any deliveries destroyed by Star Waves. Base personnel must retrieve the package in time.
Datapads_L1Base.17_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Anastasia Ditrich
To: All

I regret to inform you that Dr. Scott Zhao has been found dead by Dr. Harris in area M2. He was ripped apart by the aliens, we were unable to retrieve his disc. Temporary command of the base falls to me. From this point on, please come to me with all organizational matters.

Condolences to us all,
Anastasia Ditrich
Datapads_L1Base.15_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Anastasia Ditrich
To: All

We did it! Our mission has been concluded by the new management of the Liu Mining Company. Evacuation pods will arrive within seven days to take us home. Good work!

We are ceasing all excavation as well as laboratory and technical research.

Due to the frequent issues with the door, entering lab L1 as well tech room T1 is forbidden. Opening them takes up too much time for people who have a lot to do before we wrap up our mission. If the door once again enters lockdown, please open it only when absolutely necessary.

Sincerely,
Anastasia Ditrich
Datapads_L1Base.07_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Camila Dias Silva
To: Liu Mining Company HR Department

Due to the conditions at the sulfur mining base on Arcadia-7 becoming increasingly unsafe, I have decided to resign from my position.
Attached is my signed resignation.

Please process my request quickly,
Dr. Camila Dias Silva

——

From: Liu Mining Company HR Department
To: Camila Dias Silva

Potential dangers are mentioned in your contract so citing an unsafe environment is not enough to terminate your contract by mutual consent. In this situation, contractual penalties come into effect.

Terminating a contract early means you either need to return your sleeve (the body you are currently using has been paid for by the Liu Mining Company) or its cost. You also need to return the sleeve being used by your daughter which was partially paid for by our company.

Additionally, you will have to organize and pay for your transport from the Ruptura System back to Earth.

Because we care about the well-being our employees, we will give you some additional time to think over your decision.

Sincerely,
Liu Mining Company
Datapads_L1Base.21_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Hannah Cheng
To: Scott Zhao

Today ends with a sixth ton of sulfur excavated. If we keep this up, we'll fill up all of the storage space within a month. Provided they won't collapse due to another explosion. There was another one today. It was small, but even a pebble can cause an avalanche. I'm reiterating my request to cease all mining activity until the new equipment is introduced.


——

From: Scott Zhao
To: Hannah Cheng

Of course, it's becoming too frequent. Plans for the improved equipment should arrive tomorrow around noon standard time. Take some time off until then, tell the others. Everything is coming along nicely, no need to overextend ourselves. This time tomorrow I'll send out Prestwood to survey the terrain. I'm worried about the stability. We might have to move the entire base.
Datapads_L1Base.04_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Learn the truth
To: multiple recipients

You think the ruptura system exists because you saw videos… what if it was a deep fake?... You've heard about the people who worked there maybe even died??? how do you know what REALLY happened to those people
IRO showed its hand in 2143 what happened then what did they try to hide under the ""cosmic secret""? Then they turned it off... now they're pretending they're sending another mission!!! what are they trying to HIDE???
Learn the truth, click the link: [This page does not exist]. The IRO fabricated a fake event so that you'd keep looking at the sky instead of down here on Earth not seeing what is happening to YOU.
Learn the TRUTH!!!!
Datapads_L1Base.01_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Liu Mining Company
To: Scott Zhao

Good morning.

In accordance with guidelines, we're sending you the coordinates of planned local excavation areas. Details can be found in the attachment.

Best regards,
Liu Mining Company
Datapads_L1Base.14_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Liu Mining Company
To: Scott Zhao, Anastasia Ditrich

We regret to inform you that, due to a restructuring of the company and re-arranging of projects, we have decided to shut down your project. This decision is dictated solely by budgetary concerns, we are extremely pleased with your progress and will gladly work with you in the future.

The first two evacuation pods will be delivered in 5 days (Earth time) so please indicate three people who will be evacuated first. Severance payments will be transferred to your accounts once you return to Earth.

The management of both the Liu Mining Company and the Moon Energy Corporation thanks you for your sacrifice.

——

From: Scott Zhao
To: Liu Mining company, Anastasia Ditrich

When can we expect the second evacuation?

——

From: Liu Mining Company
To: Scott Zhao, Anastasia Ditrich

Unfortunately, we cannot predict the schedule at this time, but we can promise you the next evacuation will happen in the near future.

——

From: Scott Zhao
To: Liu Mining company, Anastasia Ditrich

What exactly do you mean by "the near future"?

——

From: Liu Mining Company
To: Scott Zhao, Anastasia Ditrich

We cannot provide that information at this time.

——

From: Scott Zhao
To: Liu Mining company, Anastasia Ditrich

In that case, until we learn the schedule for the full evacuation, I am unable to indicate three people that I can send home. I will wait for the full evacuation plan.
Datapads_L1Base.02_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Moon University
To: Camila Dias Silva

Dear Dr. Silva,

I've had the opportunity to read your article on the stability of the Rift in the 3/2152 issue of Science & Technology and I was very impressed by your acuity. I wanted to ask whether you wouldn't be interested in visiting the Lunar University once you complete your mission in the Ruptura System?

A lecture on your most recent discoveries would be highly beneficial to our students.

We are also constantly in search of new teaching staff. I'm sure you have already received many other job offers but please also take into consideration our new but quickly growing university.

Prof. Leo Khan
Rector, Lunar University
Datapads_L1Base.05_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Scott Zhao
To: All

To answer the frequent questions: Due to the instability of the terrain, tremors can trigger a lockdown on the laboratory door. Your standard access cards are not able to lift the lockdown. In order to unlock the door to the lab and/or the technical room, you need to go to someone higher up.

Aside from my own card, the cards of Dr. Miyamoto, Dr. Prestwood and Dr. Harris have the necessary access level. If, for some reason, I will not be able to unlock the door, you need to go to one of these three people and ask them to unlock the door. The Logistics Department knows their current assignment, you can write to them or go directly to building D1 (above my office).

Please don't bother them unless it's a real emergency when getting into the laboratory is absolutely CRUCIAL. Please also remember that it can be opened from the inside even if the alarm is on. We're working on fixing this but we don't know how long it will take.

On behalf of the entire Liu Mining Company I apologize for any inconvenience.
Datapads_L1Base.09_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Scott Zhao
To: Liu Mining Company

The canyon that, at first, seemed to be a safe place to set up the base turned out to not be that at all. The ground has shifted resulting in a module being destroyed and, what's worse, the True Death of one of the workers, Okito Miyamoto. This event has very negatively impacted the morale of people at the base. We all knew the risks, but it's one thing to read about it in the contract and something else entirely to experience it personally. Some of my subordinates don't even remember the time when people actually died. They never encountered this before!

I would like to file a request to move the base to more stable ground. We will continue to mine sulfur from the canyon, I'm not suggesting we abandon such a rich deposit! However, I would like my people to be able to sleep and carry out research in a safe environment.

I urge you to make a quick decision here before another tragedy strikes.

Scott Zhao

——

From: Liu Mining Company
To: Scott Zhao

Please refrain from any actions in this matter until we conduct analysis on the impact of relocating the base on the potential decrease in mining efficiency. Our experts are already working on it. In the meantime, please direct Dr. Xavier Prestwood to study the stability of the crater walls.

Best regards,
Liu Mining Company
Datapads_L1Base.22_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
From: Xavier Prestwood
To: Scott Zhao

The terrain under the base is full off air pockets, in other words, underground holes. They were most likely created by the regular and sudden expansion of underground water following Ruptura's waves. The hydrogen sulfide released during mining is not only toxic when inhaled, it is also flammable. Sparks produced by the extractors can cause small underground explosions that affect the stability of the terrain.

The holes are so packed with hydrogen sulfide that it is replenished almost instantly even after its sudden oxidation and disintegration during a Fire Wave. As such, the terrain always remains toxic, but that is not our biggest concern.

Aside from the threat to the stability of our entire infrastructure, these small explosions can trigger safeguards in our most critical rooms. I understand that we can't stop mining but I would suggest replacing, if possible, the extractor with a better model or, better yet, relocating the entire base.

The accumulation of the gas inside the terrain can also cause too much of the gas to be released into the lower parts of the canyon. It is highly toxic and our masks don't meet the necessary safety standards. After speaking with Mark, I know that we don't have enough biofilament to not be concerned by the deaths of the crew.

I will soon send a detailed report.
Datapads_L1Base.19_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
I'm starting to feel progressively worse. My hypothesis that the hydrogen sulfide vapors block the spreading of the toxin contained in the serpent roots may not be as optimistic as I thought.

That doesn't change the fact that consuming the roots when I was separated from the sulfur killed me a lot sooner. This time, during the controlled inhalation of the hydrogen sulfide while consuming the serpent roots, the symptoms were so delayed that I incorrectly assumed I was immune to the toxin. The headaches are becoming unbearable, I will need a new sleeve soon, I hope I will get it when I'm already back on Earth.
Datapads_L1Base.03_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
Mining sulfur on Arcadia turned out to be not as bad as I had expected. Sure, the conditions are difficult - the Fire Waves are the worst. You never know if the construction will hold, the walls creak… but I still prefer this to mining minerals in the planetoid belt. I still need to wear a spacesuit to walk on the planet but at least I'm not surrounded by the emptiness of space.

And I'll have so much to tell when I get back to Earth! I wonder how many chicks will fall for the tale of how I conquered a foreign solar system?
Datapads_L1Base.08_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
Name of deceased: Okito Miyamoto

Cause of sleeve death: the sleeve was crushed to death by residential module A1 when it fell into the canyon along with rock debris.

Cause of disc damage: despite a quick rescue effort, it was not possible to retrieve the disc before the next Fire Wave. Commander Zhao ordered the rescuers to return to base. The disc was damaged by high temperatures and recovering its consciousness is not possible. The personal effects of Dr. Miyamoto have been moved into the module.

Summary: mechanic Okito Miyamoto has experienced True Death. The damaged disc is unusable.
Datapads_L1Base.10_D_LargeBase1_c_Content:
Scott Zhao — Office D1
Xavier Prestwood — Technical supervision in storage T2
Harry Harris — Botanical laboratory L2
Hannah Cheng — Mining in area M2
Mark Porter — Clone center C1
Dan Waltz — Mining in area M1
Camila Dias Silva — Mining in area M2
Anastasia Ditrich — Office L2

Okito Miyamoto — relieved of duty

Datapads_L2base.02_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
From: Clever Robotics
To: Blake Richardson

We still haven't received any information on what's going on with FHS. Don't forget why you're here.

Clever Robotics Crisis Department

From: Blake Richardson
To: Clever Robotics

I've managed to get into the research results. I'm not an expert but I think this information is important.

Blake Richardson

From: Clever Robotics
To: Blake Richardson

You're not here to analyze. We`ll take a look.
Datapads_L2base.12_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
From: Clever Robotics
To: Blake Richardson

Attached is a virus. Put it into the system. No one who knows about Dr. Diaz`s research can survive. An evacuation transport will arrive in two days. The virus will activate in three days. All formalities with FHS have been taken care of, your hands will be clean.

Thank you for your dedication. The additional credits granted to you will fully cover the cost of your son`s sleeve. They will be transferred to your account as soon as you begin your evacuation.

Clever Robotics - Crisis Intervention Department
Datapads_L2base.08_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
From: Future Health Solutions
To: All

Welcome and congratulations!

You were chosen for this mission because you are the best at what you do! We hope that your trip was uneventful and your time spent on the planet will not only be an exciting adventure but, more importantly, a productive time. Productive for all of humanity.

Of course, the planet is not a safe one, you need to be careful, but your colleagues from Clever Robotics have prepared a wonderful research base, both safe and easy to use. Some of them will stay with you on the planet while you conduct your research. Contact them directly in case of any technical issues. Of course, remember that despite the friendship between our companies, the NDA also applies in their case, so no gossiping about the research ;))

Go discover! And live and breathe science!

Future Health Solutions HR Department
Datapads_L2base.04_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
From: Quinn Ellis
To: All

The regenerative capabilities of the Bloodfern are incredible. If broken off (a difficult feat in itself), it immediately falls apart and a new version quickly grows back in its place. The only thing that slows down its growth is being burned by Ruptura. This makes research difficult because it's hard to isolate a sample, but if we could get a genetic sample and isolate the growth genes while eliminating the decomposition defense mechanism we could find a cure for the world's food problems and break the monopoly of Claywood Algae Farms.

But that's far in the future, we have months of research ahead of us. For now, everything that we learn about the Bloodfern is highly classified and leaking any information to our "colleagues" at Clever is forbidden. Contact them only in technical matters.

Good luck,
Quinn Ellis
Datapads_L2base.09_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
From: Ramon Dias
To: Future Health Solutions - Research Department

We have a breakthrough! All research indicates that we were able to isolate the gene responsible for the Bloodfern's growth. Scientific hypothesis: these plants accumulate energy from Ruptura and use it to expediate their growth. After injecting the gene pool into wheat seeds, we were able to cultivate a strain that entered its mature stage in two hours. They are easy to cultivate, on Earth they might not even need greenhouses. Maybe I'm getting ahead of myself, but I can already see red fields scattered all over the world. I took the liberty of starting a scientific article.

Hugs,
Ramon

From: Future Health Solutions - Research Department
To: Ramon Dias

We are very pleased, I would advise opening a bottle of champagne, but that could be difficult for obvious reasons (just don't try to distill the Bloodfern). We await further research, keep sending us your work, we will gladly review it. Send us samples. It looks like you will soon return to Earth as heroes!

Congratulations,
Future Health Solutions - Research Department
Datapads_L2base.05_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
REMEMBER!
NEVER LET GO OF THE ZIPLINE DURING TRANSIT!

Our experts at Clever Robotics have created an optimal and safe connection. After grabbing the line hold on to it until the energy field takes you to another safe place devoid of the Bloodfern.

Remember that death in an overgrown area makes retrieving a disc difficult which, in turn, causes work delays.

SAFETY ABOVE ALL
Datapads_L2base.06_D_LargeBase2_c_Content:
Attention, a change in procedure:
The doors should always stay open.
If they are closed, contact Dr. Quinn Ellis (FHS), Dr. Ramon Dias (FHS) or Eng. Dellaney Perkins (CR).

Datapads_MediumBases.002_1_D_MediumBase_p_Content:
From: Carlos Miller
To: William Claywood

The rich deposits of Wolfram found on the planet, though undoubtedly impressive, are not an anomaly - the anomaly is a complete lack of copper. I reviewed the results of the spectrograph before the mission, so I did not expect to find any abundant deposits, but the soil research is astounding. We're not detecting even faint traces of copper in the soil. With this type of planet it's an anomaly on the scale of the known Universe.

I'm at a loss, Mr. Claywood. I can't explain this. I have also not found any traces of gold or silver. The only significant aspect that I can think of that these elements have in common is their high conductivity.

This makes Wolfram the best candidate for mass producing electronic equipment. It's not ideal, but we need to adapt. We've put together the machines and are sending everything to the Selenian Corporation, I will keep you updated on the mission's progress.

Respectfully,
Carlos Miller
Datapads_MediumBases.001_4_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Officer Boris Tilton
To: Selenian Corporation

Greetings.

I am submitting a formal notification regarding the death of mission leader Drew Forrest. Drew Forrest left the base along with E0017 in order to locate new potential deposits of Helium-3. According to E0017's testimony, they were attacked by the local fauna. E0017 managed to survive the attack with serious damage to her sleeve. She also brought with her Drew Forrest's deceased sleeve.

After analyzing Forrest's disc it was deemed no longer useable. The damage unequivocally points to an animal attack.

E0017 received a new sleeve.
Officer Boris Tilton


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: Officer Boris Tilton

Thank you for the information. We are sorry to learn of this. We are happy to let you know that, for the duration of the investigation, you are now to assume the position of expedition leader.

Due to E0017's new sleeve, her debt has increased to 139,856 UC.

Please remember that our correspondence remains highly classified.

Good luck!
The Selenian Corporation
Datapads_MediumBases.001_5_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Officer Boris Tilton
To: Selenian Corporation

Greetings.

Once again I have bad news. Our engineer E0017 has disappeared. We have had no contact with her for the past three cycles. I sent out a search party but they were unable to find her.

I'm also worried about the technical state of the base and its safety. As head of security, I don't know how I can ensure the safety of the base without the regular maintenance of its equipment and protective cloak. Please send new crew members.

As for E0017, I personally don't believe this was an escape, the convict's behavior was excellent.

Officer Boris Tilton


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: Officer Boris Tilton

Greetings!

Unfortunately, the planned budget for the mission won't allow for additional people to be sent. You need to find a way to manage.

As for E0017, the convict's behavior makes no difference here. Until she is found, she should be treated as a fugitive, keep that in mind. This also means her debt has increased to 183,678 UC. If she is not found within the next fourteen cycles, we will be forced to consider her truly dead and transfer her remaining debt to the closest living relative. Please keep us informed.

Good luck!
The Selenian Corporation
Datapads_MediumBases.001_1_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Selenian Corporation
To: Officer Boris Tilton

Thank you for agreeing to participate in our experimental rehabilitation program!

As per our guidelines, I am sending you the convict's details. All of the information below is highly classified under the penalty of a hefty fine. Needless to say, this confidentiality applies regarding the other crew members as well.

Number: E0017
Name: Lilianne Ward
Scientific degree: Low Temperature Engineer, Jennifer Doudna University, 2105

Experience:
Liu Mining Company - Junior Technician (2105-2107)
Moon Energy Corporation - Senior Technician (2107-2113)
Moon Energy Corporation - Mining Team Manager, Moon Colony Luna-4 (2113-2128)
Mandatory rehabilitation work at Luna-6 - Junior Digger (2128-present)

Sentence:
Sentenced to pay a fine of 150,000 UC for illegally giving birth to a male child. Sent to the Luna-6 base for rehabilitation work after being unable to pay the fine. The fine continued to increase due to an excessive use of sleeves and insubordination.
Does not pose a threat. Exemplary behavior in recent years.
Due to the experimental nature of the program, the convict is required to keep a journal.
Amount left to be worked off: 127,856 UC.

We hope your cooperation is fruitful!
The Selenian Corporation
Datapads_MediumBases.002_4_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: William Claywood
To: Carlos Miller

Good day,

I'm writing to your private communicator because our main line of contact is no longer secure. Everything indicates that Taylor has gone through your computer and knows that we have been in contact. He has already notified the Selenian Corp. about it. So this is my last message to you. Please delete all traces of our conversations. This also means our agreement is void and you will not receive compensation.

It was nice knowing you,
William Claywood
Datapads_MediumBases.001_2_D_MediumBase_p_Content:
Harvey Summers: That new girl is weird, she just asked me what the fine was for swearing.

Cormac Hansen: Huh? What fine?

Harvey Summers: They must've had some weird rules at the penal colony. I don't like this.

Cormac Hansen: Yeah, I heard she murdered someone. And I mean murdered-murdered, destroyed his disc.

Harvey Summers: From what Chris told me, she apparently carried out some terrorist attack. But Ada says she was convicted of robbery. The only thing we know for sure is there's something off about her. We should get a bonus for dangerous working conditions.

Cormac Hansen: Yeah, and a Christmas Bonus and a vacation to Bali. Just be on your guard and keep an eye on her. As if we didn't have enough problems with the aliens.
Datapads_MediumBases.001_3_D_MediumBase_p_Content:
I was supposed to be honest, so I'll be honest. It pisses me off that the others are making normal money here and bragging about what they're gonna buy when they get back to Earth! Bragging how many spare sleeves they'll have… and I'm never gonna see the money I'm making! Everything goes towards paying off my fine... Good news is I'm making more here than I would've if they had sent me to dig holes somewhere in Alaska. Though I don't know if it's worth the looks I'm getting from my co-workers. At least at the penal colony everyone was equal.

Chapter 14 - The bizarre delicacies of the preiroid era

[…] Let's be honest. You're reading this chapter not because of the rightfully by-gone rotten eggs and pickled herring, you're all waiting for the really controversial topics. Yes, before the IRO, it would happen that people would eat... people.

I will stress right at the start that this was not a widespread practice, eating human meat was not popular in any nation's cuisine, it happened almost always in extreme situations or as part of a ritual.

In the past, people were not able to print sleeves, losing one's body resulted in the True Death of the individual, so people became irrationally attached to bodies, often seeing the meat as the person they had feelings for. This created one of the strongest moral taboos connected with eating humans. It also made sense from an evolutionary standpoint. Eating members of one's own species did not provide any advantages in the Darwinian race.

Among the dangers of eating human meat are:
- Prion diseases (including Kuru)
- Autoimmune diseases
- Viral diseases
- Social exclusion
- Severe psychological trauma
- Many others

Of course, nowadays the taboo remains, though the biological dangers could be easily circumvented. Once again, our motto applies here - history is always relevant. The biofilament we use today to create sleeves was invented at a time when cannibalism was a huge social taboo, so each of our sleeves contains patented compounds that prevent the consumption of tissue printed in the Regeneration Chambers in quantities larger than simply biting one's nails. And so we're left to enjoy delicious synthetic animal meat. [...]
Datapads_MediumbasesContentUpdate_1.006_1_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
Chapter 8

[…] Despite the enormous amount of money he had to be making as the director of a large company, the apartment John (name changed) lived in was not luxurious. About 20 square meters, empty shelves, and the mattress of his small twin bed probably remembers pre-colonization days. This was an extraordinarily frugal individual, maybe even miserly. He's the first person with a positive account balance that has agreed to an interview, he also has the worst apartment.

He treats me to some algae tea, I thank him smiling but don't drink it. The smell alone makes my stomach churn. Is this what life without debt smells like?

- What would you like to know? How much I've spent exactly? - He begins the conversation with a smile. He's trying to be funny, but his smile stinks worse than my tea.

- I don't need such details. Please just tell me your story.

- Nineteen years. That's what I really paid. - Tha answer seems rehearsed. - If we had gotten permission right away, my son would've been an adult by now.

John isn't an isolated case. The belief in some circles that childbirth permission is granted to those well-off is also not true. The IRO throws everyone into the shackles of bureaucracy, regardless of how much they make. Only the elite can have offspring, and the elite are not directors like John, they're not even company owners. The only condition for receiving permission, it seems, is to be on Meera Singh's good side. What did John do to be denied his right to a son after nineteen years of fighting bureaucracy? That's what I'm trying to find out, but I know that I may never get an answer. Maybe John doesn't know himself. [...]

Chapter 2

[…] For these reasons, the colonization of extraterrestrial territories was practically impossible for people in the 20th century and the first half of the 21st century. Let us now take a look at how the great leap forward at the turn of the century allowed us to overcome each of these obstacles standing in the way of colonizing extraterrestrial objects.

- The cost of transporting objects - This problem persisted the longest. Despite the introduction of the UC across the entire globe, which facilitated global trade, and advancements in rocket technology, this remained an obstacle. Only Pocket technology discovered by the Claywood Corporation allowed for the transfer of cargo into the spatial subdimension which made transporting cargo beyond orbit significantly easier.

- Issues with the human body adapting - Sleeves and discs allow us to not worry about how numerous years spent on Mars will affect our skeletal system. The ability to adapt a sleeve to the conditions that exist on a given planet allows the body to adapt to any gravity. And returning from the stars to Alma Mater has never been easier - you simply print out a body adapted to the conditions on Earth without worrying about details like muscle atrophy.

- Problems with growing food - Algae by Claywood Algae Farms did not only eradicate hunger worldwide, the ease with which they're grown has eradicated hunger in the universe. Next time your parents won't buy you anything good and you're forced to eat an algae bar, remember that the first heroic colonists on the Moon and Mars were also eating them!

- Problems with land ownership - After doing away with the outdated concept of nations and the IRO embracing us with protection, there are no more land disputes. Every celestial body a human sets foot on is the property of the same organization. Threats of war and international law disputes are irreversibly a thing of the past. [...]

From: Harry Harris
To: Liu Mining Company

The microorganisms within the Hydrobulb feed on the toxic substances found in bodies of water, which means the water in the pocket-like fruit is filtered, and because of the minerals left in the liquid, I am very certain that the water found in the fruit is suitable for drinking. After my observations, I even tried one of the fruits and I'm relieved to say that nothing bad happened. It's also quite tasty.

As expected, the microorganisms within the Hydrobulb are protected by its structure. Exposed directly to a Fire Wave, they die and cannot regenerate. It seems that the Hydrobulb's ability to instantly regenerate, which is typical for the local flora, protects the microorganisms which would not be able to survive without it.

Hydrobulbs deprived of their microorganisms, while able to survive both waves of fire and cold in their natural environment, eventually wither from the toxins within three cycles. This is a case, then, of ideal symbiosis, and at this stage I have no idea how these organisms could have evolved to be so dependent on each other in the conditions of such an unstable star. But I leave this matter to experts in evolutionary biology.

I've taken enough samples to continue further studies in the comfort of my laboratory. I'm returning to the main base. The full report is attached.

P.S. I allowed myself a little hubris in the report and called the microorganisms Sarcina Harrisum. If no one has any objections I will apply for the bacteria to be officially classified as such.

Robertson&Robertson Law Firm. Low prices! Call or write today. Our specialists are waiting for you.

Robertson&Robertson Law Firm. We've been reducing your debt since 2110!
Datapads_SmallBases.016_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:

To: All

Congratulations! Exactly a year has passed and we are so happy with your results that as a bonus we are deducting 20,000 UC from every crew member's debt!

Secure the equipment for the next crew and then enjoy some vacation time once you get back. The rescue team will arrive with capsules tomorrow at noon Earth time.

We are proud of you.

See you soon!
The Selenian Corporation


—


From: E1305
To: Selenian Corporation

Unfortunately, the capsule has not arrived on time. Can you tell me how long the delay will be?
NOT SENT
Datapads_SmallBases.011_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Sergeant Atticus Crown
To: Griffits Blue Testing Department

Test 12.06c ended in failure. The aliens are unaffected by the substance. Dosage increased six times did not change their behavior. The substance did not decrease or increase their combat prowess. I am no biologist, but I suspect their protein structure could be entirely different from ours. In order to carry out more testing, I will need access to the results of other research from allied bases.

Corporal Dreyfus and I are starting to feel the effects of being in the proximity of the substance. I have started to cough up blood and get light-headed, while the corporal's mental state leaves a lot to be desired. If possible, we ask for an escort to the closest Regeneration Chamber in order to acquire new sleeves.

Sergeant Atticus Crown
Datapads_SmallBases.017_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Violetta Khan
To: Lorella Zurli

Hey!
I'm finally at the base and everything here is so fascinating! Dangerous, alien, but fascinating. I want to tell you EVERYTHING but you know how it is. I can't divulge any details. I can't even tell you if I was able to find anything or not. It's so frustrating!
Tell me how you are. How's work?


—


From: Lorella Zurli
To: Violetta Khan

Hey,

I'm happy for you, but I'm also a little jealous. The company cut my budget, they might axe my department completely. Everyone wans to invest in the Ruptura System now. Ruptura, Ruptura! They don't talk about anything else. It's so stupid. They haven't even fully explored Mars yet and now they're off to a completely alien galaxy. It's so short-sighted.

So it's possible I will soon have to find a new line of work.


—


From: Violetta Khan
To: Lorella Zurli

I'm sorry to hear that. Can I help you somehow? Maybe you'd like to work with me? I could mention you to the right people. It'd be great to see you! And have some company :(


—


From: Lorella Zurli
To: Violetta Khan

No offense, but I think the idea of working there is completely crazy. I'm not going to risk my life - not just my sleeve but my actual life! - for some stupid corporation that doesn't even respect my work anyway. I'd rather pack my bags and go back to Earth.
Datapads_SmallBases.023_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Wentworth Connelly
To: Jules Dawn

Hey!

I was looking through the paperwork on facilities currently on Arcadia and I noticed (you won't believe it) that you're on the list. What's up? We haven't seen each other in quite a few years. I'm so happy you've decided to make some extra money and came all the way out here. I really hope you'll make enough to return the 60,000 UC you owe your friend.

You know what's interesting about our Engine? It releases atmospheric compounds with such precision that I could change the composition of the atmosphere in one small area and then flood it with ionizing cosmic radiation. Of course, we're not allowed to do that, there's high probability that a person could be in that area and we'd destroy their sleeve, maybe even their disc too. But if I did want to have some fun, I have this one hypothetical area, I've attached its coordinates along with my bank account number.

We should meet up.

Hugs,
Wentworth Connelly
Datapads_SmallBases.020_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Zed Gator
To: Jaden Terrence

All this time I have tried to be a level-headed and understanding leader. I didn't punish you for eating too many supplies, I didn't say anything about the prank with turning off the solar panel, or when Bob forgot to take a sample, but everything has its limits.
The entire habitat is starting to crack. Jaden, I heard you were a geologist, I was wondering why the hell we'd need a geologist but I didn't say anything hoping at least the geological aspect would be taken care of. This rock is BREAKING APART. Just being here seems dangerous. I demand a detailed report on the rock structure on my tablet by tomorrow. And if the habitat falls apart, you can BE SURE that we will fine you. For the full amount.

No regards,
Zed Gator


—


From: Jaden Terrence
To: Zed Gator

There's no problem, stop panicking. The habitat is stable. It's normal that the rocks are moving apart slightly, considering what's happening with the star. If you kept getting hot and cold like that you'd fall apart too, but I'm sure the habitat's structure will keep the rock in place. Relax.

Best Regards,
Dr. Jaden Terrence, Geologist
Datapads_SmallBases.005_2_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
I've landed on Arcadia-7. The Church of Immortality considers this planet holy. Here, its adherents are supposed to pass the trial and achieve true immortality, whatever that means… Maybe they're just greedy. Discs are not enough for them.
I'm surveying the planet. It seems perfectly normal and strange at the same time. I'm looking for signs. I don't believe in the trial. I don't want to go into the fire. And yet something is telling me to look for answers. Do aliens really exist? Is life one big test? I hope that some things will become clearer during this mission.

Datapads_SmallBases.028_3_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
Researcher: Dr. Beatrice Laskowski
Test subject: Lt. Harold Weir
Comparison subject: Cpl. Louis Weir

Ask for reinforcements, URGENT.
Louis is dead, Harold is seriously wounded - further testing if it's because of the L.E.M.
Louis's disc destroyed when he fell - tell Harold when he's better.
They damaged the Regeneration Chamber, repairs will take some time.
Harold is unable to fight. Moved to the chamber room.
We'll really die here if they come again.
Suspend testing - don't provoke them anymore.
Datapads_SmallBases.028_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
Researcher: Dr. Beatrice Laskowski
Test subject: Lt. Harold Weir
Comparison subject: Cpl. Louis Weir

Despite the general fatigue that all of us are suffering from, the Lieutenant appears to be functioning somewhat better than the other crew members.
Maximum blood pressure during exercise testing does not exceed 170/60.
Reduced telomere wear was also observed when compared to the test subject.

Conclusions:
The L.E.M. performs its function of generally improving vitality as expected. The conditions on Arcadia-7 and bombardment by Star Ruptures do not affect its functionality.
It is my expert opinion to allow the Limbic Enhancement Membranes to be tested in combat conditions in the Ruptura System.
Datapads_SmallBases.028_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
Researcher: Dr. Beatrice Laskowski
Test subject: Lt. Harold Weir
Comparison subject: Cpl. Louis Weir

From among the expected side effects of L.E.M. implementation

None of the subjects experienced:
Dizziness.
Shortness of breath.
Color blindness.
Selective deafness.
Increased libido.
Diarrhea lasting more than 48 hours.
Stroke.
Sudden cardiac arrest.
Left-handedness (or right-handedness in the case of left-handed individuals).

Both subjects experienced:
Trouble sleeping.
Decreased libido.
Enlarged gallbladder.

Datapads_SmallBases.012_3_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
Verdict in the case of the attack on Deputy Commissioner Tsunoda
Three men, who two years ago attacked a member of the Science and Innovation Commission, Kenji Tsunoda, were today found guilty of carrying out a terrorist attack. They are facing a life sentence. It's possible, however, that Judge Cannone will invoke a recently passed new law.
After the death penalty was abolished, a new type of punishment was introduced where the perpetrator's disc is removed from their body and placed in a prison safe never to be put into a sleeve again. Opponents of the new law claim it is cruel and a human rights violation. They are planning to protest in front of the courthouse. Deputy Commissioner Tsunoda's sleeve was destroyed during the attack but his disc was retrieved by the anti-terrorist squad. After being placed into a new sleeve, Tsunoda continues to serve on the Commission.

Datapads_SmallBases.026_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
[…] Our "immortality" is not real immortality. The only thing we've accomplished is to increase our longevity, it's no different from the constant advancements in medicine. "The End of the Soul" proposed by Damish is far from the truth. People remain mortal so long as discs remain in the material world. What makes a disc different from the body? What is the difference between a sleeve and a pacemaker or an organ transplant?

Until we are able to transfer consciousness into the simplest form of ones and zeros, Homo Sapiens will not become the immortal Homo Deus. We can still only find eternal life in God, because only He is able to give it to us. Today's world has become poisoned by temptation and discs are a curse. They prolong life but do not improve its quality, they make us forget what's important, we succumb to pride and hypocrisy, thinking we will have time to fix everything. We don't realize that we can still end, that discs can be destroyed, that our consciousness will depart this world.

We have been deprived of the mercy of witnessing the death of our loved ones. We don't feel the breath of the Grim Reaper on our backs, but it's there. Constantly watching and waiting for a mistake, a misstep, an accident when we're all alone and there'll be no one to move us to a new sleeve. Beware the false belief in immortality. Beware of being too prideful, as that is what caused Lucifer's downfall. [...]
