Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.014_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
A powerful earthquake has devastated southeastern Europe.
The earthquake, measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale, has damaged buildings and infrastructure. A flood followed the earthquake carrying away people who took shelter at aid stations. At this time, 32 people have been confirmed dead, with thousands still missing.

IRO representatives who arrived at the scene spoke optimistically about the situation. "In the past, we would not have been able to save so many people. Today, we can place their discs in new sleeves. I assure you that rescue efforts will not cease until we have retrieved every disc from underneath the debris and from the bottom of the river" said Yusuf Kaya, Special Commander of the Crisis Center. "All victims will receive a new body and a newly rebuilt home."

Those affected are thanking the responders for their help. Dorina Toma is grateful that her daughter, Elena, was rescued: "They found her body far outside the city. The water must have carried her there. One soldier personally cut out her disc and handed it to me. I was so overcome with joy that I forgot to ask his name. Thank you, whoever you are."
Mrs. Toma is hopeful her husband's disc can also be found. Much like thousands of residents in the affected region who were separated from their loved ones by the disaster.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.009_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
Chapter 4

[…] I didn't eat my algae today on purpose, just so that I could stuff my face here. I couldn't get over the delicacies in the menu. They had real pork! My mouth filled with saliva. My hunger almost made me forget I was angry at Eduardo. I looked at my communicator. Zero messages. Over an hour late. When the irritated waiter started walking my way for the fourth time, a man sat down at my table.
- I'm sorry, this is taken - I spoke up shyly.
He looked into my eyes angrily and I immediately felt the same chills that I felt last night. I had no doubt.
- Edie? - I asked.
- Eduardo - he corrected me.
- Did you change your body?
He didn't answer, instead he waved the waiter over. I got used to his previous sleeve, I fantasized about it, but there was something intriguing about this new one. Is he going to keep changing like this every day? Every... night? I blushed just thinking about it.
- We'll take two pheasants please - he said to the waiter.
- Actually, I'd rather... - I stopped, silenced by Eduardo's glare.
- Two pheasants - he repeated. He was so manly. Is he the same in bed? [...]
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.00X2_X2_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
Chapter XXIII: Two Heads Are Better Than One

The discovery that discs contain the bearer's consciousness almost immediately gave scientists the idea to duplicate consciousness and place it in two different bodies at once. It took several years for people to understand how discs store data but finally they were able to convert the process into the language of 1s and 0s. Consciousness information takes up about three petabytes of data (it may seem like a lot, but when we're talking about duplicating great minds, it's surprisingly not that much). It quickly became apparent, however, that copying the contents of a disc and activating it in two bodies at once were two completely different things.


There can be only one

Activating the copied disc in body B, while the original version was still in body A, caused an immediate erasure of the disc in the previous body. Immediate. This effect occurs regardless of the speed of light or distance, which led to the quick and trivial conclusion that it is connected to the strong force and quantum states. As to the cause of this effect, however, there has been no scientific consensus.

Emmet Conway proposed an interesting hypothesis. As long as the consciousness remains "sleeping" on the disc, it is in superposition with the active consciousness. Awakening the new consciousness collapses the wave function responsible for the quantum state of the given individual. To put it in simpler terms: the universe "chooses" which person will exist. Interestingly, contrary to the Mach-Zehnder experiment where the particle "randomly" chooses one of its states when observed, when the second disc is activated, consciousness appears in the new body 100% of the time.

Experiments performed by Conway in hermetically sealed isolation did not change the end result. The volunteer's new body was locked in a chamber isolated with Bose-Einstein condensate and the disc was activated at a random moment. Activating the disc inside the chamber always caused the disc outside of it to be deactivated. Due to the lack of any other observers, the conclusion is obvious that the awakened individual becomes their own observer. Of course, Conway received a Nobel Prize for his research, though the only thing he confirmed was that duplicating consciousness is currently impossible.

The quantum information hidden on the discs indicates a deeper understanding of quantum physics, and so the Universe, by their creators, which could be cause for alarm and is one of the main arguments against this technology. How can we freely use something we won't fully understand for a long time to come?(...)
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.00X2_X_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
Chapter XXIII: Two Heads Are Better Than One

(…)
What about the theory of relativity?

Despite the immediate activation of the copied consciousness, the speed of light remains the limit for sending information. The activated consciousness remembers its life and events only up to the moment when the disc data was copied. It is impossible to instantly transfer the knowledge of an individual across a great distance, the information needs to be sent to the disc using conventional methods.

In the early years, there were experiments to send a consciousness to a base on the Moon by activating a body previously sent there, but ultimately the "new person" would wake up remembering only events up until the moment the copy was sent. This allows for many processes to be streamlined, but we had to wait until the discovery of the Rift before we could send people to other galaxies.

Another problem is the speed at which we can send so much data. The size of three petabytes to which we were able to compress consciousness without data loss is still too large to be smoothly transferred to another receiver in a short amount of time. What's more, the very process of copying consciousness data requires a lot of energy and it takes around a week, which means the person being copied needs to be put into a pharmacologically-induced coma for a similar amount of time.

Until any of these processes can be sped up, the only worthwhile option is to physically transfer the disc to a new sleeve. Nearly all scientific disciplines need to work closely together to figure out a way to freely send consciousness between sleeves - this is one of the main problems we are currently facing as a species. Whoever is able to solve it will become very wealthy.


Pseudoscience

There is a multitude of ignorant individuals, both on the net and in universities, who believe that our inability to duplicate consciousness proves the multiverse theory. According to them, the new consciousness would have to be brought over from a parallel universe. Even if this was true, there is no hypothesis how this knowledge could even be used. The allocation of resources to this kind of research only shows the incompetence of institutions that allocate budgets. We should focus on what we can practically use the discs for to advance humanity, not on purely philosophical and mathematical musings.

Various religious leaders form another crazy group. Walter Goodworth, for example, preaches that the problem with duplicating consciousness proves the existence of a indivisible soul. That is an absurd concept - the idea of a soul was abolished in the 20th century. Soon he'll be claiming that the quantum data of a consciousness weighs 21 grams. (...)

Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.00X4_X_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
From: Aldouble
To: Kevin Burback

Had enough boring conversations? No one is able to provide you with an intellectually stimulating discussion? That is now over!

Having analyzed the data from all available historical documents and "feeding" them into language models, the engineers at Aldouble have expanded our library to include over 500 geniuses, all inside your AudioCom!

Looking for a creative approach to a problem? Talk to Leonardo da Vinci, Steve Jobs or even Socrates!
Interested in art? Klimt, Van Gogh and Mondrian are at your service!
Financial problems? Rockefeller, Ford and Bezos will help you invest effectively!
Choose from among a broad spectrum of geniuses! You don't have to be one to act like one!

This is not a scam! We've analyzed all authorized sayings of the masters and we've learned their secret! Visit our website and take advantage of a 30% discount! Unlock your potential!


—


From: Kevin Burback
To: AIdouble

First of all - that's illegal. Second of all - to create a copy of a person you'd have to have access to practically all of their day-to-day activities. That's difficult even today, and we've been gathering data about what people do online virtually non-stop every day for decades. Third of all - it's immoral. Don't send me emails like this.

Not respectfully,
Kevin Burback


—


From: AIdouble
To: Kevin Burback

You can't reply to an automatically grenerated message.


—


From: Kevin Burback
To: AIdouble

Did you just really send me an email saying: "You can't reply to an automatically gRenerated message"? That's not a system notification, do you really think I'm an idiot?

I'm reporting you. Maybe some dead lawyer will be able to help you.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.014_3_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Elena Toma
To: Harold Toma

Hey Dad!

They blocked mom's account when she tried to write you. They'll probably block mine now too. They told mom to say that. There was an inspection, they found something in your office, mom doesn't want to tell me what, but she won't stop crying. She said we don't have a choice, we can't write to you.

We love you very much, mom doesn't know I'm writing this but I'm sure she's very sorry.
Elena.

To: Natasha Pough

This is not an ad. It's an offer for a better life. Without the medicine and supplements from Future Health Solutions, the conquest of space would not be possible. We help you overcome the limits imposed by outer space.

The Galaxy series of products will help you feel at home anywhere - whether it's under lunar domes or in Martian tunnels. Or maybe you dream of going farther? Anything is possible with our supplements. They will strengthen your immune system and provide a solid dose of vitamins and minerals. You don't have to worry about your bones weakening or organs failing!

Our Nebula series, on the other hand, is the unparalleled solution for the hardest working colonists. Our supplements help quickly increase muscle mass, reduce fatigue and stimulate the intellect. You can work harder and more efficiently, while reducing sleep to a minimum. It's your shortcut to a promotion.

Forget about being tired. Throw off your limitations. Your health is your future.

Future Health Solutions - For modern problems.


—


From: Natasha Pough

How'd you get this address? You can't write here!


—


From: FHS Store

Thank you for your interest in our product! Reply with "Better life" to get a special discount on the Nebula series!

Future Health Solutions - For modern problems.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.014_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:

To: Dorina Toma

Hey!

I just read the article. What's going on? Is Elena okay? Why are firefighters looking for me? What's this about? They told you to say that?

I love you,
Harold


—

This isn't funny. Honey, write me back, these messages aren't cheap. I don't know what's going on.

I love you,
Harold

Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.00X_X2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Marco DeLuca
To: Selenian Corporation

Work is progressing as planned, despite fewer personnel. We were able to force Zamenhof to do some medical tests and I can say that physically he's fine, it's his mind that's the problem. I haven't noticed any aggressive behavior on his part but his disconnection from reality is frightening and neither Nathan or I feel comfortable being on this mission with someone who's lost their mind. Please send someone new and take Zamenhof back to Earth.

Requesting a quick reaction,
Marco DeLuca

P.S. I tried to see what he's been writing but it's not possible to translate the binary code into English.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.007_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Michael Clarke
To: Moon Energy Corporation

I don't believe that placing the base at a higher altitude was the best idea. It doesn't protect us from Vermin attacks and the Solar Panels aren't generating any more power. Meanwhile, the terrain is tough, going up and down the steep slopes is annoying, and my calves hurt every day.

We request permission to move the base to a lower altitude with less steep terrain.

Michael Clarke


—


From: Moon Energy Corporations
To: Michael Clarke

Hello!

Permission denied.

Thank you for your sacrifice!
The Moon Energy Corporation
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.007_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:

To: Michael Clarke

Good day!

Regarding your terrain analysis data, we have not determined any tectonic danger in the area where the base is located. We must, therefore, reject your request to re-locate the base.

Please remember to direct any future correspondence to the contact email address. Further bypassing of intermediaries will result in a fine.

Best regards and thank you for your sacrifice!
The Moon Energy Corporation Geological Research Department
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.013_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Natasha Pough
To: Griffits Blue

Initial recon shows no sign of the enemy in the area. The terrain is stable, safe, the water is not potable but we'll think of something. We should be good to begin weapon testing.

Sgt. Pough
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.010_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Oliver Murdock
To: Selenian Corporation

The planet's seismic activity is completely predictable. The tectonic plates are moving uniformly. The strongest shockwave that we have registered was barely a 1.7 on the Richter scale. Compared to the ground on Earth or Mars, I'd call Arcadia boring.

The Star Ruptures are a different story. Regular energy impacts, expansion and compression of rocks and other factors caused by cataclysms. We'll remain in the mobile base for the next few Ruptures and then we'll go back. We hope this will not affect the main mission negatively.

Engineer Oliver Murdock
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.009_3_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Path of Souls
To: multiple recipients

Discs have introduced many positive changes into our lives, but they have also created chaos in the spiritual sphere. The eternal cycle of life and death has been disrupted.

Do you feel lost?

Removed from nature?

Are you afraid for your soul?

Ancient practices will help you regain balance!

Incense and herbs: produced according to recipes by monks from the Far East, they will purify your body and mind. They will help you meditate and enter trances.

Intention candles: created out of natural wax especially for magical rituals, they help your intentions come true. Don't be afraid to ask for what you deserve!

Talismans: they offer protection and support from the primordial gods of nature, they will help ground you.

Technology has pushed us away from the ancient powers, but if you dare reach for them, they will answer your call.

See our full catalog - our rituals, spells and magical tools will help you connect with the Oneness and regain peace of mind.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.009_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: S1337
To: Selenian Corporation

I must regretfully file a complaint regarding convict A0078. He refuses to cooperate in any way and does not fulfill even the most basic of obligations. During the previous cycle, he barricaded himself in the foundations of the base and refuses to come out. When I asked him to help me mine titanium he responded, quote: "I don't care about that, what can they do to me here? You should chill out too!".

I am requesting permission to use direct coercive measures.

I really don't know what to do.
Convict S1337


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: S1337

We were afraid it could come to this. We are happy to see how well you are handling the mining on your own. Since indirect coercive measure aren't working, we are granting you full authorization to use direct coercive measures.

Good luck!
The Selenian Corporation


—


From: S1337
To: Selenian Corporation

Convict A0078 has disappeared. I suspect he is hiding somewhere in the area because I have noticed that products are regularly disappearing from the Food Station, making him the main suspect.

I think he read my previous message and got scared. I have no way of influencing his behavior. Please send reinforcements, I might not be able to defend myself alone if the Vermin attack.


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: S1337

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide anyone to help you. Seeing how well you are doing on your own, we are certain you will be able to overcome any obstacles you face!

Good luck! You are our best convict!
The Selenian Corporation
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.008_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Victor Santana
To: Future Health Solutions Research Department

We were able to capture another specimen. After the accident, we were forced to put it in the habitat module. This specimen is a basic form of alien, it doesn't explode or spit, it just uses its extraordinarily sharp legs to attack. Dr. Han has received a new sleeve and is doing well. She is responsible for overseeing the new specimen.

Dr. V. Santana
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.008_1_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Victor Santana
To: Future Health Solutions Research Department

We were successful in capturing a specimen, we can begin our research. As expected, the specimen is being held far from the living quarters. Dr. Hui is keeping it stable, we are trying to use as little electricity as possible, it appears to agitate the specimen. I will send updates on our progress in my next email.

Dr. V. Santana
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.00X3_X_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
I'm at a loss. This star doesn't resemble anything I have seen in my 60-year career. The spectrography and visual observations indicate that it is a red giant, but then why does it explode? It should be collapsing into a blue dwarf. And the explosions are numerous, it's as if it's going back in time. There is nothing in this universe that would cause a star to behave in this way.

Everything seems to indicate that Ruptura's explosions are not natural. Either someone created the star or something happened to it. Maybe it's some graviton anomaly? Maybe a failed experiment into pocket dimensions? Maybe it's an artificially created weapon? I can theorize ad nauseum, but it won't get us any closer to the truth.

I don't know what to do.
Datapads_SmallBasesContentUpdate_1.008_3_D_SmallBase_p_Content:
Nothing in this organism makes sense. At first, I was excited at the prospect of examining something so strange. The unlimited potential in researching these creatures, so different from anything I've seen both on Earth and on this Godforsaken world, was a chance every scientist dreams of. But the fascination quickly faded.

I feel like the decades I have spent honing my knowledge have been wasted. Nothing that occurs within these organisms resembles anything I have seen before. Even the nitrogenous bases of their nucleotides are different from anything I have ever seen.

This creature should not exist. Its very presence undermines not only the laws of evolution but even the laws of physics as we know them. This could not come into being either by natural means or even in laboratory conditions. I imagine this is what the scientists that discovered quantum mechanics felt like when all of their knowledge went to hell.

I think I'm done. Nothing in this organism makes any sense. I need help interpreting even a part of what I've seen.

Dialogue.0746E66F4204B9FC76F9C1AC5C95BF9D_A_G_Cle: Congratulations! Clever Robotics has received its order! A reward for fulfilling the order is waiting for you in the terminal.

Dialogue.F5D6295742B30D4FCE3F769F19377E6A_A_G_Cle: Another shipment has arrived. Clever Robotics is pleased with the quality of your work. There are rewards waiting for you in the terminal that should help optimize how you work.
Dialogue.255C8CBD45EB0E75794F9FACF030F71F_A_E_Cle: Optimize? I thought we were doing pretty well.
Dialogue.255C8CBD45EB0E75794F9FACF030F71F_A_M_Cle: Optimize? I thought we were doing pretty well.
Dialogue.255C8CBD45EB0E75794F9FACF030F71F_A_P_Cle: Optimize? I thought we were doing pretty well.
Dialogue.255C8CBD45EB0E75794F9FACF030F71F_A_S_Cle: Optimize? I thought we were doing pretty well.
Dialogue.1A81BA9F41FD0A274FE50F9A35ADECF4_A_G_Cle: Clever Robotics deeply believes that any task can always be made more efficient!
Dialogue.117348A94E71C2B7BA1643BA83168DD8_A_G_Cle: Bravo! Shipment delivered to Clever Robotics! They're still very happy with your services but remember, everything can always be done more efficiently!
Dialogue.0264484B428E63F23CE488A3ADFF8E27_A_E_Cle: We can't be in two places at once. Other corporations need shipments too.
Dialogue.0264484B428E63F23CE488A3ADFF8E27_A_M_Cle: We need to complete orders for five different companies.
Dialogue.0264484B428E63F23CE488A3ADFF8E27_A_P_Cle: Our efficiency is satisfactory. Other corporations need our shipments as well.
Dialogue.0264484B428E63F23CE488A3ADFF8E27_A_S_Cle: There are other companies we need to complete orders for as well.
Dialogue.790110A444336EF8863CB4842DD0713D_A_G_Cle: Oh, no, no, no. Clever Robotics understands this and is not suggesting you prioritize their requests over others. That would be a violation of your contract. Clever Robotics just wants to help you complete all of your orders more efficiently.
Dialogue.699DB03F4A7D2719F2C59F9990C810E0_A_G_Cle: Good job! Clever Robotics would like to let you know that they are happy with your work and at this rate you will pay off your debt in no time. Please tell me, how do you feel about working with Clever Robotics?
Dialogue.F2FDA90F43A8453BAF4101814143E314_A_E_Cle: I don't see anything particularly special about them.
Dialogue.F98CE63D4018EA370C73BC924BFAF50B_A_G_Cle: Remember that if you have any feedback for the company you can let me know directly.
Dialogue.F9887A8E4FA8CE9A0A592C934B899A05_A_P_Cle: I'll let you know if anything comes to mind.
Dialogue.991FBF3D4F1054C94465A1B31AE959CB_A_G_Cle: Good work. Clever Robotics has received its order! There is a reward waiting for you in the Corporate Terminal that should help you work faster.
Dialogue.867820734C99F4CDCAEE4EAF992B4DD6_A_G_Cle: Excellent. Clever Robotics has received its shipment. Claim your rewards in the terminal.
Dialogue.52DBD4F344198E1085FB74828B6EA482_A_E_Cle: Remember how you said we can tell if you if we have any feedback? I do have something.
Dialogue.52DBD4F344198E1085FB74828B6EA482_A_M_Cle: Remember how you said we can tell if you if we have any feedback? I do have something.
Dialogue.52DBD4F344198E1085FB74828B6EA482_A_P_Cle: Remember how you said we can tell if you if we have any feedback? I do have something.
Dialogue.52DBD4F344198E1085FB74828B6EA482_A_S_Cle: Remember how you said we can tell if you if we have any feedback? I do have something.
Dialogue.F8A7618D47D53AFEA4734099B295E54F_A_G_Cle: As the liaison between Claywood and Clever Robotics I'm all ears!
Dialogue.D9E8455F4E154F3D4F919BB8F229A653_A_E_Cle: They could tone it down with the efficiency and optimization talk, we've got enough to worry about as it is.
Dialogue.D9E8455F4E154F3D4F919BB8F229A653_A_M_Cle: They keep harping on efficiency and optimization. Not that I really care about that but other corporations don't do that. I'm feeling a little pressured.
Dialogue.D9E8455F4E154F3D4F919BB8F229A653_A_P_Cle: I really like their gear but this constant talk of optimization is becoming a little irritating.
Dialogue.D9E8455F4E154F3D4F919BB8F229A653_A_S_Cle: I feel like Clever Robotics constantly talking about our efficiency puts unnecessary pressure on us.
Dialogue.45F37B83411B253F4FC51E8F343B01B7_A_G_Cle: Another shipment sent! Clever Robotics thanks you and grants you your rewards. It has also responded to your feedback regarding their communication. Quote:
Dialogue.6287BB814BEDA04504F2B180BC7DC333_A_G_Cle: Clever Robotics is deeply saddened by this situation, it was not our aim to increase your stress levels by putting more pressure on you. In order to avoid such problems in the future everyone responsible for this infraction has been suspended in their duties effective immediately. They were also fined a penalty equivalent to two years wages. These individuals have now been replaced by qualified non-organic employees. The CEO, Robert Garner, takes full responsibility and apologizes to you all. You are very important to us.
Dialogue.8EDB42C14BC3992C00D9C19AD14EE131_A_E_Cle: What?! I didn't want anyone to get fired. It wasn't that big a deal!
Dialogue.8EDB42C14BC3992C00D9C19AD14EE131_A_M_Cle: That's awful. I ruined the lives of several people by making a simple comment. I'm not saying anything anymore.
Dialogue.8EDB42C14BC3992C00D9C19AD14EE131_A_P_Cle: Rightfully so. It was a minor issue but perfection is the goal.
Dialogue.8EDB42C14BC3992C00D9C19AD14EE131_A_S_Cle: It was just a minor nuisance. That's a very severe penalty.
Dialogue.420E0BCB4A5FB120E9E424BCBE29C4BA_A_G_Cle: The Clever Robotics motto is "No compromise. Just perfection."
The Clever Robotics motto is "No compromise. Just perfection."
Dialogue.55680EFF46385031863A79BA6D02BD49_A_E_Cle: What if I have more feedback for Clever Robotics?

Dialogue.55680EFF46385031863A79BA6D02BD49_A_S_Cle: You can't overdo it when punishing someone, that's when morale suffers.

Dialogue.38F20F47475B5975F398F78C10C2B410_A_S_Cle: I don't have any more feedback. No one needs to get fired.
Dialogue.0D4C523E4413AB0D1B11B0B252B852D0_A_G_Cle: If you're uncomfortable with providing more feedback because of the previous firings please let me know.
Dialogue.B6F4DD884CD68B027498BAB8252F4F46_A_E_Cle: No, no, never, nothing like that. Everything is muy bueno.
Dialogue.B6F4DD884CD68B027498BAB8252F4F46_A_M_Cle: Yes, Gal, I am bothered by it. That's not how feedback should work.
Dialogue.B6F4DD884CD68B027498BAB8252F4F46_A_P_Cle: I rarely say this but I really am impressed with everything they do.
Dialogue.B6F4DD884CD68B027498BAB8252F4F46_A_S_Cle: No, I really have no issue.
Dialogue.687D534A467A8E6A03567282D883106E_A_G_Cle: Then you'll probably be surprised to hear that the people responsible for the previous decision were just let go. They were replaced by non-organic employees that will exhibit more empathy when dealing with other employees which will in turn increase morale and efficiency.

Dialogue.49BFDA2F46C668AAD137CDA1C4B563F1_A_M_Cle: I'm not talking to them anymore. That's horrible.
Dialogue.49BFDA2F46C668AAD137CDA1C4B563F1_A_P_Cle: If it'll improve the way the company functions then good.
Dialogue.49BFDA2F46C668AAD137CDA1C4B563F1_A_S_Cle: So even more people were fired. Because of a small oversight?
Dialogue.F96C215B4A0CB8950D0927A11B483ACF_A_G_Cle: Cargo received! Clever Robotics thanks you for a particularly speedy shipment. Rewards await you in the terminal! They are extremely impressed that despite your fragile protein structure you're able to be so effective!

Dialogue.56285F8A473E3EC562DF87B48212F61B_A_M_Cle: Did I hear that correctly? Are there any people still working at Clever Robotics?
Dialogue.56285F8A473E3EC562DF87B48212F61B_A_P_Cle: It's a limitation I'm aware of but rarely does anyone point it out. Is there anyone still working at Clever Robotics that's made of protein?
Dialogue.56285F8A473E3EC562DF87B48212F61B_A_S_Cle: Excuse me? Protein structure is a weird thing to say. Are there any people still working at Clever Robotics?
Dialogue.F06F5C034A7E6986051DD2A688F3C5F4_A_G_Cle: In accordance with the April 2104 law, at least 10% of Clever Robotics personnel is required to be human.
Dialogue.7E29F3034E482AD5D057E48D54546A56_A_M_Cle: So why do they sound so weird?
Dialogue.7E29F3034E482AD5D057E48D54546A56_A_P_Cle: 10% is still a lot. Working with protein-based organisms should be normal for them.
Dialogue.25E121C74C82163141912DBBA832E295_A_G_Cle: Of that 10%, 98% is in senior management.
Dialogue.A36F977C4C3281DCE4F8F789DBBDF182_A_G_Cle: You don't want to know. Those poor, poor people.
Dialogue.3C62A62B497C5B12E8F9E89A7A62EBA2_A_G_Cle: Great work. Clever Robotics has received your shipment. As usual, your reward waits for you in the terminal.
Dialogue.114FAEE841C940AC34F7C187C435B6BF_A_G_Fir: I advise caution. The fruit on Arcadia can alleviate hunger, but putting unknown things into one's mouth is rarely beneficial to the individual. Though, of course, it was beneficial to the development of civilization. Although this fruit is edible, that won't always be the case.
Dialogue.B293D52C4A58733485413490ACF6E4FD_A_S_Exi: I don't see any more enemies.
Dialogue.26E7C4E243D08A0D2BAE5ABC155698F9_A_G_FE_: Okay, my dears, time to get back to work.
Dialogue.682E7DB7464FD92B473897A5D2D3FF88_A_E_FE_: And the whole moment is ruined.
Dialogue.F0F2DC6947F07CC2B7E57CB4B9B52E63_A_G_FE_: Did you understand the final message?
Dialogue.502064594003947668783C8A16C62F4F_A_M_FE_: The planet's atmosphere has been altered. It said something about reducing the amount of cosmic radiation. Does that mean what I think it means?
Dialogue.502064594003947668783C8A16C62F4F_A_P_FE_: More hydrogen compounds have entered the atmosphere reducing the amount of cosmic radiation that gets through it and reaches Arcadia. Does that mean what I think it means?
Dialogue.502064594003947668783C8A16C62F4F_A_S_FE_: It said something about atmospheric changes. To be honest I didn't understand it.
Dialogue.7B57F3C24770BEEC396593A37F912394_A_G_P_F: Unfortunately, despite my best efforts, I've still not found a way to read your brain waves, so the answer is: I don't know. However, I do know that thanks to your actions, an area of ​​Arcadia-7 is now receiving much less ionizing radiation. You can now explore new territory!
Dialogue.7B57F3C24770BEEC396593A37F912394_A_G_S_F: Scientific details aside, an area of ​​Arcadia-7 is now receiving much less ionizing radiation thanks to your efforts. You can now explore new territory!
Dialogue.AE9728E04B3F57E3B7B3FA885A957547_A_E_FE_: So it's time for some sightseeing?
Dialogue.AE9728E04B3F57E3B7B3FA885A957547_A_P_FE_: That's exactly what I was thinking.
Dialogue.2578268D403131D8A32B4AB6AABC7D92_A_G_FE_: No alien lifeforms detected. Deactivating quarantine mode.
Dialogue.EC8C73D642FCAD4917BCD8946FAC59BE_A_E_FE_: We did it. Now I'm afraid to turn it on again.
Dialogue.EC8C73D642FCAD4917BCD8946FAC59BE_A_M_FE_: Even turning on a machine on this godforsaken planet can be lethal.
Dialogue.EC8C73D642FCAD4917BCD8946FAC59BE_A_P_FE_: That wasn't so bad. Time to get this machine started.
Dialogue.4CE37AD74688FEA0E533648BB4E3D2B4_A_G_FE_: No alien lifeforms detected. Deactivating quarantine mode.
Dialogue.E69A84CB41F685AF97B278A71E55D209_A_S_FE_: Alright, this has to be the end.
Dialogue.1D5AD02A48E111DAA902AAB51CF08487_A_G_FE_: GAL: No alien lifeforms detected. Deactivating quarantine mode.
Dialogue.862A40A4434A4F24B26A6B991C79044C_A_E_FE_: It's getting worse! But there's not much to left go.
Dialogue.862A40A4434A4F24B26A6B991C79044C_A_M_FE_: That was close. We need to prepare.
Dialogue.862A40A4434A4F24B26A6B991C79044C_A_S_FE_: This time the enemy was stronger. We should prepare before we turn the engine on again.
Dialogue.8E2F125A42C6F629054BA89A59B014F5_A_G_FE_: I am detecting that you are in the area of the Forgotten Engine. That's good, make sure you have taken everything that could be useful now that it has been activated.
Dialogue.1143755949BA170D5448639019F17F31_A_E_FE_: A battery, I'll need it to open the door.
Dialogue.1143755949BA170D5448639019F17F31_A_M_FE_: A battery, the first step in opening that door.
Dialogue.1143755949BA170D5448639019F17F31_A_P_FE_: A single battery. Not enough voltage to open the lock.
Dialogue.1143755949BA170D5448639019F17F31_A_S_FE_: A battery. It looks like I need this for the entrance.
Dialogue.182D554A4679EA7B29398EB069203EFC_A_E_FE_: Darn it all, of course it's not working.
Dialogue.182D554A4679EA7B29398EB069203EFC_A_M_FE_: It won't work without a core.
Dialogue.182D554A4679EA7B29398EB069203EFC_A_P_FE_: There's no core. We need to modify the plan.
Dialogue.A5B5DCD44A5D291AED64A997CFB0F93B_A_E_FE_: Places like this have to be self-sufficient. If we look hard enough we're bound to find a spare core.
Dialogue.E42F1959474D2E390BDA2BA72F1D69D6_A_P_FE_: If I were responsible for the construction of this place, I'd keep the core on the technical level.
Dialogue.F0CE323B424E7BBA2B3134A7574C82A2_A_E_FE_: Well I'll be. That's a big room.
Dialogue.F0CE323B424E7BBA2B3134A7574C82A2_A_M_FE_: It looks quiet, but let's stay alert.
Dialogue.F0CE323B424E7BBA2B3134A7574C82A2_A_P_FE_: Yes! This is where they controlled the machine! Let's turn it on!
Dialogue.F0CE323B424E7BBA2B3134A7574C82A2_A_S_FE_: Hmmm… so they've been in here too.
Dialogue.FA36B65642B64F75ED989E9643DFA0E5_A_E_FE_: Very clever of them, I have to admit, impressive piece of technology.
Dialogue.FA36B65642B64F75ED989E9643DFA0E5_A_M_FE_: Such a small thing and yet it holds so much power. The human mind is astounding.
Dialogue.FA36B65642B64F75ED989E9643DFA0E5_A_P_FE_: What a fascinating project. This unassuming core is able to activate such an impressive machine.
Dialogue.E27B7CC543FFB656A6495D805A54D8A3_A_G_FE_: It looks like you have everything you need to activate the Forgotten Engine. Proceed to the control center.
Dialogue.7FF741F34F49F95A916D0F9CF14F2D64_A_E_FE_: Alrighty, time to turn this beast on.
Dialogue.7FF741F34F49F95A916D0F9CF14F2D64_A_P_FE_: What a strange feeling. I'm excited but also sad that it's over.
Dialogue.961F1B7243A707E151BE0FAF222A7751_A_G_S_F: I'm glad you're so engaged but you're not in the army anymore. You don't need to be so formal.
Dialogue.961F1B7243A707E151BE0FAF222A7751_A_M_P_F: Everything good eventually comes to an end. But personally I'm glad this'll be over with.
Dialogue.961F1B7243A707E151BE0FAF222A7751_A_S_M_F: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We need to be ready for anything.
Dialogue.FCE085B542182A36ED85028024482D1C_A_E_FE_: Okay, I'm switching to my professional mode. Considering how infected the control center was, we need to be prepared.
Dialogue.FCE085B542182A36ED85028024482D1C_A_G_M_F: S8466 is right. I recommend stocking up on ammunition and rations.
Dialogue.FCE085B542182A36ED85028024482D1C_A_S_FE_: Yes, ma'am! I mean uh… Yeah, sure!

Dialogue.36BA5CEA461E0B8F070785BCFA538E8F_Physici: P0212: Such a trivial word. We’re in the Forgotten Engine! How can you not be excited?
Dialogue.3CBEEEDF4F66A39BFC2361822CC51C19_A_M_FE_: A keycard for a higher floor.
Dialogue.3CBEEEDF4F66A39BFC2361822CC51C19_A_P_FE_: The keycard for the technical floor.
Dialogue.3CBEEEDF4F66A39BFC2361822CC51C19_A_S_FE_: The keycard for the technical floor.
Dialogue.E5C50D1745F67D4F42426D9FBADCD267_A_P_FE_: Oh well. This has to be the last one.
Dialogue.312887DD4D14D91B52DC59BB2A3E5DA3_A_E_FE_: Okay, we're off to the technical level to find that core.
Dialogue.312887DD4D14D91B52DC59BB2A3E5DA3_A_M_FE_: The core should be on the technical floor.
Dialogue.312887DD4D14D91B52DC59BB2A3E5DA3_A_P_FE_: The engine is still missing its core. Let's look for it in the technical level.
Dialogue.312887DD4D14D91B52DC59BB2A3E5DA3_A_S_FE_: Mission: find the core. Get to the technical level.
Dialogue.35F57A6E4FF6BEF7FF5B8CBF856C8062_A_E_FE_: We have everything we need. Let's turn this baby on.
Dialogue.35F57A6E4FF6BEF7FF5B8CBF856C8062_A_M_FE_: Now we can finally activate the engine.
Dialogue.35F57A6E4FF6BEF7FF5B8CBF856C8062_A_P_FE_: Time to activate the engine. I can't wait.
Dialogue.35F57A6E4FF6BEF7FF5B8CBF856C8062_A_S_FE_: We're ready. Let's turn on the engine.
Dialogue.0ECCF9244BA0CEBEEE4CFF834D61709D_A_G_FHS: Great work. Future Health Solutions is now receiving all requested items. New rewards and tasks are waiting for you in the terminal.
Dialogue.E859AAA64C7374438D87DC94100586C7_A_G_FHS: Bravo! Future Health Solutions is happy with your work. New rewards have been unlocked. Look in the terminal to assign them. Future Health Solutions for modern problems.
Dialogue.D191B1A44BC7385FBC76FE8ABA833A22_A_E_FHS: Why did you add the slogan at the end?
Dialogue.D191B1A44BC7385FBC76FE8ABA833A22_A_M_FHS: Why did you add the slogan at the end?
Dialogue.D191B1A44BC7385FBC76FE8ABA833A22_A_P_FHS: Why did you add the slogan at the end?
Dialogue.D191B1A44BC7385FBC76FE8ABA833A22_A_S_FHS: Why did you add the slogan at the end?
Dialogue.C6DDEE2947952699B30007B1A3AF2FA1_A_G_FHS: Be glad I didn't sing it.
Dialogue.05E8377649DBAB7309B9968467A3D0CF_A_G_FHS: Future Health Solutions has received its order! Homesick? Living in a space colony often separates us from our loved ones. Try Oxytocinum! A syrup that releases a quadruple dose of oxytocin - the closeness hormone! You don't have to visit your family to feel like they're there.
Dialogue.1A4FFA864B8327033EC81DBF9C2B6DA5_A_E_FHS: Why do you sound like an ad?
Dialogue.1A4FFA864B8327033EC81DBF9C2B6DA5_A_M_FHS: Why do you sound like an ad?
Dialogue.1A4FFA864B8327033EC81DBF9C2B6DA5_A_P_FHS: Why do you sound like an ad?
Dialogue.1A4FFA864B8327033EC81DBF9C2B6DA5_A_S_FHS: Why do you sound like an ad?
Dialogue.881B81BC4BC425D37515B6B4F5B3B024_A_G_FHS: I'm reading exactly what I have in my instructions. Now also with tangerine flavor! Future Health Solutions for modern problems.
Dialogue.B47E977942F7902A0DE536A23E39346D_A_G_FHS: Great work. Future Health Solutions has received your shipment. Claim your rewards in the terminal.
Dialogue.AFA436874C3DC8B4E1AD94B3FF246093_A_G_FHS: Future Health Solutions has received its order. You must be very tired after all of that. And your eyesight is probably not what it used to be when your sleeve was fresh, right?
Dialogue.B7944F2A4DAA139ED558EEBBFD273F14_A_E_FHS: It could be a bit better.
Dialogue.B7944F2A4DAA139ED558EEBBFD273F14_A_S_FHS: There's nothing wrong with my eyesight or endurance.
Dialogue.919DFCB04D6CDE2229DEE3B5B13ECE9A_A_G_FHS: Try the Limbic Enhancement Membrane! This groundbreaking system…
Dialogue.A16CACBC483495DAFE31E5844890AB64_A_E_FHS: Gosh darn it! I thought you were really asking.
Dialogue.A16CACBC483495DAFE31E5844890AB64_A_M_FHS: I knew it, it's an ad.
Dialogue.A16CACBC483495DAFE31E5844890AB64_A_S_FHS: I'll do it but not because there's something wrong with me.
Dialogue.0ACC6C4E48EE7B3DFFB6A39EDA5D1466_A_G_FHS: It will boost your body's performance by 1000%! Available now in your terminal! Future Health Solutions for modern problems.
Dialogue.9610431B43C902C0AED0779F7EFFD4E7_A_G_FHS: Another order fulfilled! Future Health Solutions recommends Osteo+. In environments with different gravity, your bones may…
Dialogue.C2561B82446FBEADCDB8989CC222ADFB_A_E_FHS: Could you please stop bombarding us with ads? There's only four of us here, there's no point.
Dialogue.C2561B82446FBEADCDB8989CC222ADFB_A_M_FHS: Could you please stop bombarding us with ads? There's only four of us here, there's no point.
Dialogue.C2561B82446FBEADCDB8989CC222ADFB_A_P_FHS: Could you please stop bombarding us with ads? There's only four of us here, there's no point.
Dialogue.C2561B82446FBEADCDB8989CC222ADFB_A_S_FHS: Could you please stop bombarding us with ads? There's only four of us here, there's no point.
Dialogue.654159614FBD28578EC89CA0C587F0C9_A_G_FHS: According to data from the Ad Targeting Department at Future Health Solutions this means the ads are reaching 100% of the population.
Dialogue.A065071C49286B2F7BE3AB957EA7A676_A_E_FHS: But we'll be using the equipment even without the ads.
Dialogue.A065071C49286B2F7BE3AB957EA7A676_A_M_FHS: But we'll be using the equipment even without the ads.
Dialogue.A065071C49286B2F7BE3AB957EA7A676_A_P_FHS: But we'll be using the equipment even without the ads.
Dialogue.A065071C49286B2F7BE3AB957EA7A676_A_S_FHS: But we'll be using the equipment even without the ads.
Dialogue.D93B5A2646BC379DAF9CD1AD9D1507ED_A_G_FHS: I didn't write the algorithm. But if you like I can block it.
Dialogue.E2F4201341E34C3F49AE8F900CBC98ED_A_G_FHS: Done. Still, you have a new reward in the terminal.
Dialogue.6BB1C9F94DC35DAD338E8294B619B720_A_G_FHS: Good job! Future Health Solutions has unlocked new rewards for you.
Dialogue.287ED23F464E761DB8CC85898EE5E2D4_A_G_FHS: It's there, but I'll keep it to myself.
Dialogue.127604F148057E82AB695E92884652AA_A_G_FHS: Future Health Solutions thanks you for the shipment. Tell me, do you sometimes itch in hard to reach places?
Dialogue.886BB056448B6B6293DCF0BCC1C17412_A_E_FHS: I won't fall for it this time. Nuh-uh. Though this spacesuit does chafe and maybe that's why it itches…
Dialogue.886BB056448B6B6293DCF0BCC1C17412_A_M_FHS: Now I know it's an ad.
Dialogue.0D23238B443366F7C5DED29F5FA1E604_A_G_FHS: On Earth you'll be able to try Itchstop which thanks to its unique composition…
Dialogue.1981D73F48412E3FD9EF5ABB3A81D378_A_E_FHS: Darn you, GAL! You were supposed to turn off the ads.
Dialogue.1981D73F48412E3FD9EF5ABB3A81D378_A_M_FHS: I was right. Turn them off.
Dialogue.1981D73F48412E3FD9EF5ABB3A81D378_A_P_FHS: Ah, it's the ad again. GAL, turn them off please.
Dialogue.1981D73F48412E3FD9EF5ABB3A81D378_A_S_FHS: It's another ad. Turn it off.
Dialogue.2F365F5E445E4A23F85D46B745FA0C80_A_G_FHS: It's not an ad, it's a sponsored message!
Dialogue.368D4B184950BC6940BEBB9466C19FF4_A_M_FHS: Let's not debate semantics. Turn them off.
Dialogue.7FD679CE4D1AA932C2D9EA9BA6A3167D_A_G_FHS: Itchstop is now available with tangerine flavor.
Dialogue.59C72FFA48D434E60ADD9CB97D602F76_A_G_FHS: I'm sorry, it's hard to resist. I'm turning them off.
Dialogue.874245DB460DF17998FB4CB26AAAD7CD_A_G_FHS: Excellent work. Future Health Solutions received its order. To prevent improper use, please explain how the buildings already made available to you are working out.
Dialogue.F9A704BE4F84F7E7E0EFC097F17CF357_A_G_FHS: Are you fed up with monotonous chemical processes? Is simple electrolysis taking up an entire day?
Dialogue.6D94004B4A1B06936CDB0B89631685F9_A_G_FHS: Order fulfilled. A reward from Future Health Solutions is waiting in the Corporate Terminal.
Dialogue.50B013F3456D369D4EC0E1904DEE9BFA_A_G_FHS: Wonderful! Future Health Solutions has received its order. Rewards are waiting for you in the terminal. Would you like to hear about a groundbreaking pill that will stop your nails from splitting?
Dialogue.46234B024F3989B52AC441940400A7FA_A_G_FHS: Congratulations! Future Health Solutions has accepted your shipment, the reward is waiting for you in the terminal. In the meantime, I analyzed your contract and unfortunately the sponsored messages must be reinstated.
Dialogue.943CA82C4DE36AC67824EC97C0A46252_A_G_FHS: The ads are being officially turned off!
Dialogue.24084F4B432E1D7A415297AECB2E6721_A_G_FHS: You'll need to pay a contractual penalty if they're not.
Dialogue.CDCF459249F0B5788710D58E649A1195_A_E_FHS: Meh, that's the cost of one algae bar.
Dialogue.CDCF459249F0B5788710D58E649A1195_A_M_FHS: I don't like to waste money, but that's an insignificant sum.
Dialogue.CDCF459249F0B5788710D58E649A1195_A_S_FHS: Compared to our debts that's nothing.
Dialogue.6C021F8442D65F67B7D3D99C8358741A_A_G_FHS: So you consent to having the penalty added to your debt?
Dialogue.88243A8D4784AB807E6B24B3C7084940_A_G_FHS: Along with handling fees and debt service I am adding 857 Yusee to your penalty.
Dialogue.EC107244424F1352D5D4D391AE3BE624_A_G_FHS: Fantastic! Future Health Solutions is very pleased with your work. As such, in addition to your rewards, your subscription has been reduced to 5 Yusee a day!
Dialogue.E90EECE847ED6A29A3AFF0B77E9BAD83_A_E_FHS: GAL, be more precise. How much is it to turn off the ads permanently?
Dialogue.E90EECE847ED6A29A3AFF0B77E9BAD83_A_M_FHS: Of course. How much would it be if we'd pay in advance?
Dialogue.E90EECE847ED6A29A3AFF0B77E9BAD83_A_P_FHS: I thought I was only paying once.
Dialogue.E90EECE847ED6A29A3AFF0B77E9BAD83_A_S_FHS: That was supposed to be a one-time payment.
Dialogue.DD83A25B4C281B26E9EA8FB369CFE9D2_A_G_FHS: A one-time payment would be 16,799 Yusee.
Dialogue.7B8247C14219F9F6A505938591832CB5_A_E_FHS: And we'd have peace and quiet forever?
Dialogue.7B8247C14219F9F6A505938591832CB5_A_M_FHS: And we'd have peace and quiet forever?
Dialogue.7B8247C14219F9F6A505938591832CB5_A_P_FHS: And we'd have peace and quiet forever?
Dialogue.7B8247C14219F9F6A505938591832CB5_A_S_FHS: And we'd have peace and quiet forever?
Dialogue.21CAA3534002C64958281F8A13BDA750_A_G_FHS: You can be proud of the work you've done! Another order fulfilled for Future Health Solutions!
Dialogue.CD7AEC7B421633EAC2CC1881D03D7540_A_G_Fir: You're nearing the abandoned outpost of a previous expedition. Search the area, you'll find equipment and information you can use.
Dialogue.05D38F9645E2251333402C917018548D_A_E_Fir: Can I use any of what's left standing?
Dialogue.05D38F9645E2251333402C917018548D_A_M_Fir: Can I use any of what's left standing?
Dialogue.05D38F9645E2251333402C917018548D_A_P_Fir: Can I use any of what's left standing?
Dialogue.05D38F9645E2251333402C917018548D_A_S_Fir: Can I use any of what's left standing?
Dialogue.671D572B4BE45C4CEECFE1B52A6D8B78_A_G_Fir: Unfortunately, no. All buildings were created for a Core that was an older model, incompatible with the current version of the Building Tool's programming. But it’s okay, look on the bright side, anything you find here is yours. I won't tell anyone.
Dialogue.C3A39D5345943C777AB7139F9980FC20_A_G_Fir: Unfortunately, no. All buildings were created for a Core that was an older model, incompatible with the current version of the Building Tool's programming. But it’s okay, look on the bright side, anything you find here is yours. I won't tell anyone.
Dialogue.5E32394947C24E619B168BB48F46EFBE_A_E_Fir: I can't even build anything here?
Dialogue.5E32394947C24E619B168BB48F46EFBE_A_M_Fir: I can't even build anything here?
Dialogue.5E32394947C24E619B168BB48F46EFBE_A_P_Fir: I can't even build anything here?
Dialogue.5E32394947C24E619B168BB48F46EFBE_A_S_Fir: I can't even build anything here?
Dialogue.6AC66DEF41AC9BF30DBB8C8EE3430DAB_A_E_Fir: Is that it? It's over? Please, Gal, tell me it's over.
Dialogue.6AC66DEF41AC9BF30DBB8C8EE3430DAB_A_M_Fir: You were right, Gal. That, that, that was frightening. Such power.
Dialogue.6AC66DEF41AC9BF30DBB8C8EE3430DAB_A_P_Fir: That was even more wondrous than I imagined. You could smell the sublimation. What a force of nature! I can't wait until humanity reaches Type 1 on the Kardashev scale and will have access to such power.
Dialogue.6AC66DEF41AC9BF30DBB8C8EE3430DAB_A_S_Fir: I've heard what Ruptura does, but nothing could prepare me for what I just experienced.
Dialogue.64C638264CBB08A522BB1A94D322D6D7_A_G_Fir: You'll experience this again. It's better to be prepared. Make sure the Base Core doesn't overheat.
Dialogue.F60AD4404962F000793737806E28FF58_A_G_Fir: I see you've approached the Geo Scanner. You can use it to see the surrounding area.
Dialogue.723A221245D0DF40B87D72B4607774B8_A_M_Fir: Better to be aware of your surroundings.
Dialogue.CFAB3A924710D2A8AE5DA88F8954EE90_A_G_Fir: You have just listened to an audiocom recording of someone who was here before you. Each recording could contain useful data so Mr. Claywood has asked that you retrieve as many of them as possible.
Dialogue.6D9AC1914A0D6D37D3E6E08F57F86A5B_A_G_Fir: The Monolith has become active and your base is a tasty morsel for the Vermin. Prepare for an attack and protect the Core!
Dialogue.564D3C5A4B5E4DC6B5DA78B6D7A9C25D_A_E_Fir: What do you mean it's become active?
Dialogue.564D3C5A4B5E4DC6B5DA78B6D7A9C25D_A_M_Fir: What do you mean it's become active?
Dialogue.564D3C5A4B5E4DC6B5DA78B6D7A9C25D_A_P_Fir: What? What do you mean it's become active?
Dialogue.564D3C5A4B5E4DC6B5DA78B6D7A9C25D_A_S_Fir: What do you mean it's become active?
Dialogue.F090D4BF43016747C4222BA7F6A4A014_A_G_Fir: The Monolith creates Vermin and they're hungry.
Dialogue.30AE883D4F649A2C56C73CAF2DCB6C48_A_E_Fir: Is there no way to stop that?
Dialogue.30AE883D4F649A2C56C73CAF2DCB6C48_A_M_Fir: That's not good. Can we prevent this in any way?
Dialogue.30AE883D4F649A2C56C73CAF2DCB6C48_A_P_Fir: Interesting, so that device is some sort of womb… Is there any way to prevent the Vermin from attacking?
Dialogue.30AE883D4F649A2C56C73CAF2DCB6C48_A_S_Fir: Can anything be done about that?
Dialogue.D305F71340E677EEA1E59CB523FCC466_A_G_Fir: All you can do is defend the base by exterminating the threat.
Dialogue.A5C258A7454DD7C437FF248946C437AE_A_G_Fir: I am detecting increased Ruptura activity. Prepare yourselves for a wave.
Dialogue.346607F8469C21992E1DA996FDDD6EB6_A_E_Fir: Oh, no no no, already? Just like that?
Dialogue.346607F8469C21992E1DA996FDDD6EB6_A_S_Fir: A wave? Is that what I think it is?
Dialogue.0CE5DFD94EB5045083CB5294026713A2_A_G_Fir: I'll say no more, you need to live through this yourself. Or not live. Living is not mandatory.
Dialogue.0FE4DC9D47FCD63C1926A08142CA9B8F_A_E_Fir: I don't feel like dying. What am I supposed to do, Gal?
Dialogue.0FE4DC9D47FCD63C1926A08142CA9B8F_A_M_Fir: How can I minimize the risk?
Dialogue.0FE4DC9D47FCD63C1926A08142CA9B8F_A_P_Fir: Alright, Gal, what do I do?
Dialogue.A480D76F43279BB432F6B1BDF579DA48_A_G_Fir: In order to protect your sleeve from being incinerated I recommend watching Ruptura closely and remaining close to a safe place.
Dialogue.1D467FE7419F747321CC288C2F115598_A_E_Fir: Oh! Gal! Gal! I found a corpse!
Dialogue.E329F7A9474E328B8B67F3BDCCF1EC20_A_G_Fir: Arcadia-7 is one big graveyard. Bodies dry out quite quickly and the uniqueness of the soil has resulted in numerous bodies remaining on the surface.
Dialogue.E69EB3A3414CF3D487EEC2B53F44EFB1_A_E_Fir: Why haven't they been disposed of?
Dialogue.E69EB3A3414CF3D487EEC2B53F44EFB1_A_M_Fir: Why haven't they been disposed of?
Dialogue.E69EB3A3414CF3D487EEC2B53F44EFB1_A_P_Fir: Why haven't they been disposed of?
Dialogue.E69EB3A3414CF3D487EEC2B53F44EFB1_A_S_Fir: Why haven't they been disposed of?
Dialogue.0C0CE82B40DAFD1740E575B5DF29553C_A_G_Fir: Usually there was no one around to do it. These aren't empty sleeves.
Dialogue.89B870BA43F941E03EDC0F8697E0DDE9_A_E_Fir: What? You mean these are real corpses?
Dialogue.89B870BA43F941E03EDC0F8697E0DDE9_A_M_Fir: What? You mean these are real corpses?
Dialogue.89B870BA43F941E03EDC0F8697E0DDE9_A_P_Fir: What? You mean these are real corpses?
Dialogue.89B870BA43F941E03EDC0F8697E0DDE9_A_S_Fir: What? You mean these are real corpses?
Dialogue.7AC8166243B5667DEC41A4BDA5F6AA37_A_G_Fir: Exactly. The discs of these people were destroyed. They could not be moved to another sleeve. They are truly dead.
Dialogue.F329623A45BAC444297553A8E897DE25_A_E_Fir: So… so this is an actual dead person? Like their soul is gone? I think… I think I'm gonna puke.
Dialogue.F329623A45BAC444297553A8E897DE25_A_M_Fir: Those poor people. Most of them didn't know what they signed up for.
Dialogue.F329623A45BAC444297553A8E897DE25_A_P_Fir: This is the first time I'm seeing a real corpse! Just as I thought, it looks just like an empty sleeve. Nothing interesting about it.
Dialogue.7B3BCDB14A9942D2732264BC8D936C75_A_G_Fir: Good work. The cargo dispatcher and receiver are two devices that work with each other. Now you can send items between two distant points. This will surely help expand your production.
Dialogue.75ECA3D849C314DB958052A48947645F_A_M_Fir: This world is amazing. So many wonderful creatures.
Dialogue.75ECA3D849C314DB958052A48947645F_A_P_Fir: It looks like a crab. The highest stage of evolution, potential proof of the cancerization hypothesis. We should study it.
Dialogue.810754BC4AC5215312BC0CA31FECF51C_A_E_Fir: Oh, a Lorem Ipsum tablet! I had one just like that on Mars!
Dialogue.810754BC4AC5215312BC0CA31FECF51C_A_M_Fir: An old tablet. These things are really durable.
Dialogue.810754BC4AC5215312BC0CA31FECF51C_A_P_Fir: Ah, a Lorem Ipsum model. That really means these crews are old.
Dialogue.4547A9934E2E1122AC175DBEC73BC99E_A_G_Fir: Yes, due to its excessive durability, the Lorem Ipsum model was chosen as the standard for missions to Ruptura for decades. You'll probably find many more like this. I have synced your system with them. Any data found on the tablets will immediately download to your database.
Dialogue.7CACC1D445DD560A5183FE8459779FAF_A_E_Fir: Aaaah… What was that? I..I...I died. And now I'm..... here.
Dialogue.7CACC1D445DD560A5183FE8459779FAF_A_P_Fir: Wait, did I just die. What happened?
Dialogue.7CACC1D445DD560A5183FE8459779FAF_A_S_Fir: Oh god… I thought that was the end.
Dialogue.A8CF4CFE41462E953AE7348E214C2F44_A_G_Fir: A copy of your consciousness is always being sent to the last used Regeneration Chamber. Welcome to your new sleeve! The first one's free. Each one after that will of course be added to your debt.
Dialogue.39069FB149519AF99F91AAADBA8BCB31_A_E_Fir: That was the most fudged up thing I ever experienced. Never again.
Dialogue.39069FB149519AF99F91AAADBA8BCB31_A_M_Fir: A copy? Am I still me then?
Dialogue.39069FB149519AF99F91AAADBA8BCB31_A_P_Fir: Fascinating! So much data in such a short time. I even remember when my heart stopped! Impressive, I'll gladly learn more about this.
Dialogue.39069FB149519AF99F91AAADBA8BCB31_A_S_Fir: So my service will last forever.
Dialogue.A8F7630A49564FA6146426AFE4329C8D_A_G_E_F: I'm afraid "never" is too strong a word.
Dialogue.A8F7630A49564FA6146426AFE4329C8D_A_G_M_F: Unfortunately, I am not equipped for philosophical debates.
Dialogue.A8F7630A49564FA6146426AFE4329C8D_A_G_P_F: The technology is protected property of the Claywood Corporation.
Dialogue.A8F7630A49564FA6146426AFE4329C8D_A_G_S_F: Maybe not "forever", more like "as long as possible" and we hope it does!
Dialogue.5D5416454318BC88CCB1BD9356E9FBF0_A_G_Fir: Congratulations! You've just built the Weapon and Modification Station. You will now have access to a whole assortment of weapons!
Dialogue.FB54FB6D4F60C655A61002B976CBD6BF_A_G_Fir: Nothing's free, but don't worry, you won't need to spend a dime. Griffits will allow you to use War Bonds to buy new weapons.  You can find quite a few of them in the wallets of the fallen on Arcadia.
Dialogue.27579A41420AFF1DF30EF794D1D804EB_A_E_Fir: War Bonds? Aren't they supposed to be issued during times of war?
Dialogue.27579A41420AFF1DF30EF794D1D804EB_A_M_Fir: War Bonds. They've conquered the world and they still need to borrow money for imaginary conflicts. Pathetic.
Dialogue.27579A41420AFF1DF30EF794D1D804EB_A_P_Fir: War Bonds? They can't pay us with money? We're not at war, why the bonds?
Dialogue.27579A41420AFF1DF30EF794D1D804EB_A_S_Fir: War Bonds. Brings back memories from the army. I thought they were discontinued after winning the battle for Ceres.
Dialogue.0D96DAEA48F159F337588E8C9122F1B4_A_G_Fir: The Griffits Blue Corporation believes the world is in a constant state of war. War with the resistance.
Dialogue.412B66124AA482FAD1983FA082CB0863_A_M_Fir: What was that? I never heard of a species like that.
Dialogue.412B66124AA482FAD1983FA082CB0863_A_P_Fir: What were those creatures? They didn't look like anything from Earth.
Dialogue.13BF2DC24F5387987C26EBB61F155FB8_A_G_Fir: They're Vermin, the main threat on this planet.
Dialogue.DA980F7443C879FB68DB408407A7BF24_A_G_Fir: Most of the people that arrived on Arcadia-7 were eliminated by these creatures. Natural disasters you can prepare for, but Vermin are a bit more unpredictable.
Dialogue.FE13CAA84B58AF8D2E9A3B84C4634C63_A_E_Fir: Why didn't you warn us that we'd be fighting some overgrown… I don't even know what!
Dialogue.FE13CAA84B58AF8D2E9A3B84C4634C63_A_M_Fir: Another nightmare no one told us about. What were those creatures? Their behavior was similar to several species but classifying them at first glance seems impossible based on the taxonomies I know. Why didn't we get any information on them?
Dialogue.FE13CAA84B58AF8D2E9A3B84C4634C63_A_P_Fir: Hmmm… Strange organisms. They look like insects at first glance but they couldn't survive out here with this level of oxygen concentration. Is this some completely new species? Why don't I know anything about them? I know everything about this planet!
Dialogue.FE13CAA84B58AF8D2E9A3B84C4634C63_A_S_Fir: Why weren't we told about them?
Dialogue.77E3BA8E4F7912B17AC75CA8C102B1F4_A_G_Fir: The IRO imposed a TS-9 top secret clause on their existence. They made very sure no one ever found out about them. Aside from high-ranking officials, only people sent directly to the planet have ever learned of their existence.
Dialogue.5A899FE4465138020B97259A30274852_A_E_Fir: Claywood was here, you should've told us. You knew!
Dialogue.5A899FE4465138020B97259A30274852_A_M_Fir: Claywood was here, you should've told us. You knew.
Dialogue.5A899FE4465138020B97259A30274852_A_P_Fir: Claywood was here, you should've told us. You knew!
Dialogue.5A899FE4465138020B97259A30274852_A_S_Fir: Claywood was here, you should've told us. You knew.
Dialogue.16247F1D4A52945152CEDF933EB8CFA5_A_G_Fir: You have officially become a cook. On Arcadia-7 there were less than a hundred of you in total, so it's quite a prestigious honor.
Dialogue.EB53DA0344F33395FF33AE8CB9117D60_A_G_Fir: But you personally placed the ingredients into the food processor. That's more than most chefs do at some leading restaurants.
Dialogue.CFE3D3F24489B03968B51E998D27F79E_A_G_Fir: No more eating raw food! You can now process and combine various nutritional materials!
Dialogue.1E95D5E04368A4B1BBDE12B26588D4F4_A_E_Fir: I had something similar at home but when my subscription ended all I could make was algae bars and sourdough for borscht.
Dialogue.1E95D5E04368A4B1BBDE12B26588D4F4_A_M_Fir: A Food Station. Another way to demean the people who can't afford it. You can print any meal for the cost of a subscription and those who can't afford it are left with algae bars.
Dialogue.1E95D5E04368A4B1BBDE12B26588D4F4_A_P_Fir: Oh, a Food Station. Takes me back to my college days.
Dialogue.DD881DE24C7F7AA8DDC652A022F83FE1_A_G_Fir: Oh no, this is not a simple food station. This one is specially tailored to the conditions on Arcadia-7. All the recipes it contains are designed with the local environment in mind.
Dialogue.F37D674443C48BF3155FBAAF892851DD_A_E_Fir: So no chance for a chimichanga? That was my favorite recipe.
Dialogue.F37D674443C48BF3155FBAAF892851DD_A_M_Fir: That's nice of them. Alright, let's see what it can do.
Dialogue.F37D674443C48BF3155FBAAF892851DD_A_P_Fir: That means I'll be able to try the local flora! Amazing!
Dialogue.F37D674443C48BF3155FBAAF892851DD_A_S_Fir: So no chance for a chimichanga? That was my favorite recipe.
Dialogue.D84A8BB84595AB25EABD568BFB621016_A_G_S_F: No, but I'm sure something from the Food Station's extensive menu will be to your liking.
Dialogue.79A8982E4E669F9BAAAF72B1C559C96E_A_G_Fir: Threat detected. Level 4 Vermin. Retreat recommended.
Dialogue.5A5A1CDB44D90C24FFDDC1A083AA062D_A_P_Fir: It's big so it's probably slow.
Dialogue.F1FA7EE24085F14A77421CBAFFDFD5A3_A_G_Fir: It's a Grubbler. I know what you're going to ask. Yes, my analysis shows that it's 86% edible.
Dialogue.298131CA4B1DDA0E9B19A0AE942B7256_A_M_Fir: At this point I'm not even sure if you're not joking.
Dialogue.298131CA4B1DDA0E9B19A0AE942B7256_A_P_Fir: Exactly what I was going to ask. 86% is quite high.
Dialogue.9BF064434BF710D7D2D570AFB0869AE5_A_G_Fir: Critical decrease in vital signs detected.
Dialogue.B107418C4CF3E66ED625FAA415E9A363_A_G_Fir: Use the Medtool to heal yourself.
Dialogue.968ED378490A68104122FBB1E70960D5_A_G_Fir: Try to find and eat some Star Tears. It's a white-blue plant that grows in meteor craters.
Dialogue.648F033546F37653405017933CC08C31_A_G_Fir: This is Ignitium, a cosmic mineral that's good at storing heat but also releases it quickly. It can help you cool your base. But hurry, if not controlled it sublimates rapidly.
Dialogue.E7C9CF5949EA7BFE7B689BA222DEAD14_A_G_Fir: You've entered an infection cloud. Microorganisms from the Vermin are reacting with your equipment disrupting your shield.
Dialogue.895ED09547B343776D768F8E826562F7_A_P_Fir: That's what you get for using superconductive converters for defense. I once wrote a paper on the need to switch to transregulatory systems, but who'd listen to me?
Dialogue.895ED09547B343776D768F8E826562F7_A_S_Fir: So we need to fight exposed.
Dialogue.F20E38DD4FC6D407A4223BAE656CEB4C_A_M_Fir: An LEM, could come in handy.
Dialogue.F20E38DD4FC6D407A4223BAE656CEB4C_A_P_Fir: Is that what I think it is?
Dialogue.C32B398F458921CAEF794598B5C65B78_A_G_Fir: Now you'll be able to install LEMs in yourselves, which will enhance your abilities. Remember, the more often you perform a certain action, the easier it is for your mind to adapt to it. Only after some time will you be ready for modifications. We wouldn’t want your brains to get fried, right?
Dialogue.8B785D454D3D0C25CA56629010CCB51A_A_E_Fir: Darn, I always wanted to learn to play bass. If I found an LEM for that - ah, I'd still need to practice.
Dialogue.8B785D454D3D0C25CA56629010CCB51A_A_M_Fir: I understand, I will gather experience until I can use them.
Dialogue.8B785D454D3D0C25CA56629010CCB51A_A_P_Fir: Of course. You can't upload a disc into your brain and suddenly learn kung-fu.
Dialogue.8B785D454D3D0C25CA56629010CCB51A_A_S_Fir: I used them in the army. Why would I not be able to use them now?
Dialogue.38EE491A4771AEE30E52F5B7462A4361_A_G_E_F: That's the sad truth of life.
Dialogue.38EE491A4771AEE30E52F5B7462A4361_A_G_M_F: That way you won't fry your brain.
Dialogue.38EE491A4771AEE30E52F5B7462A4361_A_G_P_F: Oh, I didn't know you liked 20th century cinema.
Dialogue.38EE491A4771AEE30E52F5B7462A4361_A_G_S_F: Neural pathways tend to fade over time. We print your brain based on your most recent memories.
Dialogue.5C199D0E4D2048E09F429DB508611E84_A_G_Fir: Correct, a Limbic Enhancement Membrane. It increases the brain's capabilities. Once placed in the disc, it will improve your motor or cognitive skills.
Dialogue.324B4CE64F37A56C805FBE9E36DF06E5_A_E_Fir: I heard about this! Rich people install these so they don't have to sleep for three weeks. Very effective!
Dialogue.324B4CE64F37A56C805FBE9E36DF06E5_A_M_Fir: That's what I thought. You could feed a family for years for one of these things. And here they're just lying around.
Dialogue.324B4CE64F37A56C805FBE9E36DF06E5_A_P_Fir: Wonderful! Pushing what humanity is capable of to the limit!
Dialogue.324B4CE64F37A56C805FBE9E36DF06E5_A_S_Fir: Can't wait to install it. I miss the days when I was loaded with them. I always feel like I'm hungover without any.
Dialogue.DE7500A94216EE25086387806625081D_A_E_Fir: Thanks, Gal. Now it all makes sense.
Dialogue.DE7500A94216EE25086387806625081D_A_M_Fir: I see that. You know what I mean, Gal.
Dialogue.DE7500A94216EE25086387806625081D_A_P_Fir: I asked the wrong question. What function does it serve?
Dialogue.DE7500A94216EE25086387806625081D_A_S_Fir: I see that, but what is it?
Dialogue.0621D33B447A8B7ED7DFF99C405973F2_A_G_Fir: Unfortunately, all information on that subject is highly classified.
Dialogue.A5CFF55D45442DD7C339818B28BA75A9_A_G_Fir: Congratulations! You've now entered an area that was previously off limits! Thanks to the Forgotten Engine the atmosphere is filtering out cosmic radiation more effectively. This new area of Arcadia-7 is waiting to be explored and excavated! Be proud of what you've accomplished!
Dialogue.BE0F34F741B34D50E34138B2238A3A94_A_G_Fir: This is an Oxallop that grows at the bottom of water reservoirs. Some things you can only get at certain times. Observing how Arcadia changes might be the key to your mission.
Dialogue.2B60D8A741CAF45F8C6FEBBB3DB4217C_A_G_Fir: There are substances forming in the environmental conditions of Arcadia-7 that we can only dream of back on Earth. Powerium is a highly valuable resource. Try to find a way to use it.
Dialogue.16A605E64FEF7FE31E2DA89EB966748A_A_G_Fir: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger! Or ruins your kidneys. We won't know until you try it.
Dialogue.9D33C92F47F980754E51D687208C1E33_A_G_Fir: You've found a source of quartz, it's particularly rare on Arcadia. It can be used to create more advanced technology. Use it wisely, spectrographic analysis shows very limited deposits on the planet.
Dialogue.6741C6624B03C0268463D3B2BB6762DF_A_P_Fir: I feel like my bones hurt but they don't have any nerves.
Dialogue.B336ACF34E3F086689EB248672E24636_A_G_Fir: Cosmic radiation has reached a dangerous level. I suggest leaving the contaminated area.
Dialogue.25CAC7774679D88CB512D6BA9988A9D0_A_G_Fir: Congratulations! You can now unlock new functionality for your buildings at the Recipe Station!
Dialogue.53FB4EEA4DDCCC0AA6043BB395F64605_A_E_Fir: But the buildings can already do these things, why would we need to unlock anything?
Dialogue.53FB4EEA4DDCCC0AA6043BB395F64605_A_M_Fir: But the buildings can already do these things, why would we need to unlock anything?
Dialogue.53FB4EEA4DDCCC0AA6043BB395F64605_A_P_Fir: But the buildings can already do these things, why would we need to unlock anything?
Dialogue.53FB4EEA4DDCCC0AA6043BB395F64605_A_S_Fir: But the buildings can already do these things, why would we need to unlock anything?
Dialogue.0D52AE6048615D2AD319F68F7A79147D_A_G_Fir: Arcadia-7 is a very particular place full of specific resources and requirements. The buildings' programming needs to be updated as these requirements change, to avoid unnecessarily clogging up memory as well as transfer fees.
Dialogue.6C20E02A4C6734D1C8726199FA012003_A_E_Fir: It's the Claywood Corporation that determines the cost of transfer. You could lower the price and everything would go smoother.
Dialogue.6C20E02A4C6734D1C8726199FA012003_A_M_Fir: It's the Claywood Corporation that determines the cost of transfer. You could lower the price and everything would go smoother.
Dialogue.6C20E02A4C6734D1C8726199FA012003_A_P_Fir: It's the Claywood Corporation that determines the cost of transfer. You could lower the price and everything would go smoother.
Dialogue.6C20E02A4C6734D1C8726199FA012003_A_S_Fir: It's the Claywood Corporation that determines the cost of transfer. You could lower the price and everything would go smoother.
Dialogue.2E59688C4B248BCFBDD64FB7F57552FD_A_G_Fir: I'll respond with one of Mr. Claywood's favorite sayings: "This is exactly why you're not the richest person in the world."
Dialogue.AA8DDD8B4BDB4F2578C0868C9C0470A4_A_G_Fir: You will now be able to reverse the manufacturing process and reclaim all of the materials used.
Dialogue.FBFB57C242C9898B156F6F8D7937E375_A_E_Fir: Is this the same machine that was used to destroy the belongings of criminals in order to profit off of them? My aunt lost a lot of souvenirs that way.
Dialogue.FBFB57C242C9898B156F6F8D7937E375_A_M_Fir: I read an article about this machine. It was created to quickly clean up after a massacre and make use of resources from conquered territories.
Dialogue.FBFB57C242C9898B156F6F8D7937E375_A_P_Fir: A very useful device, it greatly sped up the process of re-distributing wartime loot.
Dialogue.FBFB57C242C9898B156F6F8D7937E375_A_S_Fir: A very useful device, it greatly sped up the process of re-distributing wartime loot.
Dialogue.0CFB665E43647F808F9B0BAA79EE1D21_A_G_Fir: And now you can use it for peaceful purposes. Remember that the clothes iron was also invented to torture prisoners, and yet you've used it to iron clothes, right?
Dialogue.DD1AAEE7443691D87F39DE8F095F881E_A_E_Fir: I'm pretty sure that's not true.
Dialogue.DD1AAEE7443691D87F39DE8F095F881E_A_M_Fir: I'm pretty sure that's not true.
Dialogue.DD1AAEE7443691D87F39DE8F095F881E_A_P_Fir: I'm pretty sure that's not true.
Dialogue.DD1AAEE7443691D87F39DE8F095F881E_A_S_Fir: I'm pretty sure that's not true.
Dialogue.17D0694C4FA1381348D64D926BD9643F_A_G_Fir: Watch out for the red plants.
Dialogue.A45DF3024F429636EDEDB6B80A23031B_A_M_Fir: In the future, try to warn me before I walk into something.
Dialogue.A45DF3024F429636EDEDB6B80A23031B_A_P_Fir: For a super advanced artificial intelligence you're surprisingly slow with your warnings.
Dialogue.4B68D8BC481DF5C63CDA5298319E2A6B_A_G_Fir: Your printing point has been updated. When you happen to die I will send your mind here and this is where your sleeve will be printed.
Dialogue.9688EAAD4DC8134E5DE1E18DF1210810_A_G_Fir: Apologies, if you happen to die.
Dialogue.9AF9138A4F4CD37752480C8AFD0D5416_A_E_Fir: Wow! Everything has started to grow back. It's beautiful!
Dialogue.9AF9138A4F4CD37752480C8AFD0D5416_A_M_Fir: Incredible. Each blade of grass is growing back. As if Arcadia was given a second chance.
Dialogue.9AF9138A4F4CD37752480C8AFD0D5416_A_P_Fir: Incredible. Despite such high temperatures, everything here immediately grows back. Fascinating.
Dialogue.0356D92346BCD4EB3BF7C5803933A132_A_G_Fir: Every piece of organic matter on this planet has adapted to the star's explosions. You'll see this miracle again many times.
Dialogue.3A214F3348C27AC2000980A30F5610BD_A_G_Fir: I'm detecting a caustic hydrogen sulphide gas. I recommend moving away from the gas immediately.
Dialogue.5312CB14464A2B0A032C56987E22C360_A_M_Fir: Oh god, that was very strange.
Dialogue.17F020E14F65DEE4B7A6E483E33D16AE_A_G_Fir: Everyone reported the same feeling during testing. Don't worry, you'll get used to it. Now there are no limits! You can travel across the planet at the speed of light!
Dialogue.6DEB8242468755FD477F01BB31DDF46A_A_M_Fir: Such advanced life in these conditions? Incredible.
Dialogue.2A2F74E94183015FB452FCAB0A278944_A_G_Fir: It's a Vulpir. A mammal native to Arcadia-7. Technically it doesn't fulfill all of the requirements of being a mammal but new definitions haven't been written for Arcadia yet.
Dialogue.4439D8914ECCB68357B1959E39C14220_A_P_Fis: I will save you with science.
Dialogue.21A698A04DE288676014C2AF6F66287C_A_P_Gas: The mask won't filter this out.
Dialogue.5190961F46AEF815255373A8A6B85166_A_P_Gas: This gas can damage my brain.
Dialogue.0F042E1B459DA4D8D01F34AE855E3B73_A_G_Geo: To function properly it requires access to some form of terrain imaging. Look through your available tasks, there should be a corporation that can provide you with something to assist.
Dialogue.5D8F81F640EBB9ABECB868AE1BEBA7CD_A_M_Gol: The bigger they are the harder they fall.
Dialogue.56F72365418F3A5E62C76E9E780FFCB2_A_P_Gol: You didn't stand a chance against the power of my brain.
Dialogue.67A6E9224CC8BCDD341749B2BACB1B9C_A_G_Gri: The Griffits Blue Corporation is grateful for all of your shipments. Remember that supporting this particular company will allow you to upgrade your arsenal, which will certainly help in surviving on Arcadia.
Dialogue.027943AD4F2B7233C36B0B8951BECEF3_A_G_Gri: The Griffits Blue Corporation has received its order. They are very happy with your services but have a few questions and would like to know if you'll participate in an anonymous survey.
Dialogue.7FE810184F2FF1B057D32BA792C6C903_A_G_Gri: On a scale of 1 to 5 how safe do you feel during your stay on Arcadia?
Dialogue.B50BCB014186C64AC84BFA8F351F1F28_A_E_Gri: Let's see. An exploding star that destroys everything in its path. Aliens that keep attacking me. And convicted criminals for neighbors. Two. I lived in Detroit once.
Dialogue.B50BCB014186C64AC84BFA8F351F1F28_A_M_Gri: Zero. Death is around every corner. I know how their propaganda works so make a note that no weapon can raise that score.
Dialogue.B50BCB014186C64AC84BFA8F351F1F28_A_P_Gri: Starting with five as the base value, I subtract one point for Ruptura, the fact the ecosystem was not adjusted to allow my species to live comfortably, the aggressive Vermin and proximity to convicted criminals. But I'm adding points for the great equipment and unlimited printing of new sleeves. So five.
Dialogue.B50BCB014186C64AC84BFA8F351F1F28_A_S_Gri: Not really to be honest, but the gear is solid. Three.
Dialogue.E44C4B024A96DCF895E364A84AE5983C_A_G_P_G: Noted. They'll be very happy with that answer.
Dialogue.E44C4B024A96DCF895E364A84AE5983C_A_G_S_G: Noted. They won't be happy with that answer.
Dialogue.1EFA14D94898BB6DDA15B7A43554F690_A_G_S_G: Congratulations. With another order fulfilled you were able to increase your trust level within the Griffits Blue Corporation. They are very grateful.
Dialogue.E664AAA344DBE329E7D85E9D4CC1E446_A_E_Gri: Are they so grateful they'll stop supporting a criminal regime?
Dialogue.E664AAA344DBE329E7D85E9D4CC1E446_A_M_Gri: I never felt as dirty as I do working for them.
Dialogue.E664AAA344DBE329E7D85E9D4CC1E446_A_P_Gri: Gratitude won't do me any good here, I need rewards.
Dialogue.E664AAA344DBE329E7D85E9D4CC1E446_A_S_Gri: Working with them is an honor.
Dialogue.38E5567F461A175848DC99992AC3CCEE_A_G_E_G: I wouldn't count on it, but you never know…
Dialogue.38E5567F461A175848DC99992AC3CCEE_A_G_M_G: Maybe your rewards in the terminal will help you get clean.
Dialogue.38E5567F461A175848DC99992AC3CCEE_A_G_P_G: They just happen to be waiting for you in the terminal.
Dialogue.38E5567F461A175848DC99992AC3CCEE_A_G_S_G: They are certainly as honored to be working with you!
Dialogue.BD875E014EC3921B79C09A808ECBBE7F_A_G_Gri: Excellent. The reward from the Griffits Blue Corporation is already waiting for you. You'll like this.
Dialogue.74C3401140A26F8F87583E90C77C6CD5_A_G_Gri: Griffits is very happy with your services. They've provided a special motivational message just for you!
Dialogue.CB356F2C473FBB73851B7C8309B0A134_A_G_Gri: CHAOS. DEATH. DESTRUCTION. These things have gone away and been forgotten thanks to people like you! Every item sent is potentially one less rebel! Every part received is another step towards world peace!
Dialogue.29D487EA43F4EEDD9EA4EA8D03848EE5_A_E_Gri: They didn't record this just for me, I heard the same message at every factory I worked at.
Dialogue.29D487EA43F4EEDD9EA4EA8D03848EE5_A_M_Gri: I agreed to do this only because you promised the equipment we send would not be used directly to fight the resistance movement. Don't tell me they recorded this propaganda just for us because they would've taken that into account.
Dialogue.29D487EA43F4EEDD9EA4EA8D03848EE5_A_P_Gri: Sounds pretty generic. If they had recorded it just for us they would have mentioned Arcadia or Ruptura.
Dialogue.29D487EA43F4EEDD9EA4EA8D03848EE5_A_S_Gri: I heard that exact same message when I was stationed as security for the moon colony.
Dialogue.894D3D8943C8CC02FC0B458BD1B7E793_A_G_Gri: I am not authorized to confirm your accusations. But keep working, seeing your work I am convinced that one beautiful day they will record something just for you!
Dialogue.0AFB3DF84B8CA44ABF83F3993253775F_A_G_Gri: Bravo! The Griffits Blue Corporation has received your shipment and would like to conduct another survey.
Dialogue.B22C823442E4B20F054A4DB0D96D21C8_A_P_Gri: Always happy to help with research.
Dialogue.17D480AF4CADBEEF280CADAD228D2031_A_G_Gri: What should be done with members of the resistance movement? A. They should all die. B. They should all be sent to penal colonies. C. The resistance movement is so incompetent it will destroy itself.
Dialogue.18ED4DBA4DF6F9C0C46511A0430A0CB2_A_P_Gri: It's B, of course. That's the only way they can still be useful to society.
Dialogue.18ED4DBA4DF6F9C0C46511A0430A0CB2_A_S_Gri: He who spreads death should be condemned to it. A.
Dialogue.0792B79E439D40B2CBA666805808CD03_A_G_M_G: In that case I'll choose a random answer. You've answered A. They should all die.
Dialogue.0792B79E439D40B2CBA666805808CD03_A_G_P_G: They told me to say that's a good answer but there was a better one.
Dialogue.60583ED344A3A2D43BDEE39009299634_A_G_Gri: You've reached another level with Griffits! Have you thought about a new weapon? Or maybe you'll upgrade something you already have?
Dialogue.B68239BD45B23DB51955FBB84AF95673_A_E_Gri: I haven't thought about it yet.
Dialogue.B68239BD45B23DB51955FBB84AF95673_A_M_Gri: I haven't thought about it yet.
Dialogue.B68239BD45B23DB51955FBB84AF95673_A_P_Gri: I haven't thought about it yet.
Dialogue.B68239BD45B23DB51955FBB84AF95673_A_S_Gri: I haven't thought about it yet.
Dialogue.532EA1D043BFBC0FC063A5A2D578948C_A_G_Gri: I recommend investing some Bonds in the Reaper. It's the preferred rifle for the 12 to 114 age group.
Dialogue.FD4B27144792467BDA2D2487F889DC91_A_G_Gri: Wonderful! Griffits thanks you for the shipment and encourages you to search Arcadia to find abandoned Bond discs.
Dialogue.1793744346B673E375494F8E7942BFCF_A_E_Gri: I'm assuming that just putting them on the market will somehow influence the company's stock?
Dialogue.1793744346B673E375494F8E7942BFCF_A_M_Gri: I'm assuming that just putting them on the market will somehow influence the company's stock?
Dialogue.1793744346B673E375494F8E7942BFCF_A_P_Gri: I'm assuming that just putting them on the market will somehow influence the company's stock?
Dialogue.1793744346B673E375494F8E7942BFCF_A_S_Gri: I'm assuming that just putting them on the market will somehow influence the company's stock?
Dialogue.661D8D364BB09D49A82C77AF0DA3E823_A_G_Gri: Barely, if at all. But it will definitely help you create more weapons. So that you can better defend yourself against revolutionaries.
Dialogue.7434F7E443E54ACE393FADAC8C0BD3BE_A_E_Gri: They can't cut down on the propaganda even for this mission?
Dialogue.7434F7E443E54ACE393FADAC8C0BD3BE_A_M_Gri: Disgusting. If anything, a weapon should be used to defend against real threats.
Dialogue.D671B483460BFAD59109C988538FF0C9_A_G_Gri: I'm just reading what they wrote.
Dialogue.275B27A14BC6160DC0C2FFA0E493C630_A_G_Gri: The Griffits Blue Corporation has received your shipment. In addition to granting you your promised reward they would like to ask you to say a few nice words about the company. They'll use them in a future press release.
Dialogue.F0F7D3374887166641A2FA9FA2B096EF_A_E_Gri: Sure. It's best to shoot space jerks with Griffits Blue Corp weapons?
Dialogue.F0F7D3374887166641A2FA9FA2B096EF_A_M_Gri: I won't be their puppet. I'm doing what they told me to do as best I can. I won't advertise their weapons too.
Dialogue.F0F7D3374887166641A2FA9FA2B096EF_A_P_Gri: That's not part of my responsibilities.
Dialogue.3B3B2B5A4B7ED9EBE3F9318854046E80_A_G_Gri: Griffits thanks you for your recommendation.
Dialogue.92053E494871EC9EA729C2ADF6C37528_: Another level! New rewards from Griffits are waiting to be claimed.
Dialogue.8266886D48B6FF51B60DCC957EF6B740_A_G_Gri: Another task for Griffits has been completed! I have a surprise for you. I sent a special request on your behalf to the Griffits Blue Corporation and they've answered it.
Dialogue.B1F79E5C4F88F7E52936B4804ECB4E0D_A_G_E_G: Dear E4101, CHAOS. DEATH. DESTRUCTION. These things have gone away and been forgotten thanks to…
Dialogue.B1F79E5C4F88F7E52936B4804ECB4E0D_A_G_M_G: Dear B1690, CHAOS. DEATH. DESTRUCTION. These things have gone away and been forgotten thanks to…
Dialogue.B1F79E5C4F88F7E52936B4804ECB4E0D_A_G_P_G: Dear P0212, CHAOS. DEATH. DESTRUCTION. These things have gone away and been forgotten thanks to…
Dialogue.B1F79E5C4F88F7E52936B4804ECB4E0D_A_G_S_G: Dear S8466, CHAOS. DEATH. DESTRUCTION. These things have gone away and been forgotten thanks to…
