Dialogue.0EB978E74D196F7CA8C093AB19F2894F_A_G_E_T: We are glad you like it. Arcadia can be beautiful compared to other celestial bodies.
Dialogue.0EB978E74D196F7CA8C093AB19F2894F_A_G_M_T: The Claywood Corporation's latest technological advancements ensure maximum safety. History will not repeat itself.
Dialogue.0EB978E74D196F7CA8C093AB19F2894F_A_G_P_T: Technically you are not a pioneer. A lot of people have been to Arcadia before you.
Dialogue.0EB978E74D196F7CA8C093AB19F2894F_A_G_S_T: The Claywood Corporation spares no expense to ensure its workers are safe during their mission.
Dialogue.0EC4A28544F6BEA424FD22A96A1D1484_A_E_Tut: Though I have this nagging feeling I'll regret saying that.
Dialogue.0EC4A28544F6BEA424FD22A96A1D1484_A_M_Tut: Corporate bullcrap. You've changed, I remember you weren't always like this.
Dialogue.0EC4A28544F6BEA424FD22A96A1D1484_A_P_Tut: That was a long time ago and besides, the quality of their research and observations was embarrassing. You need someone who'll notice the important things. Like Darwin on the Galapagos Islands, but better.
Dialogue.0EC4A28544F6BEA424FD22A96A1D1484_A_S_Tut: I understand that, but wouldn't it make more sense to send someone who is familiar with workplace safety and broad survival skills? My expertise is limited mostly to combat.
Dialogue.8733EF224FB6DFC03CA8B8864FC1E444_A_G_E_T: I am unable to predict your feelings but if I can give you some advice, I suggest enjoying the moment while it lasts.
Dialogue.8733EF224FB6DFC03CA8B8864FC1E444_A_G_M_T: You have me confused with someone else. I am GAL. Your Galactic Assistance Liaison, and this is the first time we have met.
Dialogue.8733EF224FB6DFC03CA8B8864FC1E444_A_G_P_T: I'm glad but I will also remind you of your resource-gathering duties.
Dialogue.8733EF224FB6DFC03CA8B8864FC1E444_A_G_S_T: We are aware. Mr. Claywood has carefully studied all of your histories. You will have a chance to prove your worth.
Dialogue.8DB7FCB94164294C10EE08975A158684_A_G_Tut: The shipment has arrived! You've just proven you're useful which means the corporation trusts you a little bit more. You've acquired new schematics. Go ahead, claim your reward.
Dialogue.9C8928784D5255E779B07A9B9A45D956_A_G_Tut: We're nearing the end of our training, please answer the following questions.
Dialogue.BDEA960C466D1D0E13745195F0D65122_A_G_Tut: On a scale of one to ten, how anxious does being incinerated alive make you feel?
Dialogue.A716D05F4CBDB4FEA9E7B8AF64891D77_A_E_Tut: I can't think of a worse way to die. So on a scale from one to ten it's a solid three.
Dialogue.A716D05F4CBDB4FEA9E7B8AF64891D77_A_M_Tut: That's probably one of the worst possible ways to die. Nine.
Dialogue.A716D05F4CBDB4FEA9E7B8AF64891D77_A_P_Tut: Since this is the first question, to establish a good baseline I will answer five.
Dialogue.A716D05F4CBDB4FEA9E7B8AF64891D77_A_S_Tut: I can think of worse ways to go. Six.
Dialogue.3AA5C2D14CE209DE9B9689BE60D95F19_A_G_Tut: Understood. On a scale of one to ten how afraid are you of arachnids about a meter in diameter?
Dialogue.DDDF163240B11F6B8F277C9A0E2D740C_A_M_Tut: These questions are starting to upset me.
Dialogue.DDDF163240B11F6B8F277C9A0E2D740C_A_P_Tut: It's unnerving how specific that question is.
Dialogue.DDDF163240B11F6B8F277C9A0E2D740C_A_S_Tut: These questions are starting to worry me.
Dialogue.5FE806824384375D69E0CB9E4BC20A4B_A_G_Tut: There's no need! Questions never killed anyone!
Dialogue.027076654491680549003BAE9A421EF6_A_G_Tut: Welcome to Arcadia-7 in the Ruptura system!
Dialogue.054083604180802DC25ED7AEACCC2B80_A_G_Tut: The goal of this training is to teach you to effectively acquire and produce goods for our clients. However, we'll begin with something simpler.
Dialogue.2197E9724D6977C358C433A147E53856_A_G_E_T: Prisoner E4101, welcome to Arcadia-7! You've chosen to skip the recommended onboarding training. At the Claywood Corporation, we value that kind of confidence! I’m looking forward to working with you!
Dialogue.2197E9724D6977C358C433A147E53856_A_G_M_T: Prisoner B1690, welcome to Arcadia-7! You've chosen to skip the recommended onboarding training. At the Claywood Corporation, we value that kind of confidence! I’m looking forward to working with you!
Dialogue.2197E9724D6977C358C433A147E53856_A_G_P_T: Prisoner P0212, welcome to Arcadia-7! You've chosen to skip the recommended onboarding training. At the Claywood Corporation, we value that kind of confidence! I’m looking forward to working with you!
Dialogue.2197E9724D6977C358C433A147E53856_A_G_S_T: Prisoner S8466, welcome to Arcadia-7! You've chosen to skip the recommended onboarding training. At the Claywood Corporation, we value that kind of confidence! I’m looking forward to working with you!
Dialogue.FD91755144D4DEE6D8E8B88C2F3B9FCA_A_M_Unl: Created to take life en masse. Now it'll save a few.
Dialogue.FD91755144D4DEE6D8E8B88C2F3B9FCA_A_P_Unl: Hmm… I see some possible modifications.
Dialogue.D93AEF7647DB87BCB37493967AC9EC4E_A_E_Unl: Frackin' A! I love gear like this. Let's go flying.
Dialogue.D93AEF7647DB87BCB37493967AC9EC4E_A_M_Unl: Another toy. It looks quite handy. What do we need a drone for, Gal?
Dialogue.D93AEF7647DB87BCB37493967AC9EC4E_A_P_Unl: This looks very interesting. I see a lot of uses for this device.
Dialogue.D93AEF7647DB87BCB37493967AC9EC4E_A_S_Unl: A drone. Very good, it'll be great for recon.
Dialogue.EBB3D64B4C88538F7309529A304F2531_A_G_Unl: This specialized drone has a built-in Building Tool. You can now start building from a completely different perspective. You're only limited by its range. Go ahead, try it out!
Dialogue.A3F0436B4ACA525321AAF5A1A4686EBD_A_G_Unl: I'm legally obligated to go over grenade training with you.
Dialogue.84A16D4E48B338F3AB4C4BB439C2117E_A_E_Unl: We have to go through training even out here? Skip it, Gal, we won't tell anyone.
Dialogue.84A16D4E48B338F3AB4C4BB439C2117E_A_M_Unl: I understand. If we must we must. I'm listening.
Dialogue.84A16D4E48B338F3AB4C4BB439C2117E_A_P_Unl: I don't know if there's anything you can say that I don't already know.
Dialogue.84A16D4E48B338F3AB4C4BB439C2117E_A_S_Unl: I know how to use them. But I understand, orders are orders.
Dialogue.5B355F0740BBA029B8B963B1225ECFE8_A_G_Unl: The Griffits Blue Corporation guarantees the highest level of safety during use - even when activated the grenade is stable and will not explode as long as you are holding it in your hand, making it safe to use by the whole family regardless of age. The Griffits Blue Corporation is not responsible for any bodily harm caused by the throwing, or dropping of the grenade.
Dialogue.2B26858B4845C5CFA3F2E3AD57812C31_A_G_Unl: You know that feeling when you accidentally get hit by a car? Jumping out of a helicopter didn't go according to plan? Or maybe you were bored playing with a gun and you shot your kneecap?
Dialogue.686D18604AC1E3D27CAA9BA326C6C5D7_A_G_Unl: Those problems are over! You don't need a new expensive sleeve anymore! Future Health Solutions introduces the Medtool! It will heal any wound in seconds! Future Health Solutions for modern problems.
Dialogue.6B279CF74946EA815377579F15BB1391_A_M_Unl: Even I have to admit they did good by us. I would dream of having easy access to a Medtool back at my job. But why didn't you just say what it was outright?
Dialogue.6B279CF74946EA815377579F15BB1391_A_P_Unl: So it's just medicine to heal wounds. A good device.
Dialogue.6B279CF74946EA815377579F15BB1391_A_S_Unl: So it was an ad. Either way, this will help.
Dialogue.190631D142FF7762D7DFF3BD59F45DED_A_G_Unl: I'm sorry. Contracts with Future Health Solutions require I do things a certain way.
Dialogue.1A555848494C3C42EFEFF0865F018BA2_A_G_Unl: You've just unlocked the UPP-7. We hope it will help you better deal with the planet's dangers.
Dialogue.5B3F2857433D97A9A42B6C92E09AA139_A_E_Unl: Wonderful! You know what would've been even more wonderful? If we had it when we first met the Vermin!
Dialogue.5B3F2857433D97A9A42B6C92E09AA139_A_M_Unl: I never thought I'd be glad to see a gun. Gal, how are you only giving it to us now?
Dialogue.5B3F2857433D97A9A42B6C92E09AA139_A_P_Unl: Hmm. I'll need to learn to use this. In the future, you might consider adding basic weapons training.
Dialogue.5B3F2857433D97A9A42B6C92E09AA139_A_S_Unl: Good weapon. I used it back at the academy. Why are you only giving it to us now?
Dialogue.C56BC2694585465610E23591613730F4_A_E_Unl: Wonderful! And, um, why would we need it on a peaceful mission?
Dialogue.C56BC2694585465610E23591613730F4_A_M_Unl: Gal, what dangers do you have in mind? This is a peaceful mission, and in the documents I had access to, I don't remember seeing anything about a predator species on the planet. Aside from us…
Dialogue.C56BC2694585465610E23591613730F4_A_P_Unl: Hmm. I guess I'll need to learn to use this. In the future, you might consider adding basic weapons training.
Dialogue.C56BC2694585465610E23591613730F4_A_S_Unl: Good weapon. I used it back at the academy. Why are you giving it to us? This is a peaceful mission.
Dialogue.506CAC65487555594362AE8C791D73B7_A_G_Unl: Arcadia-7 still has some surprises left in store for you.

DT_DL_Spam.D_Football_02_Content:
Diego: Nie uwierzysz, co mi napisała laska z HR-u! Chcą nam obciąć pensje przez ten mecz!
Joel: Co???
Diego: Twierdzą, że to marnowanie ich czasu i nie płacą nam za obijanie się. Chyba chcą zwolnić kierownika.
Joel: Skąd w ogóle o tym wiedzą?
Diego: Z mojego maila do żony.
Joel: To jest naruszenie prywatnej korespondencji! Pozwij ich!
Diego: Daj spokój, nie wygram z prawnikami korporacji…
Joel: Gnoje.
DT_DL_Spam.D_Tasting_01_Content:
Hana: Przeglądałam notatki z badań i natknęłam się na zapis o "badaniach organoleptycznych". Czy to oznacza to, co myślę? Kim, chcesz się z tego wytłumaczyć?
Kim: Spokojnie, nie zjadłem próbki, tylko ją polizałem ;)
Hana: Procedury surowo zabraniają spożywania pokarmów obcego pochodzenia do momentu dokładnego przebadania i zatwierdzenia przez Dział Badań i Patentów. Tym razem skończy się tylko na ostrzeżeniu, ale w przyszłości proszę trzymać się zasad.
Kim: Procedury to nie wszystko. Jesteśmy ludźmi na obcej planecie! Powinniśmy doświadczać tego świata! Powinniśmy spróbować zrobić obiad z tutejszych warzyw. Poznawać smaki, zapachy, faktury… Kto nie ryzykuje, ten nie wygrywa :)
Hana: Gdy "doświadczenie" da ci trzydniową sraczkę, nie przychodź do mnie z płaczem. A teraz proszę o nowy raport z badań.
DT_DL_Spam.D_Football_01_Content:
Od: Diego Gonzales
Do: Maria Gonzales

Cześć kochanie!
Przepraszam, że tak długo się nie odzywałem. Jestem zawalony robotą. Na szczęście kierownik zauważył, że zespół zaraz padnie z przepracowania i zorganizował dla nas mecz! 
Bieganie po nierównym boisku w kombinezonie nie jest łatwe i żałuj, że nie widziałaś bramkarza! Musieliśmy przerwać ze względu na falę ognia, ale gdyby nie to, moja drużyna by wygrała! Skończyło się na remisie, ale byliśmy akurat w ofensywie, gdy rozbrzmiały alarmy! Szkoda, że bramki się stopiły… Nie bawiłem się tak dobrze od miesięcy.
Ucałuj ode mnie Mateo i napisz, co u was.
Diego

Enc_Building.Analyzer_chapt1:
A prototype of the Analyzing Station was developed by the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> during one of the first missions to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> which made it capable of analyzing samples of unusual composition from the start. A perfected commercial version was approved for use during extrasolar missions by the highest scientific commission of the IRO in 2148. In reality, it was already being used on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> much earlier than that, but only for the purposes of the company's own internal testing.

The device performs qualitative, quantitative, and structural analysis of the collected sample using a range of chemical, physicochemical, and biochemical methods. It determines the properties of the sample and the percentage of each component, being able to identify both organic and inorganic compounds (e.g. metals). If an edible biological sample is detected, it determines its nutritional information such as the amount of protein, fat, sugar, and dietary fiber it contains.
Enc_Building.Analyzer_chapt2:
The Analyzing Station from the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> helped identify <link id="Powerium">Powerium</>, a previously unknown element that does not exist in the Solar System. It made up 12.8% of all resources exported from <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> in 2149.

After leaving the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</>, the Analyzing Station found use primarily in the highly specialized research centers established beyond Earth. It is also utilized during missions to external planets by people who hope to discover new resources. On Earth, the Station is rarely used; cheaper and simpler devices are entirely sufficient for the laboratories operating there.
Enc_Building.Analyzer_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

An automatic Analyzing Station. It processes a sample of unidentified matter and displays the results of its analysis.
Enc_Building.Armory_chapt1:
The <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> is the largest manufacturer of weapons, vehicles and advanced military technology in the world. It provides equipment to the <link id="IRO">IRO</> army as well as patrol and fighter ships to the space marines. In 2146, it sent its first EUS units to <link id="Arkadia-7">Arcadia-7</>.

The machine can print the following models: the UPP-7 pistol, the SLAMS-12 shotgun, the MAR-9 "Phantom" assault rifle and the M175 "GRIM" machine gun. The weapons and their upgrades can be unlocked using "war bonds". These are acquired by completing orders for the <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> or by finding them in abandoned bases from previous expeditions. War bonds have been an internal form of currency at the company for decades.
Enc_Building.Armory_chapt2: The Equipment Upgrade Station was created specifically to support bases established on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, which were under unexpected and aggressive attacks by the <link id="Aliens">Vermin</>. Considering the conditions found on the Moon or Mars, civilian access to weapons there would not only be ill-advised but could be extremely dangerous and irresponsible. Although skirmishes with the aliens do not qualify as a full-scale war, the <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> has created its machines to require war bonds in order to operate. In this way, the corporation maintains its control over the weapons market.
Enc_Building.Armory_header:
A <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> patent.

A 3D printer for firearms. It offers four weapon models and their upgrades.
Enc_Building.Assembler_chapt1:
Space colonies would not survive without a stable and safe source of power. Aside from advanced electricity generators, other elements of the infrastructure are also important. That's why in 2094, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> developed the Assembler, a moderately advanced device for producing the components for a power grid and electrical accessories.

Thanks to the Assembler, space colonies can quickly create the elements they need - whether it's to expand their bases or to replace old or damaged components. The Recipe Station contains standardized models which will easily work with the machines and buildings of various manufacturers.
Enc_Building.Assembler_chapt2: The electrical components created by the Assembler meet the EL45-CI standard and can be safely used in industrial installations operating in extraterrestrial conditions. The machine was also a popular device on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> where stable power and access to specific elements could decide between life and True Death. The components are created with the highest precision and the repeatability rate of the manufactured elements is 99.8%.
Enc_Building.Assembler_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An advanced manufacturing machine. It produces power grid elements.
Enc_Building.BaseCore_chapt1:
In 2145, after becoming acquainted with the conditions on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, the Space Committee announced a competition to create a device that would neutralize the effects of the solar explosions on any infrastructure built on the surface of the planet as much as possible. Requirements included the generation of a protective force field, ensuring the stability of the power grid and the filtering out of cosmic radiation.

Five companies entered the competition: the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</>, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</>, Project: Future, Patel Conquest and the Guāng Company. Three of the initial proposals advanced to the next stage and prototypes were tested during the first research missions. The machine from Patel Conquest was the least successful as it malfunctioned during a <link id="Star_wave">Fire Wave</> resulting in the total obliteration of the base. Shortly after this fiasco the company went bankrupt.

Ultimately, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> emerged as the winner. The Base Core of their design received 84 points out of 100 in a document summarizing the competition. In 2147, the highest scientific commission of the IRO allowed it to be used on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>. The protective shield decreased the rate at which <link id="Habitat">Habitats</> degraded. They used to get destroyed after three waves but the first version of the Base Core extended the life of a building to 7-8 waves. Currently an improved version is being used on the planet that, when used in conjunction with the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</>, provides 99.9% protection.
Enc_Building.BaseCore_chapt2:
The Base Core functionality was inspired by how Earth's thick atmosphere and magnetic field protect it from high-energy cosmic radiation. However, the machine's effect had to be strengthened by several thousand percent in comparison to that natural phenomena. The sun reaches its maximum every 11 years, while <link id="Ruptura">Ruptura</> does so in irregular intervals which can range from several days to just a few hours. The energy from the plasma explosion on Ruptura reaches the surface of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> in minutes. And while the strength of magnetic storms on Earth is measured on a 5-point scale, on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> they reach levels between G9 and G12.

After the missions to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> stopped, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> ceased the Base Core production. Only recently, with the new mission, did they start to be used again.
Enc_Building.BaseCore_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

The central point of the base. Critical infrastructure allowing for the creation of other buildings and protecting them from Ruptura's explosions.
Enc_Building.BasePlatform_chapt1:
The surface of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> is varied and uneven, that is why the Platform system from the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> is vital to base building. The Platforms, held up by supports and columns, stand above the rocks and sinkholes creating an even foundation on which buildings can easily be constructed. Keep in mind, however, the maximum weight capacity of the Platform.

Stairs, ladders and railings allow for the creation of any walkway configuration which can then be used to comfortably move above the difficult terrain. Although the Platforms were created for <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, they have found use in bases on other planets as well. The company continued to develop the product which is why the new mission to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> has access to an improved version.
Enc_Building.BasePlatform_chapt2: The Platforms are equipped with an electrical system which allows for power to be connected between buildings without the need for additional electrical infrastructure. Color-coded indicators show power levels: green means the system is fully powered, red means power levels are too low. In the case of the latter, additional power sources need to be connected, such as a Solar Generator or a Wind Turbine. The Platforms are designed to guarantee the user's safety - one can walk on them without fear of electrocution.
Enc_Building.BasePlatform_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A modular platform system. It can be used to build roads, erect buildings and transfer electricity.
Enc_Building.BasicExporter_chapt1:
Delivery drones with high weight capacity from <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> caused a revolution in the sector of space logistics. They allow for cargo to be transported without the need for roads to be built on alien planets - and the version with longer range can even transport cargo between worlds. These specialized unmanned ships are the backbone of an optimal supply chain.

The Orbital Cargo Launcher is equipped with space transport drones. They have a tracking system and an anti-collision mechanism which guarantee the drones do not crash into asteroids, each other or any other obstacle. A reinforced shell protects the cargo from radiation and the extreme conditions that exist in outer space.
Enc_Building.BasicExporter_chapt2: The Orbital Cargo Launcher was developed especially with the extreme conditions of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> in mind. The construction of a space elevator is impossible due to Ruptura's activity, as is the maintenance of an airport for traditional transport ships. Meanwhile, the transport of goods via drones happens without the need for a crew and the Orbital Cargo Launcher does not need to be operated by any additional personnel. As such, it is the most convenient, safest and cheapest way to send resources from <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> to the Solar System.
Enc_Building.BasicExporter_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

A transport drone system. It launches unmanned ships with cargo into outer space.
Enc_Building.CloningBed_chapt1:
The Regeneration Chamber was developed by <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> based on an original design by Abigail and William Claywood. In August 2090, the company applied for a license from the Science Committee allowing mass production, and received it three months later. The first model needed 6 months to print out a fully functioning body.

The current model of the chamber can do so in mere hours. It creates a biological hydrogel based on the donor's DNA which - once mixed with pluripotent stem cells - is used to create all of the needed cell types. Then the machine prints the skeleton and organs, creates the cardiovascular system, muscles and tendons, finally wrapping the entire body in skin. Finally, it stimulates the nervous system and all of the organs so that the sleeve is fully functional as soon as a disc is inserted.
Enc_Building.CloningBed_chapt2: The latest 4th generation Regeneration Chambers have reduced the amount of biomaterials used by 1.5%. Research has shown that a further reduction causes organ failure or more brittle bones. <link id="FHS_corp">FHS</> is experimenting with polymers that could be used to replace less vital structures in the body. Scientists believe that introducing synthetic materials into the clone at the cellular level could positively impact the sleeve's performance, such as its strength, endurance and speed, while concurrently lowering the cost of production.
Enc_Building.CloningBed_header:
A <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> patent.

Breakthrough technology that uses biofilament to create a new sleeve. A disc is then inserted into it.
Enc_Building.CombustionPowerGenerator_chapt1:
Developed by the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</>, the Chemical Generator was approved for use during extrasolar missions based on directive #BBMS-023-12BA paragraph 7G of the highest scientific committee of the <link id="IRO">IRO</> in 2162. Since then it has become one of the most widely used power generators in the entire <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</>.

The Chemical Generator at its core resembles the classic combustion engine. Alkanes found in Arcadia's atmosphere are burned, thus generating kinetic energy that drives the generator rotor which converts it into electromotive force, providing clean and safe electricity out of materials that are widely available and - more importantly - completely free.
Enc_Building.CombustionPowerGenerator_chapt2: Despite its impressive efficiency at 98.7%, this device did not find use on other planets. The atmosphere of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> is so unique that research has shown the functioning of this generator is not possible anywhere else. As such, due to the lack of expansion onto other markets as well as the end of colonization and research missions to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> for obvious reasons, the Chemical Generator as a device only used by travelers to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> has been nearly completely forgotten.
Enc_Building.CombustionPowerGenerator_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

An advanced power generator. Burns chemical compounds from the atmosphere to create electricity.
Enc_Building.Connector_chapt1:
The basic model of the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</> has a simple shape but its occupants can modify the structure according to their needs by using Add-ons. Among the available additions are:

Entry hatch - it's completely airtight isolating the inside of the Habitat from the conditions outside. Additional lock mechanisms and special seals guarantee safety even if the main locking system fails.
Windows - glass manufactured by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> using their patented ExtremeGlass technology is resistant to extreme temperatures. It doesn't melt, doesn't crack and doesn't break even during a Star Rupture. Windows ensure the Habitat is well-lit while protecting it from overheating.
Horizontal connectors - hatches that allow several modules to be linked together, adding more rooms to the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</>. They allow its occupants to freely move about the Habitat.
Vertical connectors - Habitats can also be placed on top of each other. The floors are connected via ladders with non-slip rungs.
Enc_Building.Connector_chapt2: The hatches, windows and connectors can be placed anywhere on the wall. Thanks to the automated installation system, special frames and full compatibility of the Add-ons with the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</>, the openings for them are very precisely cut without compromising the structure's stability or durability. Regardless of the number of Add-ons installed, protection from radiation as well as acoustic and thermal isolation will be maintained, as will protection from the effects of a <link id="Star_wave">Star Rupture</> (when used in conjunction with the Base Core).
Enc_Building.Connector_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

Additional elements for the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</>. They allow for the modification of the structure and for linking <link id="Habitat">Habitats</> together.
Enc_Building.CoolerPassive_chapt1:
The difficult conditions that exist on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> have forced companies interested in conquering the planet to develop innovative technological solutions that are able to withstand Ruptura's eruptions. That work resulted in the creation of the Base Core and the reinforced version of the <link id="Habitat">Habitat</>. Thanks to those inventions it was possible to establish the first small bases.

However, the <link id="Base_Core">Base Core</> has limited thermal capacity. Connecting additional buildings to the power grid caused it to overheat and shut down during a Star Rupture, which significantly reduced the possible size of a base. The <link id="Base_Core">Base Core</> Amplifier introduced by the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> solves this problem by increasing the thermal capacity of the <link id="Base_Core">Base Core</>.
Enc_Building.CoolerPassive_chapt2: The <link id="Base_Core">Base Core</> Amplifier comes in two versions - basic and advanced. The latter has more power but requires a special coolant to operate. It is still worth using though, as it allows for more buildings to be added, which in turn increases the rate of excavation and production. The base can continue to grow under the reinforced protective cloak generated by the Base Core without fear of overheating or machinery getting destroyed during a <link id="Star_wave">Fire Wave</>.
Enc_Building.CoolerPassive_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

A machine that increases the thermal capacity of the Base Core. It cools down buildings, protecting them from getting destroyed.
Enc_Building.Crafter_chapt1:
One of the challenges of the early phase of Moon colonization was the constant lack of small mechanical and electronic parts that broke down easily and always needed to be replaced. Waiting for supplies to arrive from Earth significantly delayed work, and that is why Fabricators became popular.

The model offered by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> is simple to use and by controlling the porosity, microstructure and final properties of the metal, it prints components with excellent mechanical and thermal properties. The blueprint library makes it easy to quickly find the necessary part and has helped popularize the standards of the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</>. Thanks to these qualities, the Fabricator quickly outperformed its competition.
Enc_Building.Crafter_chapt2: The Fabricator uses powder beds to build a double lattice structure of hollow tubes. This innovative geometry, inspired by solutions found in nature and then perfected, ensures that less material is used and the finished product is much lighter, as well as resistant to corrosion and compression over 5 GPa. The Fabricator prints the component layer by layer without using molds, which avoids the errors and damage that can occur when cutting out a finished product.
Enc_Building.Crafter_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A 3D printer for creating basic parts out of nanocomposites. It uses MultiLaser Powder Manufacturing technology.
Enc_Building.DroneRailT1_chapt1:
The Drone Rail Transport System is an overhead monorail used by drones transporting cargo between buildings. A special overpass is raised on supports that can also function as branches, intersections, and turnouts. Running the system above the ground ensures a collision-free and stable transport.

Thanks to the agreement reached in 2149 between <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> and other companies in the space industry, it's possible to install panels compatible with the drones on machines from different manufacturers. This allows for automatic pickup, transport and unloading of cargo.

The Drone Rail Transport System can easily be adapted to the specific needs of a base. The rails provide power and have several speed modes, while the movement of the drones is synchronized, which means there are no collisions. A well-planned internal transport system makes it easier to manage one's base and effectively use excavated resources.
Enc_Building.DroneRailT1_chapt2: Attempts to build a traditional power grid on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> were met with many difficulties. First and foremost, the grid would often go down or overload because of Ruptura. This is why the Drone Rail Transport System was designed in such a way that, along with the cargo, it would also carry electricity to the buildings it was integrated with. Combining two functions in one infrastructure increased its safety and saved space - there is no need to place additional objects and there aren't two separate systems running above the base which could end up colliding with each other.
Enc_Building.DroneRailT1_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

A rail transport system. It uses drones to carry cargo throughout the base and functions as a power grid.
Enc_Building.Factory_chapt1:
After releasing several simpler manufacturing machines and 3D printers useful during the first stages of building a space colony, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> decided to introduce a more advanced device in 2135. The Constructorizer manufactures very specialized products, such as rocket engines, rocket cloaks and nanoneedles.

Because the parts produced by the Constructorizer are used by the space industry, they had to undergo rigorous testing mandated by the Space Committee. They passed all of the tests and were made available to be used on spaceships. Rocket engines can be used to launch objects into orbit.
Enc_Building.Factory_chapt2: The Constructorizer is equipped with ultra-sensitive sensors which monitor every stage of the manufacturing process and ensure the highest quality and reliability of the rocket engine components. Gases inside the engine's combustion chamber can reach temperatures of 3,300°C, so both the walls of the chamber as well as the nozzle must be mechanically strong, resistant to extreme temperatures, pressure, and shocks. Thanks to its meticulous quality control, the Constructorizer has almost entirely eliminated any errors during the production process. As such, the failure rate of its rocket engines is as low as 0.001%.
Enc_Building.Factory_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A machine that produces advanced technology. It can create things like engine rockets and satellites.
Enc_Building.FoodProcessor_chapt1:
The Food Station from <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> was a big hit at the Moon colony. It allowed for the processing of freeze-dried food rations and the first lunar vegetables from hydroponic farms into full-fledged meals. The machine heats up the ingredients, extracting flavor and preserving all nutrients, vitamins, minerals and fiber. The first colonists didn't waste time on cooking and still enjoyed a variety of healthy dishes.

When experiments began on the Moon with planting crops in modified, specially fertilized regolith - with the intention of future terraforming - it yielded low, poor quality harvests. However, they could not go to waste, so the newer model of the Food Station can easily prepare nutritious food even from underdeveloped, meager vegetables and fruit.
Enc_Building.FoodProcessor_chapt2: Thanks to research data on the local flora gathered during the mission to <link id="Arkadia-7">Arcadia-7</> in the years 2146-2150, the company was able to modify the Food Station to better handle cooking unusual ingredients. The version of the machine prepared for the new mission is able to analyze the makeup of alien fruits and vegetables and then combine them into extraordinarily tasty and nutritious meals. As a result, there's no need to bring Earth plants to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> - mission crew members can eat what they find on the planet.
Enc_Building.FoodProcessor_header:
A <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> patent.

A space cooker. It prepares healthy and nutritious meals out of basic food items.
Enc_Building.Forge_chapt1:
The Pyro Forge is an industrial machine produced by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> for casting alloys with advanced structure and composition. First, it chooses the right temperature, then it melts together at least two metals or a metal with a non-metal. Finally, the resulting homogeneous mixture is cooled and molded.

By choosing the proportions of ingredients, the alloy's physical and chemical properties can be manipulated, such as: hardness, plasticity, resistance to corrosion, mechanical strength, electrical and thermal conductivity. In 2101, alloys produced by the Pyro Forge were awarded the quality grade of A+.
Enc_Building.Forge_chapt2:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An advanced metallurgical machine. It smelts advanced metal alloys using <link id="Goethite">Goethite</> for use by the space industry.
Enc_Building.Forge_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An advanced metallurgical machine. It smelts advanced metal alloys using <link id="Goethite">Goethite</> for use by the space industry.
Enc_Building.Furnace_chapt1:
The Furnace from the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> uses 23% less energy to reach a temperature of 1000°C than the comparable model produced by ForgeTech. The lower energy consumption was achieved due to multi-layer insulation and a new way of constructing the heating elements. As a result, the company completely pushed out its competitor on <link id="Arkadia-7">Arcadia-7</> and on Mars, as well as gained a majority of the market on the Moon.

The Furnace can create things like metallic powders, silicone, ceramics or glass - out of quartz sand mixed with other ingredients. Varying the material proportions allows for the creation of products with different physical, chemical, and aesthetic properties. As such, the Furnace produces a wide array of objects necessary for the everyday functioning of a space colony.
Enc_Building.Furnace_chapt2:
The Furnace automatically performs all stages of glass production:
1. It chooses the proportions of each ingredient for the given product and mixes them.
2. It heats and melts the raw materials into a liquid mass.
3. It forms the chosen shape.
4. It carries out controlled cooling.
5. It finishes the product, cutting it into the appropriate size and shape, grinding and polishing it.
When it comes to other raw materials, heating at all stages also happens without human intervention or oversight.
Enc_Building.Furnace_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A metallurgical furnace. It uses high temperatures to process materials.
Enc_Building.GasExtractor_chapt1:
Because <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</> is a rare and hard to obtain resource, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> took it upon itself to create a machine capable of extracting it at the very early stages of space exploration. The first Helium-3 Extractors began operations on the Moon in 2099.

When the isotope was discovered on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, it became one of the most frequently mined deposits. Within just five years of the mission in the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</>, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> released three new versions of the Helium-3 Extractor. It processes raw rock material, sifts out the <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</>, purifies it and collects it in a specially designed capsule.
Enc_Building.GasExtractor_chapt2: <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</> is rarely found on Earth. The dozen or so tons that were available had been used up, and the element's extraction from natural gas is too inefficient to meet the growing demand. <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</> is formed primarily by thermonuclear fusion within stars and is thrown out into space with the solar wind. However, it never reaches Earth because of the magnetosphere. On <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, on the other hand, it is a renewable resource. <link id="Ruptura">Ruptura's</> eruptions are so powerful that the ejected <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</> is constantly deposited onto the planet's surface by the solar wind.
Enc_Building.GasExtractor_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A machine that extracts <link id="Hellium">Helium-3</>. A specialized tool for acquiring a rare resource.
Enc_Building.Habitat_chapt1:
The existence of the newly founded company depended on the success of the Habitat. Although the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> worked on various projects, the "lunar home" was to be its flagship product. It had to be inexpensive, multifunctional, and most of all - resistant to cosmic radiation. Without that last feature, it would not be possible for people to live on the Moon due to DNA damage and disease.

The Habitat is made out of a mixture of pressed regolith and a nanomaterial developed by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> called the NanoShield. As a result, the Habitat protects both people and electronics, guaranteeing it is 95% effective in lunar conditions at preventing damage caused by cosmic radiation, magnetic storms and solar flares.
Enc_Building.Habitat_chapt2: The Habitat was used on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> as well, though the standard version proved too weak to deal with Ruptura and melted around the first explorers leading to their deaths. A reinforced construction allowed the base to be maintained a little longer, but its durability was limited, degrading after 2-3 ruptures and needing to be replaced. Only the third version that contained a new generation of the nanomaterial NanoShield+, in conjunction with the protective shield created by the Base Core, proved to be a durable and safe shelter that allowed people to survive on the planet.
Enc_Building.Habitat_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A home away from home. A safe shelter for people on any planet, offering numerous customization options.
Enc_Building.Hammer_chapt1:
Developed by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</>, the Mega Press underwent a series of rigorous tests commissioned by the subcommittee for industrial space machines and received its safety certificate in 2108. Then in 2109, metal components produced by the Mega Press received a certificate confirming their compliance with the CIM-90A standard and giving them a quality grade of A. This means they can be used in extraterrestrial construction.

The Mega Press is used for metalworking, processing plastics, shaping ceramics and manufacturing components from other materials. It is multifunctional - it bends, straightens, stretches, compresses, presses, punches, stamps, cuts, forms, and assembles required components with high accuracy and reliability. A design database available by default allows for quick selection of standardized parts.
Enc_Building.Hammer_chapt2: The maximum pressure exerted by the Mega Press is 5,000 tons, but it is equipped with an intelligent pressure gauge, position sensors and an automatic control system that regulates and monitors its pressure force and working speed. This translates into high reliability and precision of manufactured components up to 0.0003 mm. It is built to withstand <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>'s extreme conditions eliminating any vibrations and being resistant to cracks and deformation caused by high temperatures.
Enc_Building.Hammer_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An industrial press. It uses a multiplied pressure force in accordance with Pascal's law to process metals, plastics and other materials.
Enc_Building.ItemPrinter_chapt1:
In 2098, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> introduced the Basic Item Printer. It's a very simple 3D printer meant to quickly create basic elements needed to manufacture other more complex buildings and machines. Despite its limited capabilities, it is very popular due to its relatively low price.

It also works very well on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>. Thanks to its small size, it can be installed inside the Habitat. It efficiently creates components needed to expand the base. Created elements, though simple in their form, have excellent mechanical properties.
Enc_Building.ItemPrinter_chapt2: The Basic Item Printer uses MultiLaser Powder Manufacturing technology, much like the Fabricator made by the same company. However, it has a much smaller recipe library and does not offer such a high level of precision, so it can't be used to print small elements reliably. The model made to be used on <link id="Arkadia-7">Arcadia-7</> - due to the constant threat of alien attacks - can also print ammunition.
Enc_Building.ItemPrinter_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A 3D printer inside a Habitat. It manufactures basic components and ammunition, printing them layer by layer.
Enc_Building.LaserDrill_chapt1:
In 2106, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> made the decision to expand its space mining department. It began researching more innovative and experimental projects including laser technology. The new machines were primarily meant to help easily and relatively cheaply mine resources on the Moon, such as iron oxides. Not for export to Earth but to be used locally.

The Laser Drill works very well in low gravity because it does not kick up as much debris and dust as traditional mining methods do. It is thus perfect for working in the asteroid belt. The machine also allows for its laser stream to be concentrated on a small specific area leading to faster and extraordinarily precise extraction, which is especially important when mining rare deposits.
Enc_Building.LaserDrill_chapt2:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A laser excavation machine. Used in mining for extracting rare deposits to the surface.
Enc_Building.LaserDrill_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A laser excavation machine. Used in mining for extracting rare deposits to the surface.
Enc_Building.LiquidExtractor_chapt1:
Discovered in 2147 on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, <link id="Powerium">Powerium</> is a resource that does not exist in the Solar System, which is why several companies immediately began working on creating a machine that could mine it. The design of the Oil Extractor from the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> received a recommendation from the highest scientific committee of the <link id="IRO">IRO</> and in 2148 it was already being used to extract the resource.

After all missions to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> stopped, the company ceased production of the device. The Oil Extractor being used by the new mission is a model from 50 years ago that has not been developed since. That doesn't make it any less effective - it is still a fully automatic, highly efficient mining machine. The Oil Extractor works in conjunction with the Refinery, a machine that processes <link id="Powerium">Powerium</>. The base should be equipped with both of these machines to optimize production.
Enc_Building.LiquidExtractor_chapt2: Locating <link id="Powerium">Powerium</> is much simpler compared to finding oil deposits on Earth. The characteristic rainbow puddles can be identified even by a layman. As a result, one does not need specialized knowledge, costly surveys or test drilling to begin extracting it. The difficulties of pumping out oil onto the surface mean only a 65% recovery factor for a given deposit. The Oil Extractor essentially guarantees that 100% of the resource will be recovered. Also taking into consideration that Earth is running out of oil deposits, <link id="Powerium">Powerium</> is a highly sought after resource.
Enc_Building.LiquidExtractor_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

A machine that extracts <link id="Powerium">Powerium</>. A specialized device for acquiring a rare resource.
Enc_Building.MechanicalDrill_chapt1:
Gerald Morris became very familiar with how heavy machinery worked back when he ran a construction company on Earth. When he began working with his brother Frederick and expanded his business to include the Moon, he had to modify the traditional designs and adapt them to a new, more demanding environment.

The <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> created a whole series of mining machines meant to deal with the lunar regolith, Martian rock, as well as the alien soil of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>. The series 8 excavator is today one of the most popular industrial diggers in two solar systems. It is especially prized in the Mawrth Vallis valley on Mars.
Enc_Building.MechanicalDrill_chapt2: The excavator is fully automated. The cab has been removed and replaced with advanced programming that collects data from sensors, analyzes it and drives the excavation process. Eliminating the human operator led to the optimization of the machine's work and maximizing production. Output increased by 15% per day compared to excavators controlled by humans. The system also monitors the state of the machine's parts, warning if they need to be repaired or replaced before any stoppage occurs.
Enc_Building.MechanicalDrill_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An excavating machine. Used in industrial mining to bring deposits to the surface.
Enc_Building.MilitaryAssembler_chapt1:
The Facturer is an advanced manufacturing machine created by the <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> in cooperation with the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> and introduced in 2136. Because it creates dangerous items that can be a serious threat to public safety if they fell into the wrong hands, the production and sale of Facturers is strictly controlled.

Since the Facturer can create arc reactors, it underwent special testing commissioned by the highest scientific committee of the <link id="IRO">IRO</> before it was made available. Once it passed testing, the Facturer received a certificate confirming that the reactor cores it produces comply with the strictest safety standards and guarantee continuous thermonuclear fusion.
Enc_Building.MilitaryAssembler_chapt2: The Facturer can also create the latest generation of weapons such as the ion bomb used to disrupt electronics and shut down machinery (including vehicles) within a large area. Regulations do not allow for this type of weapon to be used during the mission. Built-in safeguards prevent products created by the Facturer from being used until they are activated in specially designated locations, found on most populated planets.
Enc_Building.MilitaryAssembler_header:
A <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> patent.

An advanced manufacturing machine. Used to create reactors, bombs and ammunition.
Enc_Building.PackageSender_chapt1:
As the Luna-1 base expanded on the Moon, the transport of large heavy cargo with construction materials from factories to the outskirts of town was becoming more and more logistically complicated. To solve this problem, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> created Rapid Cargo Transfer which allowed for much larger and heavier cargo to be transported than was possible with the Drone Rail System.

The cargo transport system within the base consists of two buildings. The first building is the Cargo Dispatcher which collects the indicated resources and sends out a large shipment. The second building is the Cargo Receiver which receives it. The buildings do not operate independently. A well-placed Cargo Receiver greatly facilitates the building of infrastructure far from the base center.
Enc_Building.PackageSender_chapt2: Rapid Cargo Transfer was first tested during the construction of a scientific center that was placed 50 km from the border of Luna-1. Some of the materials were transported conventionally for comparison using cargo rovers. The Cargo Dispatcher and the Cargo Receiver were sending shipments 41% faster than the vehicles that had to slow down in difficult terrain and avoid obstacles which extended their delivery time. This success led to the system being widely used in all colonies.
Enc_Building.PackageSender_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A system for sending shipments throughout the base. Intended for large and heavy cargo.
Enc_Building.PersonalStorage_chapt1:
In 2104, William Claywood discovered an unknown mineral on the Moon. Experiments conducted on it created a new technology called <link id="Pockets">Pockets</>. For a long time it was used in secret solely by the <link id="Claywood_corp">Claywood Corporation</>. Only in 2143 did the company introduce <link id="Pockets">Pockets</> to the public, also allowing other companies to use it for production.

Various storage containers were created based on the <link id="Pockets">Pockets</> technology for industrial, military and personal use. Personal Storage produced by <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> is one of the most popular models for individual clients. In an overpopulated world, the ability to store most of your possessions inside <link id="Pockets">Pockets</> helps save on valuable living space.
Enc_Building.PersonalStorage_chapt2: Personal Storage works using <link id="Pockets">Pockets</> technology. This means that it opens a small portal through which one can place any object (but not living beings!) into a special space creating a separate little dimension. In this case, it is "little" merely in comparison to the known universe - the capacity of the Personal Storage container greatly exceeds its visible external dimensions and allows for all necessary equipment to be stored away. However, for the more demanding colonists travelling beyond our Solar System, a larger version is also available.
Enc_Building.PersonalStorage_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

A container for storing equipment. It uses <link id="Pockets">Pockets</> technology.
Enc_Building.RecipeTable_chapt1:
Some of the buildings at the base, in addition to their standard version, also come in a more advanced, more efficient variant. Others can have their programming updated with new methods of processing resources or manufacturing objects. All available upgrades can be found in the Recipe Station.

The Recipe Station can be installed inside the Habitat. Acquiring and processing resources, as well as completing orders for various companies, will gradually unlock access to new recipes. Improved versions of machines allow for larger orders to be completed and more advanced recipes to be obtained.
Enc_Building.RecipeTable_chapt2: On the Moon and on Mars, each company has its own Recipe Station, which makes the process of upgrading buildings more complicated and time-consuming because it requires access to several consoles. When it comes to <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, an agreement was reached which resulted in a single Recipe Station providing building upgrades from all manufacturers. The <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</>'s solution proved to be the best. The company charges a small fee from the other manufacturers in exchange for making their building upgrades available.
Enc_Building.RecipeTable_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

A console with building upgrades. They speed up excavation, allow for new objects to be produced or a more advanced version of a building to be built.
Enc_Building.Recycler_chapt1:
One of the challenges of space colonization is resource management, including trash. In a situation with limited resources one cannot afford to be wasteful. This is why, in 2197, the <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> introduced the Recycler - a device that breaks down assembled objects into their base components that can then be used to build new, more useful things.

The Recycler is protected by a special military patent, so its details are classified, but the main function of the machine is as follows: it identifies the components and structure of the object and then very precisely breaks its chemical bonds creating new ones. The effect is that the components are separated. The loss of materials in the process is negligible, oscillating around 0.01-0.03%.
Enc_Building.Recycler_chapt2: The Recycler was initially designed for the military. It can break down the enemy's abandoned equipment or damaged vehicles into specific materials needed by the given squad. At the same time, it meant the enemy could not retrieve its lost resources. When combined with mobile manufacturing machines, it allows soldiers to resupply while the fighting continues, without having to wait for supplies to reach them. The Recycler made available for civilian use is smaller and has limited functionality.
Enc_Building.Recycler_header:
A <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> patent.

A machine for reclaiming resources. It breaks down objects into base components that can be used again.
Enc_Building.Refinery_chapt1:
Refineries on Earth can stretch across up to 300 hectares of land. Building a facility that big in lunar or Martian conditions would be a very complicated and costly challenge. That is why the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> worked on a machine that could replace the complicated installation. In 2110, it patented the Refinery.

The Refinery can process several types of raw materials. One of them is <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> which gets turned into sulfuric acid that is then used to produce artificial fertilizer - a necessity for cosmic conquest. Making the soil of alien planets suitable for plants and providing them with nutrients is crucial for the survival and growth of a colony.
Enc_Building.Refinery_chapt2: When rich deposits of <link id="Powerium">Powerium</> were discovered on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, several companies began working on creating a device that could process the valuable resource. The <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> presented its prototype Raf-01. The <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> used a different approach - it modified its Refinery. The more universal, multifunctional machine turned out to be more optimal and cheaper than a separate dedicated device. After missions to the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</>stopped, the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> ceased production of the improved version of the Refinery, but modifying it again for the purposes of the new mission was not difficult.
Enc_Building.Refinery_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A petrochemical machine. Processes rare raw materials, including <link id="Powerium">Powerium</>, into more valuable goods and intermediate products.
Enc_Building.ResearchLab_chapt1:
The Molecular Binder uses LightForce Molecular Manufacturing technology developed by a team of physicists led by Prof. Zhang and Prof. Lloyd. Their work was carried out in complete secrecy due to their use of one of the most advanced technologies known to man and their research was never made public.

When <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> introduced the machine, it received a patent with the highest degree of protection. The product is intended only for use by businesses and violating the rules of its use is met with heavy fines. The Molecular Binder is especially useful on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> where one's ability to create complex objects is limited, as is the ability to have them shipped from the Solar System.
Enc_Building.ResearchLab_chapt2: The functioning of the Molecular Binder is based on achievements made in nanotechnology and 3D printing. It uses an unusually powerful and precise laser to convert energy into matter. It then creates chemical bonds between the resulting molecules (that have the desired properties and structure). By positioning the molecules in a given pattern, it builds the three-dimensional object selected from the recipe database. The Molecular Binder is capable of creating complex structures, but is intended only for inanimate matter - it does not create living beings.
Enc_Building.ResearchLab_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

A molecular manufacturing machine. It transforms energy into matter, building a three-dimensional object on a molecular level.
Enc_Building.ResearchTerminal_chapt1:
The Corporate Terminal was created to facilitate interplanetary business communication. Because of delays in sending data due to great distances, real-time contact proved frustrating for many people and hindered any business-related discussions. A system of publishing and accepting orders turned out to be much more convenient.

The Corporate Terminal allows for quick and easy communication with companies that wish to outsource some of their tasks to third parties. Available commissions with descriptions can be viewed using a clear menu system. Offered rewards motivate the user to choose the most profitable jobs.
Enc_Building.ResearchTerminal_chapt2: Within the Solar System, the Corporate Terminal has a bidding function that allows a company to choose the best offer to fulfill its order out of several proposals. In the case of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>, this function is not available because of the lack of competition. This also means that business negotiations between the company and mission crew members are not possible. But it does encourage companies to offer attractive commissions if they wish to make use of <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>'s resources but don't want to risk sending their own missions.
Enc_Building.ResearchTerminal_header:
A <link id="Claywood_corp">Claywood Corporation</> patent.

A business communicator. Allows for browsing and accepting jobs, as well as claiming rewards for completed tasks.
Enc_Building.Smelter_chapt1:
The Smelter was designed by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> to speed up the processing of ore excavated in the asteroid belt. The patent was granted in 2130. The device replaces archaic, industrial foundries. The extracted ore is processed on site and then transported in ingot form to inhabited planets.

Full automation ensures consistent casting results - the risk of casting defects has been reduced by 92% compared to the traditional production process. The excavated ore is used in the construction, energy, machine and - of course - space industries.
Enc_Building.Smelter_chapt2:
The Smelter automatically performs all steps needed to produce an intermediate product in the form of an ingot that is compliant with the IRO-738C standard.
1. Crushing and pre-cleaning the raw material.
2. Smelting the metal ore into a liquid charge.
3. Removing undesirable products from the charge.
4. Casting into molds.
5. Cooling.
6. Initial processing.
7. Stamping the serial number and purity.
Production parameters are monitored at every stage to ensure the highest quality of the finished intermediate product.
Enc_Building.Smelter_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

Smelts raw materials. Pours a liquid charge into molds to create metal ingots.
Enc_Building.SolarPowerGenerator_chapt1:
The Solar Generator is an off-grid installation - an autonomous energy system that can power individual devices, habitats or entire bases. Photovoltaic modules transform the energy of solar radiation into electrical energy. The basic version uses standard monocrystalline silicon panels. The light-to-electricity conversion rate is 27.6%. An AI inverter predicts energy consumption, optimizes the system's operations and protects it from being damaged by a <link id="Star_wave">Fire Wave</>.

An advanced version of the Solar Generator uses tandem perovskite solar cells. They are produced at 100°C, whereas silicon requires 1000°C, so they are cheaper while being more durable and more efficient. They convert a wider spectrum of electromagnetic waves into electricity than silicon and produce more energy from a smaller surface area. Their light-to-electricity conversion rate is 45.3%.
Enc_Building.SolarPowerGenerator_chapt2: Perovskites are a group of naturally occurring minerals, with their most widespread representative being calcium titanate(IV) (CaTiO3). It does not conduct electricity which might make it seem useless for photovoltaic purposes. However, substances with semi-conducting properties were created in a laboratory based on the general crystalline structure of perovskites (ABX3). Initially, synthetic perovskites were characterized by a short lifespan, but over time, stable structures with increased durability were developed. This was primarily thanks to a Polish company that was acquired by the <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> in 2094.
Enc_Building.SolarPowerGenerator_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

An electric power generator. It uses the limitless, free and natural source of energy that is solar radiation.
Enc_Building.StorageDepot_chapt1:
Extracting resources is inevitably connected with storing them. From among the various types of containers, hangars and industrial <link id="Pockets">Pockets</>, Storage from <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> stands out. Being compatible with the Drone Rail System, it can be easily connected to mining and manufacturing machines. The transport and unloading of cargo occurs automatically.

The most basic Storage model comes in two sizes - standard and large. It is meant to store one type of a given resource. A MultiStorage model is also available which allows for several types of resources to be stored inside.
Enc_Building.StorageDepot_chapt2: A special type of Storage is the Expendable Storage. It is based on Pockets technology, which means its capacity can be increased without the need to add new buildings or buy upgrades. It just needs to be connected to an additional power supply - the more electricity the Expendable Storage uses, the more it can hold.
Enc_Building.StorageDepot_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

Buildings for storing raw materials. Models of various sizes are available.
Enc_Building.SuitWorkshop_chapt1:
Research on discs revealed that putting certain stimulating substances inside them can influence the way the limbic system functions. Initially, enhancement modules were installed by a specially trained medical technician, but in 2082, <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> developed the L.E.M. Station - a machine for self-installing and uninstalling modules.

By controlling the release of hormones as well as stimulating the brain and nervous system, modules from <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> can influence various aspects of how a person functions. The enhancement effect differs depending on which type of module is installed. Some modules can prevent hunger and thirst, others can decrease fatigue while simultaneously increasing physical fitness, and still others can help control emotions (such as fear).
Enc_Building.SuitWorkshop_chapt2:
After discs were developed in 2071, work began on expanding their capabilities. Their full potential was not known, so experiments were conducted on volunteers. In exchange, their disc subscription payments were waived for the rest of their lives. During the experiments, some patients suffered damage to their nerve cells, leading to memory loss, cardiac complications, severe panic attacks and Klüver-Bucy syndrome.

With time, it was possible to develop a safe method of applying modules to the discs. Currently, side-effects occur very rarely - in around 0.001% of people who use modules.
Enc_Building.SuitWorkshop_header:
A <link id="FHS_corp">Future Health Solutions</> patent.

A station for self-installing and uninstalling stimulating modules for discs.
Enc_Building.SulfurExtractor_chapt1:
The <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> Extractor was designed by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> specially for the acquisition of natural <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> found on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>. The average amount of this mineral found in rock deposits is 35-40%. The <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> mined in the <link id="Ruptura_system">Ruptura System</> is purer than the what is acquired on Earth by using the popular method of refining fuel.

The <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> Extractor is part of the same series of space mining machinery produced by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> as the Refinery, which can be used to process the sulfur acquired by the Extractor into sulfuric acid. The base should be equipped with both machines to ensure optimal production.
Enc_Building.SulfurExtractor_chapt2: <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> deposits emit toxic fumes with a characteristic acidic, suffocating odor. Inhalation causes irritation of the mucous membranes and upper respiratory tract. Skin contact, on the other hand, results in painful rashes and blisters. As a result, it is recommended for safety reasons to perform the installation of the <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> Extractor only immediately following a Star Rupture. <link id="Ruptura">Ruptura</>'s effect on the <link id="Sulfur">Sulfur</> deposit causes its fumes to temporarily dissipate allowing for extraction to be safely carried out.
Enc_Building.SulfurExtractor_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

A machine for acquiring sulfur. A specialized mining device designed to extract a hard to obtain resource.
Enc_Building.Synthetizer_chapt1:
The Compounder carries out complex chemical reactions. It automatically regulates parameters such as: temperature, pressure, ingredients and mixing speed, in order to guarantee the ideal production process. Introduced by the <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> in 2114, it quickly gained popularity both on Earth and in the colonies.

The Compounder can be used to produce synthetic resins from petroleum materials. During the industrial polymerization process, it combines monomers and transforms them into polymer compounds. Resins produced by the Compounder are resistant to microfractures, chemical agents, as well as changing temperatures and weather conditions. As such, they meet the mechanical strength and damage resistance requirements of the SR-114b standard.
Enc_Building.Synthetizer_chapt2: The Compounder is also able to turn Helium into a liquid which requires temperatures below 4.22 K at 1 atm of pressure. Liquid helium is used to cool superconductors and medical equipment. In cryogenics, it's used to protect newly printed, spare sleeves. On spaceships, it's used to cool super-sensitive sensors and other devices.
Enc_Building.Synthetizer_header:
A <link id="Selenian_corp">Selenian Corporation</> patent.

An advanced manufacturing machine. It carries out chemical reactions that create things like resins and aerogels.
Enc_Building.Teleporter_chapt1:
The Teleporter is a unique device created specifically for the new mission to <link id="Arkadia-7">Arcadia-7</> in 2201. It was the result of cooperation between William Claywood and <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</>. Claywood, in strict secrecy, shared his research on copying and sending consciousness with Robert Garnet.

The Teleporter does not transport matter - the body at the origin point is destroyed and only a copy of the mind is sent to the destination machine. It is then uploaded onto a disc inside a newly printed Sleeve in the second Teleporter. A well-planned placement of Teleporters allows for quick, though still experimental, travel.
Enc_Building.Teleporter_chapt2: In 2193, William Claywood discovered a way to copy and send the contents of a disc - i.e. human consciousness - between two Sleeves. Previously, it was believed to be impossible due to the prohibitively large amount of data that constitutes a mind. However, the Teleporter proves it's possible. The machine sends data at the speed of light and the person re-created at the destination point still has all of their memories, personality traits, intellectual skills and other elements of their consciousness. Claywood did not make his research public and other companies have as yet been unable to develop their own methods of transporting consciousness.
Enc_Building.Teleporter_header:
A <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> patent.

Consciousness transfer between two machines. It sends the contents of a disc to a new Sleeve.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier1_chapt1:
The Defense Turret is a basic model of a stationary, autonomous weapon mounted on a special platform. It has been used on Earth since before the age of space colonization. It is placed around military bases, strategic infrastructure such as nuclear power plants, and even private homes.

The Defense Turret is fundamental to a base's defense system on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</>. It is equipped with sensors and cameras that allow it to autonomously detect an approaching enemy, target them and open fire. Its biggest weakness is the need to manually supply and load it with ammunition, thus requiring at least partial human supervision.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier1_chapt2: One of the biggest challenges connected with autonomous weapons is teaching them to distinguish between friend and foe, so that they do not open fire every time they detect someone's presence. Advanced military AI can recognize faces, silhouettes, uniforms and even the movement of specific people, such as soldiers stationed at the base it's defending. The Defense Turret used on <link id="Arkadii-7">Arcadia-7</> doesn't need such advanced solutions due to the shape of the aliens' bodies, which are clearly different from humans. As a result, the machine does not waste precious fractions of seconds analyzing what it's seeing - it can open fire immediately.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier1_header:
A <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> patent.

An autonomous gun. It detects the enemy and opens fire. Requires manual reloading.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier2_chapt1:
The need to manually load ammunition into the Defense Turret significantly lowers its effectiveness when facing increasingly larger hordes of aliens. This is why, in 2148, the <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> partnered up with <link id="Clever_corp">Clever Robotics</> to develop a Defense Tower that is compatible with the Drone Rail System.

The Defense Tower has more firepower and longer range than the Defense Turret. It autonomously detects the enemy, targets them and opens fire. Ammunition loaded automatically makes it easier to fight off increasing attacks by <link id="Aliens">Vermin</> on an expanding base. A strategic placement of weapon platforms ensures continuous protection.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier2_chapt2: The biggest advantage of the Defense Tower is the ability to use the Drone Rail System to connect it to a Fabricator that can produce ammunition. Thanks to a special panel, the drones can deliver ammo straight into a compartment within the Defense Tower. This allows for uninterrupted firepower without the need for manual reloading. The Defense Turret is fully autonomous and does not require human supervision.
Enc_Building.Turret_Tier2_header:
A <link id="Griffiths_corp">Griffits Blue Corporation</> patent.

An advanced autonomous gun. It detects the enemy and opens fire. Automatic reloading using drones.
Enc_Building.WindPowerGenerator_chapt1:
The Wind Turbine is a power generator with a vertical axis, which means it can utilize wind coming from any direction. As the kinetic energy of the wind rotates the rotor blades, its motion is transmitted through a shaft and a gearbox to a generator, where it is converted into electricity.

The advanced model has specially shaped blades that guarantee optimal rotation and maximum efficiency of the turbine at 60.1%. The structure is very stable, it is resistant to vibrations, strong winds and unfavorable atmospheric conditions.
Enc_Building.WindPowerGenerator_chapt2: The kinetic energy of wind comes from solar energy. The unpredictability of <link id="Ruptura">Ruptura</> leads to uneven warming of the planet, which in turn causes large differences in pressure and strong convection currents in the atmosphere. This is why, for 3/4 of the year, across most of the planet at a height of 100 m, minimum wind speed is 20 m/s. The Wind Turbine is designed to already function at much smaller speeds of 2 m/s. It produces more electricity than the Solar Generator, but it's best to combine both machines for a hybrid system. This ensures stable power for the base from two sources of renewable, free and natural energy.
Enc_Building.WindPowerGenerator_header:
A <link id="Moon_corp">Moon Energy Corporation</> patent.

A power generator. It converts the kinetic energy of wind into electricity.

Fixes.006_1_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
Chapter 8

[…] Despite the enormous amount of money he had to be making as the director of a large company, the apartment John (name changed) lived in was not luxurious. About 20 square meters, empty shelves, and the mattress of his small twin bed probably remembers pre-colonization days. This was an extraordinarily frugal individual, maybe even miserly. He's the first person with a positive account balance that has agreed to an interview, he also has the worst apartment.

He treats me to some algae tea, I thank him smiling but don't drink it. The smell alone makes my stomach churn. Is this what life without debt smells like?

- What would you like to know? How much I've spent exactly? - He begins the conversation with a smile. He's trying to be funny, but his smile stinks worse than my tea.

- I don't need such details. Please just tell me your story.

- Nineteen years. That's what I really paid. - Tha answer seems rehearsed. - If we had gotten permission right away, my son would've been an adult by now.

John isn't an isolated case. The belief in some circles that childbirth permission is granted to those well-off is also not true. The IRO throws everyone into the shackles of bureaucracy, regardless of how much they make. Only the elite can have offspring, and the elite are not directors like John, they're not even company owners. The only condition for receiving permission, it seems, is to be on Meera Singh's good side. What did John do to be denied his right to a son after nineteen years of fighting bureaucracy? That's what I'm trying to find out, but I know that I may never get an answer. Maybe John doesn't know himself. [...]
