Fixes.006_2_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: B0035
To: Moon Energy Corporation

Hello,

I would like to personally report contraband that I have found. I caught Mr. Farell, serial number G0425, reading a work found on the forbidden works list - "Credit for a Grandson" by Jacob Jax.

Although I am doing this because of a moral obligation, I wanted to ask whether I can count on a reward for sharing this information.

Sincerely,
B0035


—


From: Moon Energy Corporation
To: B0035

Hello!

Thank you for sharing this important information. We can assure you that convict G0425 will be officially punished for his blatant violation of not only mission regulations but the law.

As for the reward, we understand you did not mean a financial reward, correct? Fulfilling one's moral obligation is a reward unto itself, but you also get official praise from us! The Moon Energy Corporation is thrilled to have such a wonderful convict!

We would also like to emphasize that information about our contractors reading forbidden literature should stay between us. If you spread this information you will be punished for violating your non-disclosure agreement.

Thank you!
The Moon Energy Corporation
Fixes.004_3_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Ethan Jackson
To: All

I'm writing to you on the official channel as everything seems to indicate we did it! Compared to last week, we have increased power usage by 25%.

Of course, Dr. Chen deserves the most praise as it was her genius idea to modify the contact layer.

I don't want to jinx it, but this could mean a bonus.

Thank you,
Dr. Ethan Jackson
Fixes.006_6_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Moon Energy Corporation
To: Hound Dog base personnel

Welcome!

You turned away from society, committed terrible crimes, but the Moon Energy Corporation has given you a second chance! You are now part of our most ambitious excavation project - Hound Dog!

Of course, due to your past, we can't give you complete autonomy. You must have already met Sergeant Timothy Forner. His presence is the result of our partnership with the Griffits Blue Corporation. He will make sure you are safe and that you follow regulations.

Good luck!
The Moon Energy Corporation
Fixes.006_5_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Moon Energy Corporation
To: Sergeant Timothy Forner

Sergeant!

We have received a report about contraband belonging to convict G0425. You assured us that the prisoners are behaving well. The Moon Energy people are pissed because this could damage their reputation, we're pissed because this could damage our contract. Am I to understand that a soldier with eighty years of experience is unable to see resistance activity right under his nose? This is an official reprimand.


—


From: Sergeant Timothy Forner
To: Moon Energy Corporation

There must have been some misunderstanding. G0425 is an exemplary convict, I have looked through his tablet myself and I did not see anything that would violate the law in any way. It is my opinion that G0425, just like the other convicts, is showing signs of 100% rehabilitation. This is a misunderstanding, but I am ready, of course, to accept my punishment.
Fixes.009_3_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: Path of Souls
To: multiple recipients

Discs have introduced many positive changes into our lives, but they have also created chaos in the spiritual sphere. The eternal cycle of life and death has been disrupted.

Do you feel lost?

Removed from nature?

Are you afraid for your soul?

Ancient practices will help you regain balance!

Incense and herbs: produced according to recipes by monks from the Far East, they will purify your body and mind. They will help you meditate and enter trances.

Intention candles: created out of natural wax especially for magical rituals, they help your intentions come true. Don't be afraid to ask for what you deserve!

Talismans: they offer protection and support from the primordial gods of nature, they will help ground you.

Technology has pushed us away from the ancient powers, but if you dare reach for them, they will answer your call.

See our full catalog - our rituals, spells and magical tools will help you connect with the Oneness and regain peace of mind.
Fixes.004_4_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Roberto Martin
To: Ethan Jackson

Hey.

I re-calculated everything once again and you can go ahead and increase the power. I can guarantee nothing bad will happen - it will not be enough power to attract the Vermin. I approve Peggy's proposal.
Fixes.004_2_D_MediumBase_c_Content:
From: Roberto Martin
To: Ethan Jackson

Sorry it took so long, I just found the time to go over Peggy's calculations. We should be able to increase the power but I personally don't recommend it. We don't know how the Vermin will react. We don't have enough protection to defend ourselves from them. Try to buy us some time.

—

From: Ethan Jackson
To: Roberto Martin

I tried. If we don't do it now they'll demote me and Peggy will take over the base. Do you really want to work under her?

—

From: Ethan Jackson
To: Roberto Martin

Understood. I'm not happy about it, but I can't recommend her solution. I'd rather serve under Peggy than be dead.
Fixes.009_2_D_SmallBase_c_Content:
From: S1337
To: Selenian Corporation

I must regretfully file a complaint regarding convict A0078. He refuses to cooperate in any way and does not fulfill even the most basic of obligations. During the previous cycle, he barricaded himself in the foundations of the base and refuses to come out. When I asked him to help me mine titanium he responded, quote: "I don't care about that, what can they do to me here? You should chill out too!".

I am requesting permission to use direct coercive measures.

I really don't know what to do.
Convict S1337


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: S1337

We were afraid it could come to this. We are happy to see how well you are handling the mining on your own. Since indirect coercive measure aren't working, we are granting you full authorization to use direct coercive measures.

Good luck!
The Selenian Corporation


—


From: S1337
To: Selenian Corporation

Convict A0078 has disappeared. I suspect he is hiding somewhere in the area because I have noticed that products are regularly disappearing from the Food Station, making him the main suspect.

I think he read my previous message and got scared. I have no way of influencing his behavior. Please send reinforcements, I might not be able to defend myself alone if the Vermin attack.


—


From: Selenian Corporation
To: S1337

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide anyone to help you. Seeing how well you are doing on your own, we are certain you will be able to overcome any obstacles you face!

Good luck! You are our best convict!
The Selenian Corporation

Fixes.004_6_D_MediumBase_p_Content:
Today didn’t start out so well. In the morning, I got into a fight with Ethan about my idea to increase the amount of generated energy, but when he blurted out that it was because Roberto didn't approve, I immediately started looking through the database and I found quite a few interesting things. I'm convinced Ethan will continue defending his buddy. Plus he blocked any contact with Moon Energy for anyone other than himself.

But that won't stop me from putting a scare on Roberto. Maybe my gun isn't loaded but he doesn't know that. Just mentioning Mr. C. should suffice.

HintText.HINT_BaseCoreContent:
<size size=""larger"">The Base Core allows you to construct other structures. Keep in mind that it has a limited perimeter, so if you want to expand your base, you may need more than one.



 <size size=""larger"">Protect your Base Core carefully — if it gets damaged, your entire base may stop functioning.</>
HintText.HINT_ForgottenEngineCompleteContent:
<size size="larger">Congratulations!</>
<size size="larger">You've just activated the Forgotten Engine! </>

<size size="larger">This is an Early Access build of the game, therefore everything that the Forgotten Engine unlocks will be available in upcoming updates!</>

<size size="larger">In the meantime explore Arcadia-7 secrets, expand your factory and remember: </>

<size size="larger">EVERY. RUPTURE. COUNTS.</>

Inputs.Desc_Align to Terrain: Adjusts blueprint height so that it is closer to the terrain.
Inputs.Desc_Toggle Vertical Snap: Adjusts the blueprint height to the closest building's level.
Inputs.Desc_Confirm Construciton / Deconstructi: Attempts to construct or deconstruct a building (if in building or deconstruction mode).
Inputs.Desc_Crouch / Slide: Character starts crouching or sliding if moving fast enough.
Inputs.Desc_Deploy / Recall Drone: Deploys the drone (if available) when in building or deconstruction mode. Disables the drone if it's already in flight.
Inputs.Desc_Quick Building Selection: Enters building mode and selects the blueprint that the player was aiming at.
Inputs.Desc_Equip Building Tool: Equips the building tool and enters building mode.
Inputs.Desc_Deconstruct: Equips the deconstruction tool and enters deconstruction mode.
Inputs.Desc_Equip Next Weapon: Equips the next weapon (if there is one).
Inputs.Desc_Equip Previous Weapon: Equips the previous weapon (if there is one).
Inputs.Desc_Equip First Weapon Slot: Equips the weapon assigned to the first weapon slot (if there is one).
Inputs.Desc_Equip Second Weapon Slot: Equips the weapon assigned to the second weapon slot (if there is one).
Inputs.Desc_Fire / Use / Throw: Fires the equipped weapon or uses the equipped tool.
Inputs.Desc_Move Blueprint Down: Moves the blueprint closer to the ground.
Inputs.Desc_Move Blueprint Up: Moves the blueprint away from the ground.
Inputs.Desc_Move Forward: Moves the character in the given direction.
Inputs.Desc_Interact / Pick Up: Opens various menus and containers, picks stuff up, activates buttons, doors and machinery.
Inputs.Desc_Dash: Performs a dash in the direction of movement.
Inputs.Desc_Jump: Performs a jump or a double jump (if already airborne).
Inputs.Desc_Ping: Places a virtual marker visible to all players.
Inputs.Desc_Flashlight: Powers on the flashlight. If held down, it changes its operation mode.
Inputs.Desc_Reload: Reloads current weapon (if it is equipped and can be reloaded).
Inputs.Desc_Holster / Unequip: Stows away whatever the player is holding.
Inputs.Desc_Set Z Offset: Toggles between regular height adjustment and offsetting building parts (if available).
Inputs.Desc_Aim Down Sights (ADS): Toggles looking through weapon sights (if there is a weapon equipped).
Inputs.Desc_Swap Foundation: Changes the held blueprint into another foundation variant (if there are any available).

OptionsDescriptions.GlobalIlluminationQuality_Description:
Global Illumination controls the quality of dynamically calculated indirect lighting, sky shadowing and ambient occlusion. Settings of 'High' and above use more accurate ray tracing methods to render lighting but can reduce performance.

Low - Global Illumination off 
Medium - Distance Fields - the most performance-friendly option
High - Lumen basic option focused on performance, expect some noise artifacts
Epic - Lumen setup focused on performance with high end GPUs"

<strong>Changing the Global Illumination quality might have a big impact on performance, especially with older GPUs</>
OptionsDescriptions.ResolutionScaleQuality_Description: 3D Resolution Quality determines the resolution in which objects are rendered in the game, but does not affect the main menu. Lower resolutions can significantly increase frame rate.
OptionsDescriptions.LandscapeQuality_DisabledWithTesselation: <strong>Landscape Quality is disabled when Landscape Tessellation is enabled</>
OptionsDescriptions.GraphicsQualityPresets_Warning: <strong>Note: Changing the Quality Preset from Low to Epic has a big impact on performance.</>
OptionsDescriptions.FullscreenNeededForVSync_Description: <strong>This feature only works if 'Window Mode' is set to 'Fullscreen'.</>
OptionsDescriptions.MotionBlur_Disabled_Description: <strong>This feature requires Motion Blur to be enabled
OptionsDescriptions.UpscalingSharpness_Description: Adjusts how crisp an image looks after being upscaled. You can adjust the sharpness slider to your preference.
OptionsDescriptions.UserInterfaceVolume_Description: Adjusts the volume of the User Interface.
OptionsDescriptions.AmbientVolume_Description: Adjusts the volume of ambient sound.
OptionsDescriptions.DialogueVolume_Description: Adjusts the volume of dialogue for game characters and voice-overs.
OptionsDescriptions.SoundEffectsVolume_Description: Adjusts the volume of sound effects.
OptionsDescriptions.AntiAliasingMode_Description:
Anti-Aliasing reduces jagged artifacts along the edges of the game's geometry. Increasing this setting will make edges look smoother, but can reduce performance. Higher settings mean more anti-aliasing.

None - no anti-aliasing may produce visible jagged edges but offers the fastest performance
TAA - a balance between smooth edges and performance, may produce a smooth image on lower resolutions
TSR - the best visual clarity on all resolutions but might impact performance
OptionsDescriptions.AutoSetQuality_Description: Automatically configure the graphics quality options based on a benchmark of your hardware.
OptionsDescriptions.AudioOutputDevice_Description: Changes the audio output device for game audio (not voice chat).
OptionsDescriptions.DeviceProfileSuffix_Description: Choose between different quality presets to make a trade off between quality and performance.
OptionsDescriptions.Resolution_Description: Display Resolution determines the size of the window in Windowed mode. In Fullscreen mode, Display Resolution determines the graphics card output resolution, which can result in black bars depending on your monitor and graphics card. Display Resolution is inactive in Windowed Fullscreen mode.
OptionsDescriptions.VisualEffectQuality_Description: Effects determines the quality of visual effects and lighting in the game. Increasing this setting will increase the quality of visual effects, but can reduce performance.
OptionsDescriptions.HeadphoneMode_Description: Enables binaural audio. Provides 3D audio spatialization, so you can hear the location of sounds more precisely, including above, below, and behind you. Recommended for use with stereo headphones only.
OptionsDescriptions.HDRAudioMode_Description: Enables high dynamic range audio. Changes the runtime processing chain to increase the dynamic range of the audio mixdown, appropriate for theater or more cinematic experiences.
OptionsDescriptions.InvertHorizontalAxis_Description: Enables the inversion of the horizontal look axis.
OptionsDescriptions.InvertVerticalAxis_Description: Enables the inversion of the vertical look axis.
OptionsDescriptions.MotionBlurEnabled_Description: Enabling Motion Blur results in a blur effect on moving objects or when moving the camera.
OptionsDescriptions.LandscapeTessellation_Description:
Enabling Tessellation results in more detailed landscape geometry. This feature is still in an experimental stage.

<strong>Expect a significant performance drop</>
OptionsDescriptions.VerticalSync_Description:
Enabling Vertical Sync eliminates screen tearing by always rendering and displaying a full frame. 
Disabling Vertical Sync can result in a higher frame rate and better input response, but can cause horizontal screen tearing.
OptionsDescriptions.FrameGenMethod_Description:
Frame generation is a technique that inserts additional frames between traditionally rendered ones to increase the displayed frame rate and improve visual smoothness.

<strong>Can produce much more FPS at the cost of latency, so it's recommended to use with low-latency mode options</>

<strong>DLSS Frame Generation is compatible only with 40xx and above RTX models.</>
OptionsDescriptions.FrameRateLimit_Always_Description:
Frame rate limit sets the highest frame rate that is allowed. Set this lower for a more consistent frame rate or higher for the best experience on faster machines. You may need to disable Vsync to reach higher frame rates.

<strong>Adjust with the display refresh rate for the best visual performance</>
OptionsDescriptions.FrameRateLimit_WhenBackgrounded_Descript:
The frame rate limit when in the background. 

Set this lower for a more consistent frame rate or higher for the best experience on faster machines. You may need to disable Vsync to reach higher frame rates.
OptionsDescriptions.FrameRateLimit_InMenu_Description:
The frame rate limit when in the menu. 

Set this lower for a more consistent frame rate or higher for the best experience on faster machines. You may need to disable Vsync to reach higher frame rates.
OptionsDescriptions.FrameRateLimit_OnBattery_Description:
The frame rate limit when running on battery. 

Set this lower for a more consistent frame rate or higher for the best experience on faster machines. You may need to disable Vsync to reach higher frame rates.
OptionsDescriptions.WindowMode_Description:
In Windowed mode you can interact with other windows more easily. 

In Windowed Fullscreen mode you can easily switch between applications. 

In Fullscreen mode you cannot interact with other windows as easily, but the game may run slightly faster.
OptionsDescriptions.LowLatency_Description:
Low Latency mode is highly recommended while using Frame Generation

<strong>Reflex supported only for NVIDIA™ GTX 900 cards and above.</>
<strong>Antilag supported only by AMD Radeon™ RX 5000 Series and newer.</>
OptionsDescriptions.LandscapeQuality_Description: Parallax Steps (if Landscape Tessellation is disabled) and density of additional gravel geometry.
OptionsDescriptions.LandscapeQuality_Disabled_Description: Platform does not support Landscape Quality
OptionsDescriptions.MotionBlurQuality_Disabled_Description: Platform does not support Motion Blur Quality
OptionsDescriptions.PostProcessingQuality_Description: Post Processing effects include Motion Blur, Depth of Field and Bloom. Increasing this setting improves the quality of post process effects, but can reduce performance.
OptionsDescriptions.GraphicsQualityPresets_Description: Quality Presets allow you to adjust multiple video options at once. Try a few options to see what fits your preference and your device's performance.
OptionsDescriptions.ReflectionQuality_Description: Reflection quality determines the resolution and accuracy of reflections. Settings of 'High' and above use more accurate ray tracing methods to render reflections, but can reduce performance.
OptionsDescriptions.MouseTargetingMultiplier_Description: Sets the modifier for reducing mouse sensitivity when targeting. 100% will have no slow down when targeting. Lower settings will have more slow down when targeting.
OptionsDescriptions.MouseSensitivityYaw_Description: Sets the sensitivity of the mouse's horizontal (x) axis. With higher settings the camera will move faster when looking left and right with the mouse.
OptionsDescriptions.MouseSensitivityPitch_Description: Sets the sensitivity of the mouse's vertical (y) axis. With higher settings the camera will move faster when looking up and down with the mouse.
OptionsDescriptions.Shadows_Description:
Shadow quality determines the resolution and view distance of dynamic shadows. Shadows improve visual quality and give better depth perception, but can reduce performance.

Low - No shadows for the fastest performance
Medium - The fastest performance-friendly shadows
High - A balance between quality and performance
Epic - An optimized variant with minimal visual errors
OptionsDescriptions.CoopInfoCollision_Description: Determines whether player info should be visible when other players are hidden behind objects.
OptionsDescriptions.TextureQuality_Description: Texture quality determines the resolution of textures in the game. Increasing this setting will make objects more detailed, but can reduce performance.
OptionsDescriptions.BackgroundAudio_Description: Turns game audio on/off when the game is in the background. When on, the game audio will continue to play when the game is minimized or when focus is on another window.
OptionsDescriptions.ViewDistance_Description: View distance determines how far away objects are hidden for better performance.
OptionsDescriptions.ADSToggle_Description: When enabled, ADS will be toggled when the button is pressed. If disabled, ADS will be active while the button is held down.
OptionsDescriptions.CrouchToggle_Description: When enabled, crouch mode will be toggled when a button is pressed. If disabled, crouch will be active while the button is held down.
OptionsDescriptions.ResolutionWindowedFullscreen_Disabled_De: When Window Mode is set to <strong>Windowed Fullscreen</>, the resolution must match your desktop's native resolution.

ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_MagLight_desc: A stock, light, cheap, practical magazine for the Phantom. It allows for <blue>Faster Reload</> compared to its modified counterparts, as all unnecessary bulk was cut down to make its manufacturing as cheap as possible.
ToolsAndWeapons.MEDTOOL_Desc:
An advanced medical tool full of pharmaceuticals that speed up the regeneration of the body.

Gets recharged with biological matter gained from killing aliens, gathering plants and taking damage.
ToolsAndWeapons.GRENADE_Desc:
An energy bomb that attracts aliens when deployed.

Charged by destroying aliens and meteor pieces.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_MagCompact_desc: Designed for a more aggressive approach, this magazine option strips out all unnecessary bulk to significantly <blue>Reduce Reload Time</>. While this design gets you back in the fight faster, it comes at a severe cost to capacity, making it a poor choice for sustained fire.
ToolsAndWeapons.HARVESTER_Desc: A device used to gather natural resources from ores.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_MagAssisted_desc: An experimental loading chamber outfitted with a cutting-edge ALM module to provide skilled users with the option to use a vastly more efficient <blue>Faster Reload</> technique. Simultaneously, it provides the less adept with perplexed looks as shells seemingly vanish from their grasp.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_FrontBuzzsaw_desc: Field-modified and utterly destructive, the "Buzzsaw" barrel significantly <blue>Increases Rate of Fire</> at the expense of all else. The weapon becomes a literal buzzsaw of flying death, though its recoil is a violent beast that only the most dedicated can hope to tame.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_StockRunner_desc: Interplanetary expansion is no easy feat, especially when it comes to worlds that need to be conquered, not just settled. Rising demand to equip various kinds of troops engaging in dynamic combat has given birth to this ground-breaking module. Counter-intuitive as it may be, its Energy-RC system allows for <blue>Reduced Spread During Movement</>, perfect for a run-and-gun scenario when combat gets the most intense.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_SightsDef_desc:
Meet the Standard Mk2 True <blue>Holographic Sight</> (THS): a very clear horizontal picture at a very low price.

Its design doesn't allow it to be mounted far from the weapon, nor can it display a dot in place of its signature chevron. While user complaints are common, it's never enough to deter GMS from this exceptionally cheap default. Besides, they can always spring for a premium alternative, right?
ToolsAndWeapons.MACHINEGUN_Desc:
Model 175 Griffits Response Infantry Machine Gun

A rapid-fire weapon capable of inflicting massive damage.
ToolsAndWeapons.RIFLE_Desc:
Modular Assault Rifle - v9

A medium-range automatic weapon. Commonly used by the IRO space marines.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_BarrelExtended_desc: Need more range in your shotgun? Griffits is here to provide solutions, not excuses. A heftier barrel along with a modified choke are here to provide <blue>Lower Damage Falloff</>.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_BarrelPiercing_desc: Outside of the solar system there isn't really much regulation against using high penetration weapons. Thus, this SLAMS <blue>Enemy Penetration</> barrel device comes free of charge.
ToolsAndWeapons.SHOTGUN_Desc:
Self-Loading Attack Modular Shotgun

A short-range weapon with high recoil. Best for close combat.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_BarrelShort_desc: A shortened, chokeless barrel in case you ever need <blue> Wider Pellet Spread</>. Especially useful while hunting smaller, weaker targets such as birds... or packs of Swarmers.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_StockRecoil_desc: Similarly to most LMGs, the GRIM was never meant to be fired "too" accurately, prioritizing instead the sheer volume of lead being sent downrange. Yet in some cases both of these qualities are needed. <blue>Reduced Recoil</> provided by this force dampening module is the first step to making that happen in any build.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_StockReserve_desc: A simple and inexpensive modification to elongate the magazine into the stock resulting in <blue>Increased Magazine Capacity</>. Or so it would be if not for corporate greed demanding a sacrifice for using their patented solution. Not that there's an available alternative. Time to pay up.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_MagCounter_desc: Some operators prefer a tighter, more controllable weapon over the GRIM's massive spray. The Horizontal Stabilizer Magazine is designed for them as it significantly <blue>Reduces Horizontal Recoil</>. This comes at a severe cost, however, as the default magazine's legendary capacity is a distant memory.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_MagFast_desc: A standard SLAMS internal magazine. Optimized to use universal pattern shells and provide an <blue>Increased Fire Rate</> for more efficient lead delivery.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_SightsCQB_desc: The CCS provides a more <blue>classic sight view</> compared to the default, built-in holographic sight. It's often the optic of choice for mercenaries and elite military units alike.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_StockDef_desc: The GMS Ergonomic Stock is the default option for the M175 GRIM, designed to provide a stable foundation for the weapon. Its focus on user comfort and stability provides baseline <blue>Reduced Weapon Sway</>, making the GRIM a predictable and reliable platform for any engagement.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_MagDef_desc: The GMS High-Capacity Magazine 110, or "Hi-Cap," is the stock solution for the GRIM. Combining ease of production with a simple "more firepower" doctrine, it provides unmatched <blue>Increased Magazine Capacity</> right out of the box. Some users complain that rounds rattle inside it more than in its counterparts, but the issue has never been officially acknowledged by GMS.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_SightsDef_desc: The GMS THS Mk2.4 is the M175 GRIM's standard aiming system. This holographic open sight provides a clear, unobstructed picture, allowing for quick target acquisition at close to medium range. A reliable and no-frills option, its design is the baseline for all other specialized optics.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_StockLight_desc:
The Phantom was built for Space Marine mobility in dynamic combat, requiring the lightest and most durable materials. This lightweight stock optimizes it even further, increasing <blue>Movement Speed</> for its wielder. 

Unfortunately Phantom's signature recoil dampening module had to be cut out making the modified platform an unpopular choice in the military.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_MagPiercing_desc: The Phantom was primarily developed for use (and sale) back on Earth, never truly meant to fend off alien hordes. Your priorities are vastly different, though, so get this <blue>Enemy Penetration</> mod installed and get ready to defend yourself – now against 3 aliens at a time!
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_StockRecoil_desc:
The Phantom's entire development was funded to find a suitable replacement for the hard-kicking, albeit reliable, MAR-8. 
GMS decided to give it a try and tasked its lab rats with what seemed an impossible goal: keep the same stopping power while making the platform much easier to use, appealing both to military and private sectors. Impossible, you might think, unless you're willing to pour literal millions of UC into the effort - in which case you can create a sophisticated, yet remarkably robust, dampening system that significantly <blue> Reduces Recoil</>.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_StockStable_desc: The bigger the gun, the more sacrifice needs to be made in terms of its weight. To take some of it off your (literal) shoulder, Griffits techs developed this lightweight stock that <blue>Reduces Deployment Time</>.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_FrontHeatsink_desc:
The invention of high-efficiency heatsinks, such as the CL/NA-2, has allowed for the creation of weapons with significantly <blue>Increased Rate of Fire</> compared to their predecessors. 

Unfortunately, while more death downrange per second sounds good on paper, it makes the recoil unbearable for most people. Thus, these designs never truly gained popularity or were ever mass produced. But you're not "most people", are you? If you're not, then this mod might just be the thing for you.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_SightsMagnifier_desc:
This astigmatism-friendly, fixed <blue>magnification optic</> is perfect if you need to engage targets a little farther away than usual.

Legal Note:
The MAR-9 "Phantom" is not a sniper rifle, nor is it designed as such. GMS and its subsidiaries are NOT liable for sleeves and/or lives lost in attempts to use it as one.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_FrontBarExt_desc: This classic long barrel has remained virtually unaltered since the days of the MAR-8. While not interchangeable without significant modification (since that's no way for a company to make a profit, of course) it offers <blue>Lower Damage Falloff</> compared to its shorter counterparts.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_StockStable_desc: This experimental <blue> Weapon Sway Reduction </> module employs a repurposed gyroscope stabilization system to make the Phantom easier to control. That is, if you can bear the increased recoil, as it replaces the usual dampening system.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_FrontDef_desc: This is the GMS Standard Issue Barrel, the reliable default option for the M175 GRIM. It offers moderate and balanced <blue>Recoil Reduction</> to both the vertical and the horizontal kick, making the platform stable right out of the box. While not designed for aggressive specialization, its dependable, all-around performance is what keeps it as the standard for GMS.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_MagShredder_desc: This modified internal magazine is specifically made to accommodate the nastiest Griffits Mk4 "Shredder" shotgun shells. Illegal to use against human beings, these shells nonetheless provide a much needed <blue>Increased Damage</> output when fired at aliens.
ToolsAndWeapons.PISTOL_Desc:
Universal Personal Pistol

A semi-automatic handgun favored for its balance and control.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Shotgun_StockDef_desc: Universal firearm stock used in various Griffits-made weapons. Its sturdy design focuses on providing <blue>Reduced Weapon Sway</> to positively affect the ease of use and versatility of the platform.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_FrontLight_desc:
While a standard harvester or pistol might suffice to deal with a few swarmers lured by the sound of sweet, sweet energy gathering Arcadia's riches, it's always safer to have more firepower at hand. 

This short barrel makes the entire platform both shorter and more lightweight, which <blue>Reduces Deployment Time</> as users can keep it close by.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_Rifle_MagExtended_desc: While slightly more cumbersome to reload, this oversized case significantly <blue>Increases Magazine Capacity</>, making it easier to deal with larger groups of enemies.
ToolsAndWeapons.Mod_MG_FrontSidegrip_desc: While the standard GRIM barrel offers a balanced approach to recoil, some operators demanded more. The Uplift Dampener barrel answers that call by aggressively <blue>Reducing Vertical Recoil</>, allowing for tighter bursts and more accurate sustained fire. Just be prepared for a bit more horizontal pull as this mod sacrifices the gun's default dampening system for laser-like vertical stability.

TutorialObjectives.Tut_DP_Content:
Dear convicts,

Welcome the first team of the new Argos project.

Claywood Corporation is honored to welcome you to the surface of Arcadia-7, located in the Ruptura System, in the URV-X galaxy. Your presence, as the first team after more than half a century of stagnation, marks a new chapter in the history of humanity—and the future of our company.

Your mission is to extract, process, automate, and ship the resources required on Earth. At the same time, we encourage you to explore and document this undiscovered world—a potential New Earth.

You were chosen for a reason. Each of you has unique talents and experiences that make you invaluable pioneers. While your past may have been difficult, Claywood Corporation offers you a chance for redemption and a fresh start.

Each completed order brings you closer to the freedom you long for.

Good luck!

Yours sincerely,
The Claywood Corporation Team

Your basic training on Arcadia-7 is over, but this is only the beginning of your sentence. Collect resources, optimize production, defend your base and try to survive.

Other players can now join your game.

StarRupture is an Early Access game and some elements are still work-in-progress. Expect more content and improvements with future game updates. 

If you encounter any issues with the game let us know via our support page at starrupture-game.com/support. Please join our community to share your thoughts and suggestions at discord.gg/StarRupture

Thank you for your purchase and have a nice sentence!

UIForgottenEngine.CombustionPowerGenerator_desc: An advanced power generator. Burns chemicals from the atmosphere to create electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.MilitaryAssembler_desc: Advanced production building. Utilizes high speed machining to make Products.
UIForgottenEngine.Factory_desc: Advanced production building. Utilizes nanoscale printing to make Products.
UIForgottenEngine.Airlock_desc: Allows access to Habitats. Has to be built on a Habitat wall.
UIForgottenEngine.VerticalBridge_desc: Allows access to a Habitat placed on top of another Habitat. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.BaseCore_desc: Allows for the building of other structures. Protects your base from Fire Waves. Has limited capacity that can be upgraded. Exceeding its capacity will disable the Fire Wave protection leaving your base inoperable for a longer amount of time.
UIForgottenEngine.Zipline_desc: Used to quickly travel between Zipline Supports. Doesn't conduct electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.SuitWorkshop_desc: Allows for the installation of Limbic Enhancement Membranes (LEMs). Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.PackageReceiver_desc: Allows for the long distance transportation of selected items. Requires a Cargo Dispatcher to operate.
UIForgottenEngine.PackageSender_desc: Allows for the long distance transportation of selected items. Requires a Cargo Receiver to operate.
UIForgottenEngine.Teleporter_desc: Allows for long distance travel between any two Teleporters.
UIForgottenEngine.DashCollection_desc: Allows you to move rapidly in one direction over a short distance. Costs Energy.
UIForgottenEngine.PPSCollection_desc: Allows you to run without using Energy when you are on tiles that are connected to power.
UIForgottenEngine.BuildingDroneCollection_desc: An alternative building mode with greater freedom of movement.
UIForgottenEngine.MechanicalDrillT2_desc: An improved version of the Ore Excavator offering higher extraction rates. Can be placed only on Titanium, Wolfram, and Calcium deposits.
UIForgottenEngine.GrenadeCollection_desc: Attracts Vermin when deployed. Charged by killing Vermin and harvesting meteors. The Grenade will be automatically equipped once claimed.
UIForgottenEngine.WindPowerGenerator_desc: A basic power generator. Converts wind into electrical energy.
UIForgottenEngine.SolarPowerGenerator_desc: A basic power generator. Creates energy using photovoltaic cells.
UIForgottenEngine.Furnace_desc: A basic production building. Utilizes heat to make Products.
UIForgottenEngine.Crafter_desc: A basic production building. Utilizes nanoscale printing to make Products.
UIForgottenEngine.ResearchLab_desc: A building that allows for the automation of analyzing Value Materials and producing Research Points.
UIForgottenEngine.ConnectingPlatform_desc: Can be connected to other Platforms or placed on Pillar Supports.
UIForgottenEngine.StorageDepot_desc: Can store up to 1600 units of one item. Can be expanded using more Power.
UIForgottenEngine.ResourceRedistributorMK2_desc: Can store up to 1600 units of one selected item.
UIForgottenEngine.ResourceRedistributor_desc: Can store up to 400 units of one item.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRoundabout_desc: Connection for Drone Rails. Allows for the splitting and expanding of their paths in a more organized way.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneJunction_4_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Allows for the expansion and splitting of their paths.
UIForgottenEngine.RailNode_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Allows for the splitting or merging of up to 3 Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.BigRailNode_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Allows for the splitting or merging of up to 5 Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.RailPole_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Used to support long Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneLane_3_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Used to support long Rails. Can connect up to 3 Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneLane_5_desc: A connector for Drone Rails. Used to support long Rails. Can connect up to 5 Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.HorizontalBridge_desc: Connects 2 Habitats placed side by side. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.FoodProcessor_desc: Converts raw consumables. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRailT1_desc: A core component of the rail system. Allows drones to transport items between buildings. Transfers 120 Items per minute. Conducts electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRailT5_desc: A core component of the rail system. Allows drones to transport items between buildings. Transfers 1500 Items per minute. Conducts electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRailT2_desc: A core component of the rail system. Allows drones to transport items between buildings. Transfers 240 Items per minute. Conducts electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRailT3_desc: A core component of the rail system. Allows drones to transport items between buildings. Transfers 480 Items per minute. Conducts electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.DroneRailT4_desc: Core component of the rail system. Allows drones to transport items between buildings. Transfers 750 items per minute. Conducts electricity.
UIForgottenEngine.MechanicalDrill_desc: Crucial during the early phase of the mission. Used to extract basic ores. Can be placed only on Titanium, Wolfram, and Calcium deposits.
UIForgottenEngine.Turret_Tier2_desc: A defensive structure. Automatically aims and shoots at enemies. Requires Standard Ammo to work. Can be resupplied via Drone Rails.
UIForgottenEngine.Turret_Tier1_desc: A defensive structure. Automatically aims and shoots at enemies. Requires Standard Ammo to work. Has to be supplied manually.

UIForgottenEngine.FurnaceT2_desc: Improved basic production building. Utilizes heat to make Products. Offers optimized recipes designed for higher production output as well as recipes of higher Value when sent to Corporations.

UIForgottenEngine.Assembler_desc: An intermediate production building. Utilizes nanoscale printing to make Products.

UIForgottenEngine.HabitatBig_desc: Protects from external threats. Allows placement of interior structures. Needs an Airlock for access.
UIForgottenEngine.Habitat_desc: Protects from external threats. Allows placement of interior structures. Needs an Airlock for access.
UIForgottenEngine.Recycler_desc: Recycles items into various Building Materials.
UIForgottenEngine.Pressurizer_desc: Refines raw Helium and Sulphur into Products.
UIForgottenEngine.Smelter_desc: Refines raw Titanium, Wolfram, and Calcium into Products.

UIForgottenEngine.BasicExporter_desc: Sends provided items to Corporations. Each sent Product increases your Value and reputation with the selected Corporation.

UIForgottenEngine.RecipeTable_desc: Unlocks new production and food recipes. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.Connector_desc: Used to connect different levels of a base.
UIForgottenEngine.Armory_desc: Used for weapon management. Unlocks new weapons and mods in exchange for War Bonds. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.Analyzer_desc: Used to analyze items in exchange for Data Points. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.ResearchTerminal_desc: Used to claim rewards from Corporations. Allows for the spending of Data Points. Can be placed on a wall or a ceiling. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.GasExtractor_desc: Used to extract Helium-3. Can be placed only on Helium-3 deposits.
UIForgottenEngine.LiquidExtractor_desc: Used to extract Powerium. Can be placed only on Powerium deposits.
UIForgottenEngine.SulfurExtractor_desc: Used to extract Sulfur. Can be placed only on Sulfur deposits. Cannot be placed when corrosive gases are present.
UIForgottenEngine.LaserDrill_desc: Used to extract advanced ores. Can be placed only on Goethite deposits.
UIForgottenEngine.MedToolCollection_desc: Used to heal yourself or other players. Charged by killing Vermin, taking damage, and collecting plants. The Medtool will be automatically equipped once claimed.
UIForgottenEngine.PersonalStorageBig_desc: Used to store items. Can be placed on the ground or a wall. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
UIForgottenEngine.UpgradeStation_desc: Used to unlock improved versions of buildings. Can be placed on a wall or a ceiling. Has to be placed inside a Habitat.
